izzyondroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.name: Dhizuku
izzyondroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.summary: A tool that can share Device Owner permissions to other applications.
izzyondroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.description:
This app can delegate functions from the device owner. That is, this app acts as an intermediary to call functions from the device owner.
 Normally, this authority can only be delegated to one app, but Dhizuku allows you to delegate the full authority of the device owner to other apps.
 It's easy to set up (ex: Shizuku, QR code). For more information, please see the tutorial .
 Usage example, it is ideal when you need to support two or more device owner permissions at the same time.
 Specifically, in Japan, you need to support both Aurora Store and Test DPC on a device with some limited functionality.
 Even if the app developer does not support Dhizuku, you can force support for Dhizuku by using the Dhizuku-API-Xposed module.

fdroid:com.exifthumbnailadder.app.name: Exif Thumbnail Adder
fdroid:com.exifthumbnailadder.app.summary: Add thumbnail in the EXIF tag of JPEG picture not having one (batch processing)
fdroid:com.exifthumbnailadder.app.description:
This application for android devices searches for pictures (JPEG) on your device and adds a thumbnail if they don't have one yet. Thumbnails are added to the EXIF metadata structure.
It is designed to work from android Oreo (android 8, SDK 26).
Please report issues here: https://github.com/tenzap/exif-thumbnail-adder/issues 
For more information, some known facts and how you may contribute, refer to the [project homepage][1].
 Rationale 
On some smartphones, when wanting to import pictures to Windows (or any device/operating system supporting MTP or PTP protocols), I noticed the pictures may not display a thumbnail in the import wizard (whether through the Photos app, or through the Windows Explorer import feature).
There are two possible reasons for that behaviour. First, the thumbnail is not present in the picture, usually because the app that created the picture didn't add a thumbnail. Second, there is a thumbnail but it is ignored because some EXIF tags are missing.
 Features 
- Add thumbnail to pictures (JPEG) that don't yet have one
- Lanczos algorithm to downsample picture thanks to [FFmpeg's swscale library][2] for best results.
- Select one or more folders to scan from any storage (internal, SDCard...). For example DCIM, Pictures...
- Exclude one subdirectory from selected directories
- Preserve timestamps of the pictures
- Processing log
- Synchronize deleted files in the source directory to the backup and working directory (so that you don't keep in the backup folder pictures you don't have anymore in the source folder)
- Conservative default options (backup pictures, skip corrupt files)
- Install app on internal storage or external storage
- Default EXIF library: [Exiv2][3].
- Alternative libraries: Android-Exif-Extended, libexif, pixymeta-android. See known facts on project page to learn more on benefits and drawbacks of each library.
- Settings: 
 - Rotate the thumbnail
 - Replace existing thumbnail
 - Backup of original pictures (backup is never overwritten by the app once created if you choose to add the thumbnail to the input file in its initial location)
 - Skip pictures having malformed metadata (this can be disabled to process also files having corrupt tags)
 - Replace picture in place or write new picture to another directory
 Requested permissions 
- WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE , READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE , READ_MEDIA_IMAGES 
- MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 
- ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION 
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS 
- get more details on the project homepage
 Installation 
- Prerequisites: minimum android Oreo (android 8, SDK 26). App was tested up to Android 11.
- Download it through F-Droid app [here][4]
- Download the APK from the [release page][5]
 License 
GPL-3.0 (see "COPYING" file on project homepage)
 URLs 
- [1]: https://github.com/tenzap/exif-thumbnail-adder 
- [2]: https://ffmpeg.org/libswscale.html 
- [3]: https://www.exiv2.org 
- [4]: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.exifthumbnailadder.app 
- [5]: https://github.com/tenzap/exif-thumbnail-adder/releases

fdroid:eu.darken.myperm.name: Permission Pilot
fdroid:eu.darken.myperm.description:
Permission Pilot is a new kind of app to help you review apps and their permissions.
With each Android update permissions are getting more complex.
Android showing permissions in various different locations, doesn't make it easier to review them:
* App Info page
* Special Access
* Permissions Manager
* and more...
 Permission Pilot lists all permissions in a single location, giving you a bird's eye view of app permissions.
Two perspectives are available: You can either view all permissions an app requests, or view all apps that request a permission.
 Apps tab 
All installed apps, including system apps and work profile apps.
Clicking on any app will list all permissions that the app has requested, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access, along with their status.
This will also include internet permissions, SharedUserID status!
 Permissions tab 
All permissions that exist on your device, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access.
Permissions are pre-grouped for easier navigation, e.g. Contacts, Microphone, Camera, etc.
Clicking on a permission shows all the apps that request access to that permission.
Apps and permissions can be searched using free-text, sorted and filtered by different criteria.
 Overview 
A summary dashboard showing app counts by category — privacy, security, install source, and more. Each category row navigates directly to a filtered app list.
 Permission Watcher 
Get notified when an app update adds new permissions or changes existing ones. Permission Watcher checks your apps after each update and creates a report if anything changed.
 Data Export 
Export app or permission data in Markdown, CSV, or JSON.
 Manifest Viewer 
Browse raw app manifests with searchable, categorized sections. See which apps can discover other installed apps.

fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.name: De1984
fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.summary: Privacy-focused Firewall and Package Manager for Android devices
fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.description:
De1984 is a Firewall and Package Manager for Android that works with or without root.
The name De1984 comes from George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four. It stands for resisting surveillance and taking back control of your device and data.
 FIREWALL FEATURES 
- Four firewall methods: iptables (root, or Shizuku in root mode), ConnectivityManager (Shizuku, Android 13+), NetworkPolicyManager (Shizuku, chosen manually) and VPN (no root, works everywhere). Picked automatically for your device. iptables blocks at kernel level
- On ROMs without POLICY_REJECT_ALL, NetworkPolicyManager only blocks metered background data, not WiFi
- Block WiFi, Mobile Data and Roaming separately with iptables and VPN (Roaming is part of Mobile Data). ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager block an app on all networks or none
- Block LAN access, enforced only by iptables
- "Block All by Default" (allowlist) or "Allow All by Default" (blocklist). Switching resets every app's WiFi, Mobile, Roaming and LAN rules to the new default, with no confirmation. System-recommended apps keep theirs, and critical and VPN apps keep theirs only while "Allow Firewall Critical Packages" is on
- Captive portal settings (root or Shizuku). They stay changed after De1984 is uninstalled
- Screen-off blocking to save battery and data
- Rules follow network changes in real time
 PACKAGE MANAGEMENT (Shizuku or root) 
- Enable or disable system apps, force stop apps, uninstall system and user apps
- Filter by system/user and enabled/disabled, and search
 PRIVACY FIRST 
- No tracking, analytics or telemetry
- Local-only data storage
- No proprietary libraries, no Google Play Services
- 100% open source (MIT License), buildable from source
 REQUIREMENTS 
- Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
 PERMISSIONS 
- ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE: apply rules per network
- BIND_VPN_SERVICE: the VPN firewall
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: list installed apps
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS (optional): new app installs
- RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED: start the firewall after a reboot, if it was on
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: keep the firewall running
- REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS (optional): stop Android killing the firewall
- KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES: last fallback for force stop
- Shizuku API: talk to Shizuku or Sui
- INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS: read apps in other profiles. When one exists, De1984 grants it to itself through root or Shizuku, without asking
- WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE: only checked, to show status
- REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES, INSTALL_SHORTCUT, ACCESS_SUPERUSER: declared, not used
- Root or Shizuku (optional): the iptables, ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager firewalls, package management, boot protection and captive portal settings
 OPEN SOURCE 
Source code: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984
Issues: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984/issues
Late nights for brighter days.
Created by Doru Moraru

 Why do I need it? 
The app is designed for those who simply want to keep track of cash flow, especially cash, without additional features and complications, such as managing credit cards, bank accounts or advanced financial instruments. Do you just want to track how you spend your cash? This is the right app for you.
 How it works 
The interface is designed to be simple and intuitive. To add a new transaction, simply click on the "+" button and fill in the form with the amount and a few words of description. With a simple swipe of the transaction, you can modify or delete it. If you want to change the currency, in the settings you will find all the currencies used in the world.
 Other features 
- You can search transactions by name to filter them and view a partial balance.
- By enabling the option in the settings, you can manage multiple accounts, each with its own list of transactions.

اگر هنگام کار با ابزارهایی مثل ChatGPT، Gemini، Claude، Copilot یا Perplexity با متنهای چپچین، فونت نامناسب، جهت اشتباه نوشتهها یا ظاهر نامرتب متن فارسی روبهرو میشوید، همدست کمک میکند تجربه خواندن و نوشتن شما بهتر شود.
همدست محتوای پیامها، پرامپتها یا پاسخها را تغییر نمیدهد. این افزونه فقط ظاهر متن را در مرورگر شما بهبود میدهد تا متن فارسی و عربی راحتتر خوانده شود.
قابلیتها 🚀
✅ راستچینسازی متنهای فارسی و عربی
✅ بهبود خوانایی با فونت مناسب فارسی
✅ نمایش منظمتر متنهای ترکیبی فارسی، عربی و انگلیسی
✅ تنظیم جداگانه برای هر سایت پشتیبانیشده
✅ حالت سبک برای راستچینسازی بدون تغییر فونت
✅ امکان نمایش اعداد فارسی
✅ رابط ساده و سریع برای تغییر تنظیمات
چرا همدست؟ 💡
نمایش متن فارسی در بعضی ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی همیشه یکدست نیست. گاهی جهت متن درست نمایش داده نمیشود، فونت خوانایی کافی ندارد یا متنهای ترکیبی فارسی و انگلیسی ظاهر شلوغی پیدا میکنند.
همدست این مشکل را در سطح نمایش متن کاهش میدهد و کمک میکند مکالمهها، پرامپتها و پاسخهای فارسی را راحتتر بخوانید.
حریم خصوصی 🔒
همدست برای بهبود ظاهر متن در مرورگر طراحی شده است.
این افزونه محتوای چتها را برای پردازش به سرور خارجی ارسال نمیکند و پیامها، پاسخها، پرامپتها یا اطلاعات شخصی شما را برای تبلیغات، فروش داده یا اهداف نامرتبط ذخیره و منتقل نمیکند.
روش استفاده ⚙

 وارد یکی از ابزارهای پشتیبانیشده شوید.
 همدست بهصورت خودکار نمایش متن فارسی و عربی را بهبود میدهد.
 برای تغییر تنظیمات هر سایت، روی آیکون افزونه کلیک کنید.
همدست برای تجربهای خواناتر و منظمتر هنگام کار با متن فارسی در ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی ساخته شده است. 🌱
Full Description - English
Hamdast is a lightweight Chrome extension that improves the display of Persian and Arabic text in selected AI tools. ✨
If Persian text appears left-aligned, hard to read, visually messy, or incorrectly mixed with English in tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, or Perplexity, Hamdast helps make the reading and writing experience cleaner.
Hamdast does not change the content of your messages, prompts, or responses. It only improves how text appears in your browser, so Persian and Arabic content becomes easier to read.
Features 🚀
✅ Right-to-left display support for Persian and Arabic text
✅ Improved readability with a Persian-friendly font
✅ Cleaner display for mixed Persian, Arabic, and English text
✅ Per-site settings for supported websites
✅ Lightweight mode for RTL-only display
✅ Optional Persian number display
✅ Simple controls for quick adjustments
Why use Hamdast? 💡
Persian text does not always appear correctly in AI interfaces. Text direction may break, fonts may be difficult to read, and mixed-language prompts can become visually confusing.
Hamdast helps reduce these display issues and makes Persian conversations, prompts, and responses easier to follow.
Privacy 🔒
Hamdast is designed to improve text appearance inside your browser.
The extension does not send your chat content to an external server for processing. It does not sell, store, or transfer your prompts, responses, or personal information for advertising or unrelated purposes.
How to use ⚙
Install the Hamdast Chrome extension.
Open one of the supported tools.
Hamdast automatically improves Persian and Arabic text display when needed.
Click the extension icon to adjust settings for each website.
Hamdast is built for a cleaner and more readable Persian text experience in AI tools. 🌱

firefox-addons:924854.description:
This extension allows you to save the open tabs from your window and then restore them at a later time. You can restore them individually or all at once.
The motivation behind this extension is to allow for easy tab management without the hassle of being signed in to your browser. Oftentimes, I've wanted to save my open tabs before shutting down my computer, but I prefer not to attach an account to my browser. Before, I would waste time copying and pasting each tab's url to a text file so I could remember what I was doing. Now, by using this extension, it is simply a matter of clicking a few buttons to re-open all of your tabs.
For usage help, see the README on Github . Please submit any issues on Github as well.

bluejetty:00027402:ios.description:
Your favorite photo deserves more than a gallery scroll. Paint By Number Creator transforms it into a classic numbered painting you can enjoy yourself, share with family, or print as a handmade gift.
Open a picture, choose how detailed you want the palette, and watch regions and numbers appear. Prefer speed? Use Rough. Want finer shapes? Switch to Precise. Then paint digitally—fill everything at once or one area at a time—or export a crisp PDF with a color key for real paints and paper.
Why people love it
• Bring memories, pets, and portraits to life as numbered art
• Dial in 2–64 colors and A4, A3, or A2 paper for the look you want
• Rough for a quick result, Precise when every contour counts
• Flip between original, filled colors, and numbered outlines
• Playful fill modes: complete the whole picture or tap area by area
• Match paints with RAL, RGB, HEX, or Pantone FHI labels
• Export PDF with color key, print, or save JPEG views
• Keep projects in your library and pick up anytime
From rainy-day coloring to classroom crafts and thoughtful keepsakes, Paint By Number Creator makes creating feel easy—and finishing feel wonderful.

bluejetty:00162129:ios.description:
What can Storage Cleaner help you do?
1. Smart cleaning
Smart cleaning helps you search and filter related data such as picture information, address book information, calendar information, etc. You can manage multiple types of data at one time through the one-click cleaning function.
2. Picture management
Picture management can help you analyze similar or duplicate picture resources in the system album, and can also help you analyze screenshots and other resources, and you can choose to delete them.
3. Address book management
Address book management helps you analyze and filter duplicate contacts, similar contacts, invalid contacts and other information, and you can merge these contacts with one click.
4. Swipe
You can quickly browse and filter the resources in the album. How to filter them? You only need to swipe left or right to distinguish them. After filtering, you can clear the pictures you don't like.
5. Lock App
You can choose which application to lock in the Lock module, and then follow the tutorial instructions to create Personal Automation using the Shortcuts application. Then, you can lock the app you specify so that others cannot peek into the privacy of your app.
6. Internet speed test
It only takes one click, and everything is automatically produced. After a short time test, you can get the downlink speed and uplink speed of the current network.
7. Widgets
Desktop widgets allow you to add network tests, memory usage, CPU usage, etc. to your desktop.
8. Calendar management
Calendar management can make it easier for you to manage events added to the calendar in history. The app provides a simple operation method that allows you to delete unnecessary events very easily.
9. Mobile phone optimization guide
Here you can learn how to find unused apps, how to delete useless apps, and some common social software optimization methods.
For unlocking all features and content, Premium Membership offers one auto-renewable subscription options:
Weekly payment and annual payment subscription options.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchases.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: http://www.conhor.pro/privacystatement/smartdevice/privacyPolicy.html

bluejetty:00092216:ios.description:
Chronic pain sucks. Our team felt this firsthand, and enlisted a world class team of pain experts to design a 12-week curated program designed to take you from pain state, to flow state
“Flowly helps manage not only the physical aspects of living with pain and anxiety, but also offers invaluable support to overcome the mental challenges that come along with it.” -Dr. Aman Mahajan, Chair of Perioperative Medicine at University of Pittsburgh Medical Center
“Flowly’s virtual worlds help users reclaim a sense of calm and safety at the emotional and physical level, thus allowing them to reduce activation in their nervous system and pain in their body.” -Pierre Etienne-Vannier, Mind-Body Practitioner
*How Does It Work?*
Flowly’s Healing from Pain Program is a curated 12-week program with new lessons, daily trainings, and access to a coach included
Weeks 1-4: Building the Foundation
In your first week, you will receive a Kit that includes a VR headset and a HR sensor so you can engage in your daily VR nervous system training. You will also schedule your first of three Flowly Coaching sessions to set your goals for the program, design your Flowly routine moving forward, and answer any questions you might have
Weeks 5-8: Cultivating Intrinsic Brain-Body Regulation
Engage in trainings that utilize your nervous system to take control of various psychological and emotional aspects of your chronic pain experience. All while discovering new environments and tools to create physical safety. Meet with your Flowly coach for your second session to check in on progress and goals
Weeks 9-12: Establishing Enduring Practice
Reinforcing all the training you have accomplished so far, we will put together all the tools and learnings into a daily ritual that best fits your life now, but most importantly, your life and dreams moving forward. You will also meet with your coach for your last session to wrap up your program and establish your steps moving forward
All throughout the program, you will have access to:
* Bubbles: virtual small support groups where heroes can connect with one another and engage in activities to do with improving their health
* Workshops: with health experts and specialists on specific educational health topics
* Tools: 2D breathwork guides, educational articles, and more in the Resources tab in-app
* Forum: a community forum where heroes can share their experiences and questions
After 3 months you will have the opportunity to go into “Maintenance Mode” with continued access to the program content, new VR worlds and experiences, and other in-app resources.
*Can This Actually Work?*
Flowly marries two powerful approaches: biofeedback for relaxation training and Virtual Reality. There are 1,000+ studies dedicated to both therapies for pain. Flowly itself is partnered with UPMC and USC for studies with a grant awarded by the National Institute of Health.
Dr. Robert Tien, the former Chair of Neuroradiology at Duke, says this, “Flowly’s experiences help enhance a user’s Vagus Nerve function, which plays a crucial role in preventing inflammation, increasing heart resilience, and treating symptoms of chronic pain and anxiety. Flowly is fun and accessible, but ultimately, can seriously improve overall life quality with consistent use”
*Subscription Pricing and Terms*
Healing from Pain Program
- Program Fee - $474.99
- Maintenance Fee - $4.99/month
Standard Flowly Subscription 
- Change My Life Membership - $44.99/month or $239.99/year
- Community Membership - $4.99/month or $59.99/year
Your subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account. For more information, see our terms at https://www.flowly.world/terms-of-service and privacy policy at https://www.flowly.world/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00095645:ios.description:
After years of absence, Miscrits is back and better than ever! Return to the world of Miscria and capture hundreds of iconic Miscrits. Train your Miscrits to their strongest forms and put a stop to the Magicites, who threaten to eliminate all Miscrit life from the world!
Explore the World of Miscria!
Start your journey in Sunfall Kingdom and explore the vast and vibrant surroundings! Find and capture hundreds of unique and iconic Miscrits of various types, strength and rarity. Train and evolve your Miscrits into increasingly powerful forms and watch your Miscripedia fill up!
Save Miscria from Apollo Nox!
A mysterious group called the Magicites have vowed to destroy all Miscrits to keep magic under control of the humans. You're Miscria's only hope at stopping them! Their leader, Apollo Nox, has summoned six Elementums that are draining the magic from Miscrits. Deal with the Magicites and defeat all six Elementums to enter his domain and take him down!
Battle Other Players at the Arena!
Take on other players in strategic combat at the arena! Take part in various different Arena formats, each with their own rules and rewards. Conquer the leaderboards and become the best player you can be!
An Engaging Community and Frequent Updates!
Join our Discord of over 50,000 members to showcase your Miscrits, ask questions, discuss strategies and see update details as soon as they're announced! Miscrits is still a work in progress, and there are many updates and expansions planned for the foreseeable future, as well as consistent balance patches to keep the meta fresh and evolving!
A Genuine Free-to-Play Model
Miscrits is a game built by the players, for the players. While there are in-game purchases, all in-game content can be accessed completely for free. No matter how you choose to play, you'll have access to the same tools and content as everyone else!

bluejetty:00131603:ios.description:
EATING OUT SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.
If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.
You find a restaurant that looks promising.
Then the work begins.
You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.
Maybe you feel better.
Maybe you don't.
Either way, you're still left making one of the most important decisions of your day with incomplete information.
That's the part I wanted to fix.
EVERY RESTAURANT EARNS ITS PLACE.
All restaurants start with someone in the gluten-free community who had a safe experience and told us about it.
Then our team gets to work.
First, we research the restaurant — looking into their gluten-free practices and reputation before we ever reach out.
Then we vet it directly. We contact the restaurant and ask the questions that matter. How do they prevent cross-contact? Is there a dedicated fryer? Does the staff understand celiac disease?
Then we write everything up in plain English, so you know what to expect before you ever walk through the door.
Community starting points.
Independent research.
Complete transparency.
WHY I BUILT GLUTEN DUDE.
I've had celiac disease since 2007.
Like you, I've spent way too much time trying to figure out where it was actually safe to eat. I've been glutened by restaurants that sounded confident. I've asked all the awkward questions. 
After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:
Why isn't someone doing this for us?
So I built the app I wished I'd had.
KNOW WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT.
Every restaurant is clearly labeled, so there's never any guessing about what you're getting.
• 100% Gluten-Free
Dedicated gluten-free restaurants.
• Dude Vetted
Personally researched by our team, complete with detailed notes about cross-contact procedures, kitchen practices, dedicated fryers, and staff knowledge.
• User Suggested
Restaurants we've researched but couldn't fully verify directly, backed by positive experiences from our community.
• Trusted Chains
Chain restaurants our community consistently trusts.
No mystery ratings.
No hidden scoring.
Just complete transparency.
BUILT FOR LIFE WITH CELIAC.
Gluten Dude is more than a gluten-free restaurant finder.
It's a travel companion.
• Trip Planner
Find trusted restaurants along your exact driving route.
• Airport Dining
Browse gluten-free options in more than 100 airports, organized by terminal.
• Destination Planning
Know your safest dining options before you leave home.
Because the best trips are the ones where you spend your time making memories, not searching for your next meal.
NO PAY-TO-PLAY.
Restaurants can't pay to be featured. No ads influencing what you see.
Every restaurant is here because it earned its place.
Because trust is everything.
SAVE MONEY.
Living gluten-free is expensive enough.

bluejetty:00186221:ios.description:
Used by over 3 million teachers and students worldwide, Showbie is the easiest and most effective digital learning app to personalise assignments and feedback on iPad.
DNA of Learning: Your Foundation for Student Success
Showbie supports the improvement of everyday teaching and learning by elevating four essential strands of effective classroom practice - direct instruction, independent practice, personalised feedback and real-time assessment - all in one platform.
Find out how easy it is to assign, collect and review student work from thousands of compatible iPad apps, or have your students complete assignments with Showbie’s built in tools. Provide rich feedback using digital ink, text and voice annotations right on images and PDFs, and then add your students’ best work to personalized digital portfolios that can be securely shared with parents.
WHAT EDUCATORS ARE SAYING
“Showbie is my number one can't live without app! It makes the iPad workflow process a breeze! I especially love how it works seamlessly with so many other apps.”
— Kristen Paino, Lead Technology Integrator at Avenues: The World School
“I don't need to convince my colleagues that they need to use this app — it sells itself. I like that it gives me the flexibility in how I choose to grade my student's work, especially with the voice notes feature. There is no single third party app that I would rather champion.”
— Suzanne Lustenhouwer, Teacher and iPad Coordinator, Apple Distinguished Educator
“I love that Showbie is so versatile that the youngest of students can use it independently, yet it is appropriate for older grades as well. The ease of use makes it a great workflow solution for classes with iPads.”
— Kristi Meeuwse, Kindergarten Teacher, Apple Distinguished Educator
KEY FEATURES FOR TEACHERS & STUDENTS
• Share work from thousands of compatible iPad apps in a few taps
• Use the pen tool and pin text notes directly on any PDF or image
• Gauge class understanding in real-time with minute-by-minute assessment
• Instantly differentiate assignments and materials to specific students
• Quickly distribute instructions and materials to your whole class
• Chat privately with individual students to provide timely feedback
• Record voice notes for verbal feedback or language exercises
• Quickly review and assess batches of student work and provide rich, valuable feedback
• Add student work to individual digital portfolios, or enable students to curate their own portfolios
• Invite parents to view their student’s work and keep them informed of classroom activity
• Can be used with any classroom subject
• Available in 18 languages
ENHANCED SHOWBIE PRO FEATURES
• Record and track grades as numeric scores or letter grades, along with qualitative feedback
• Provide richer feedback with more pen colours and line thicknesses, by typing on the page, or by pinning voice notes directly to student work
• Record longer voice notes and videos and upload larger files
• Lock assignments to control student access to documents and feedback
• Give parents complete access to assignments in the classes you choose

bluejetty:00128663:ios.description:
Features:
- User friendly interfaces
- Today Widget for on lock screen for easy to remember
- Preview incorrect answers for easy to get lesson learns
- Plentiful traffic signs for your easy to references
- Structured like the actual DMV written test
- Updated newest for 2020 DMV written test
- Helps you to prepare for practice tests with similar to real exam simulator.
- Total practice offline & on the go
- Manual PDF for each state
Preparing for Your Driving Test
- Get enough practice. Some drivers need more practice than others. Minors (under 18 years old) must complete 50 hours of behind*the*wheel training (10 hours must be night driving) before taking a driving test. When you practice, pretend you are taking a driving test. Ask your accompanying driver to calmly point out your mistakes. Ask questions about particular driving situations that may have confused you and correct your mistakes. The next time you practice, try to correct any driving errors you made before. The DMV examiner is there to ensure you have demonstrated that you can handle your vehicle in regular traffic situations, not to trick you. During your driving test, the examiner will note how you obey the rules of the road and traffic signs and/or signals. They will note other areas in which you may need improvement.
- Practice safe driving tips. To improve your driving skills:
 * Steer smoothly at all times.
 * Accelerate smoothly. Don’t rev the engine or make it stall.
 * Stop the vehicle gently. Start braking well ahead of where you must stop to avoid sudden movement. Know where to stop. Be aware of crosswalks. If your view is blocked at a crosswalk, move forward carefully and look both ways before entering the intersection.
 * Be sure your vehicle is in the correct gear. Don’t grind the gears. Don’t coast to a stop.
 * Always obey the posted speed limits. If needed, reduce your speed to adjust for existing weather, road, and other traffic conditions. Remember to turn on your headlights if you need to use your windshield wipers in poor weather conditions.
 * Follow at a safe distance. Use the 3 second rule. Increase your following distance in bad weather or poor visibility.
 * Know what the traffic signals mean and obey them at all times.
 * Always use the proper lane and start a turn from the correct lane into the correct lane.
 * Signal for all lane changes and turns.
 * Always look for potential hazards (scan), and check your mirrors frequently. Always look over the proper shoulder before making lane changes or pulling away from the curb.
 * Drive defensively. Anticipate another driver’s errors.

bluejetty:00165853:ios.description:
The UK Immigration: ID Check app lets you confirm your identity online when:
• applying for a visa
• updating your personal details on your UKVI account
• setting up access to your online immigration status (eVisa)
Before you start
You must follow the steps in the online application form, account update or eVisa form before using the app.
You will need to be in a well-lit area, so you can take a good quality photograph of yourself.
You need to use:
• an iPhone 8 or newer
• iOS 16 or later
If you are applying for a visa
If you use this app when you apply for a visa, you will not have to attend an appointment to confirm your identity.
You can use this app if you are:
• an EU, European Economic Area (EEA) or Swiss citizen
• a British national (overseas) visa (BNO) applicant with a BNO or Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) passport
• a graduate visa applicant with a UK biometric residence permit (BRP)
You will need either:
• a passport that has a chip (also called a ‘biometric passport’)
• a biometric residence permit (BRP)
If you’re applying for a graduate visa and are not from the EU, European Economic Area (EEA) or a Swiss citizen, you must use your BRP.
If you use a BRP, it must not have expired more than 18 months ago.
If you are setting up access to your eVisa 
You will need either a biometric residence permit (BRP) or a passport.
If you use a BRP, it must not have expired more than 18 months ago. 
If you are updating the personal details on your UKVI account
You will need a passport or other identity document with your new details. Your document must have a biometric chip.
What happens next
The app only helps confirm your identity. You must still complete the rest of your application. We will tell you how to do this when you finish using the app.
Privacy and security
The app is safe and secure. Your personal information will not be stored in the app or on the phone when you finish using it.
For information on staying safe online please visit the UK Cyber Aware website.
Accessibility
Our Accessibility Statement can be found at:
https://confirm-your-identity.homeoffice.gov.uk/register/app-accessibility

bluejetty:00026578:ios.name: Zing AI: Home & Gym Workouts
bluejetty:00026578:ios.summary: Zing is the ultimate AI Coach, revolutionizing fitness with AI-powered, personalized workouts designed by top health and fitness experts. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced athlete, Zing AI Coach adapts to your needs, offering real-ti
bluejetty:00026578:ios.description:
Zing is the ultimate AI Coach, revolutionizing fitness with AI-powered, personalized workouts designed by top health and fitness experts. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced athlete, Zing AI Coach adapts to your needs, offering real-time insights and support for a transformative fitness journey.
Advanced AI Coach
The AI Coach engages proactively, suggesting goals, scheduling workouts, and providing real-time form monitoring and feedback. It checks in daily about your energy levels, mood, and sleep, adjusting your workout plan in real-time to ensure continuous improvement.
Zing Vision
Our advanced Zing Vision technology uses your smartphone's camera to track movements in real-time, providing detailed insights to improve your technique.
AI Body Scan
Zing's AI Body Scan analyzes your body composition using your smartphone's camera. Receive insights into body fat, lean mass, and more, integrated into your fitness plan for a hyper-personalized experience. Photos are promptly deleted for privacy.
Hyper-Personalized Plans
Zing creates customized workout plans based on your unique body data, fitness background, and lifestyle. It dynamically adjusts workout intensity and complexity based on your progress, goals, and activity levels. The Strength Score helps you track and enhance your strength training, setting clear goals through increased workout intensity and repetitions.
Dynamic AI Workout Progression
Zing's AI adjusts your workout intensity and complexity continuously. Centralize all your activity data in Zing for detailed fitness insights. Seamlessly integrate with Apple Watch and Apple Health. Track your daily activity, earn milestones, and share achievements with friends for added encouragement.
World-Class Training
Zing Coach generates intuitive workouts from almost 500 exercises, adapting to your preferences and goals. It tracks muscle fatigue levels, ensuring safe and effective training sessions.
Diverse Workout Types
Zing offers various workout types including strength, HIIT, stretching, and recovery, with Pilates and yoga coming soon. Each type is designed to enhance different aspects of fitness, from muscle development and fat burn to flexibility and mind-body connection.
Fitness and Flexibility Tests
Take the Fitness Test to assess your current fitness level and the Flexibility Test to measure your mobility. Get personalized insights for your plan based on your results, and improve them with targeted exercises.
Community and Support
Join a vibrant community of over a million users. Participate in monthly challenges, invite friends to your Fitness Circle, and connect with others in our Facebook group. Zing Coach fosters a supportive environment that celebrates transformation and progress.
Subscription Plans
We offer a wide range of subscription options so that you can choose the right one for you (3 months access renewal, weekly renewal, etc.). For your convenience, subscriptions are set to Auto-Renew within the 24-hour period prior to the subscription end date. You can cancel your subscription at any moment in your iTunes account settings, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the terms. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at purchase confirmation. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://www.zing.coach/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://www.zing.coach/terms-of-use 
HealthKit Integration
Zing integrates with HealthKit, allowing you to export exercise data and import fitness data and body measurements seamlessly.
Contact Us
Email: support@zing.coach
Instagram: @zing.coach
Transform your fitness journey with Zing Coach. Download now and start your personalized training experience today!

bluejetty:00092240:ios.name: Remootio
bluejetty:00092240:ios.summary:
This application is the companion app to be used with the smart home hardware product Remootio.
Remootio is a Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled end-to-end encrypted smart remote controller, that makes your old gates and garage doors smart. With
bluejetty:00092240:ios.description:
This application is the companion app to be used with the smart home hardware product Remootio.
Remootio is a Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled end-to-end encrypted smart remote controller, that makes your old gates and garage doors smart. With Remootio you can control and monitor your gates and garage doors using your smartphone.
Thanks to Remootio's Bluetooth connectivity, you can control your gates even when WiFi is not available at your gates or when the internet service is down. You can also connect Remootio to your home WiFi and connect it from anywhere within your house. In this mode, no data goes through the internet. You can also set up internet access easily with one click in the App.
For more information, please visit www.remootio.com
Features:
•Connectivity: Bluetooth, WiFi
•Security: 256 bit authenticated end-to-end encryption with protection against replay attacks.
•Keys: You get 20 uniquely managable keys + unlimited guest keys.
•App: Modern, intuitive, and easy to use
•Hardware: Easy to install, compatible with most gates and garage doors as it works with 6-25V AC or 6-36V DC and has a normally open relay output as well as 3 ports for accessories: doorbell, gate status sensor, and manual open button.
•Subscription-free
•Works in parallel with your old remote controller
•Share keys easily with friends and family by scanning a QR code or sending a link. You can revoke keys and access rights any time.
•Auto-open: Remootio can open the gates automatically as you approach them if you turn on the auto-open feature from the Remootio app.
•You can check whether your gate is open or closed from the Remootio app any time. This feature is only available if the sensor is installed.
•Remootio can send you notifications if a certain key holder operated the gate, it was left open, or if someone rang your doorbell
•Manage as many Remootio devices with the simple app as you wish
•Customize the app by selecting different background colors for different devices, and taking photos of your gates and garage doors to appear for each device.
•You can enhance your Remootio with a range of accessories:
 - A status sensor which tells you whether your gate is closed or not
 - You can connect your doorbell (or any button) to Remootio to get notifications when someone rang it.
 - You can connect a manual open button (which you can enable or disable from the app) that opens the gate or garage door when it is pressed.

bluejetty:00096533:ios.description:
Keep Your Brain in Shape — the Fun Way! 
Welcome to Solitaire, the classic card game that’s way more than just a time killer — it’s your daily brain workout in disguise!
Sharpen your mind, challenge your logic, and enjoy that sweet moment when every card falls perfectly into place. Whether you’re a Solitaire pro or just getting started, every deal feels like a mini puzzle waiting to be cracked.
Your goal is simple: sort all cards into four foundation piles, from Ace to King.
Tap, drag, or double-tap to move cards between columns — it’s easy to learn, but surprisingly addictive once you get going!
How to play:
1. Arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors.
2. Move cards strategically to uncover hidden ones.
3. Build up each suit from Ace to King to win!
Use hints or undo if you get stuck — even smart players need a little help sometimes!
Play Solitaire anytime — morning coffee, lunch break, or before bed.
It’s the perfect mix of relaxation and brain training.
Download now and see how smart fun can be!
IGRS：
Age Rating 3 Years Above
Game content suitable for ages 3 and above (3+) does not display references to cigarettes, alcohol, drugs, violence, blood, mutilation, cannibalism, coarse language, swearing, adult humor, nudity, pornography, gambling, or horror, and does not include online interaction features such as conversations.

bluejetty:00069147:ios.description:
【Developer Notes】
I am a billiards lover, before making this game, I tried many times to find a life-like 2D pool game, but failed.
Undeniably, I've come cross some fine 3D pool games, but, personally, I prefer 2D to 3D. Because I find that it's very hard for players to estimate the distance between balls and control the force of the cue when playing 3D pool game. 3D really makes me feel dizzy!
Since I couldn't find a satisfied 2D pool game, I decided to make one myself! After working together with other pool lover developers, Pool Empire came out!
Fortunately, the game physics wins players' recognition, Pool Empire is tagged as【The Most Real 2D Pool Game】.
Leting players enjoy a real pool game is our original intention, and this goal makes us keep trying and persevering.
【The most real pool game】 
Wanna become a billiards pro player? Download and play free POOL EMPIRE now! It’s an arena for ball pool lovers, presenting the most real 2D multiplayer cue game. You can challenge players from all over the world online, and enjoy yourself becoming a pro player.
【Game Features】 
1. 1v1 Battle - Compete against players from around the world and experience the thrill of defeating your opponents.
2. Snooker—Authentic snooker gameplay that lets you effortlessly break the century mark in a single shot.
3. Adventure—Combining billiards with adventure gameplay, featuring skill balls (Lightning Ball, Bomb Ball, and Laser Ball) to boost your scores.
4. Rotation Pocket Multiplier Mode — Different pockets yield various multiplier values. Players must select specific ball numbers to pocket. Higher multipliers and ball numbers result in greater scores.
5. Tournament Mode—Anyone can become the champion and accept challenges from all players.
6. Points Tournament—Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Tournaments, progressing sequentially. Earn points and demonstrate your strength.
7. Club - A group of like-minded players gather to compete and improve together.
8. 14-1 Gameplay — Test your billiards positioning skills for an exceptional scoring experience
9. 8-Player Tournament - Eight players compete, there's only one champion, and the rewards await you.
10. Champion's Road -Challenge world-class billiards stars, master various trick shots, and effortlessly rise from grassroots player to billiards superstar.
11. Friends - Have fun with players from all over the world:Hone your skills, watch masters compete
12. Realistic Model - Authentic billiards physics model, experience the real game.
Download Pool Empire NOW!
【Feedback & Suggestions】 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/poolempire
Twitter: https://twitter.com/poolempire
E-mail: kf@tinghood.com
Thanks for your comments and suggestions!

bluejetty:00153664:ios.name: Project Indigo
bluejetty:00153664:ios.summary: Welcome to Project Indigo, a new camera experience from Adobe Labs. With a custom computational photography pipeline, a natural image look, and full set of manual camera controls, it offers something for professional and casual photographer
bluejetty:00153664:ios.description:
Welcome to Project Indigo, a new camera experience from Adobe Labs. With a custom computational photography pipeline, a natural image look, and full set of manual camera controls, it offers something for professional and casual photographers alike. Also with new controls for computational cameras and a glimpse into the future of AI image processing on our Tech Previews page. 
Available for iPhone 12 and 13 Pro/Pro Max, and all 14, 15, 16, or 17-series devices, and initial support for iPads.
For best experience we recommend using iPhone 15 Pro or newer.
A COMPUTATIONAL PHOTOGRAPHY CAMERA 
Instead of capturing a single photo, for every shutter press Indigo captures a burst of photos and combines them together to produce a high-quality photo with lower noise and higher dynamic range.
PHOTO MODE VS NIGHT MODE 
Photo mode is intended for everyday use in good lighting and has zero shutter lag, meaning it captures the moment you wanted. 
Night mode is intended for use in low light. In this mode images are captured after you press the shutter button, but use longer exposure times, further reducing noise. 
NATURAL LOOK 
Photos produced by Indigo employ computational photography and AI to produce a natural (SLR-like) look for your photos, including special (but gentle) treatment of subjects and skies. This look is applied when generating JPEG images and is embedded as a rendering suggestion in raw DNG files (if enabled). All raw pixels remain intact – the look does not alter them. 
PRO CONTROLS 
Take full control of how Indigo captures the image: manually specify focus, exposure time and ISO, exposure compensation, or white balance. Includes an optional magnified loupe for setting precise focus, and white balance control allows you to tap on an object known to be neutral gray. 
Unique to Indigo’s Night mode is manual control over the number of frames aligned and merged into a final photo. More frames result in lower noise but longer capture time. There is also a Long Exposure mode: if the phone is on a tripod, this allows the capture of synthetic long exposure effects like “water-into-silk" with infinite number of frames where the camera captures and merges images until stopped.
SUPER-RESOLUTION FOR ZOOM 
Using pinch-to-zoom in any camera app often results in image quality loss. To recover the image Indigo employs multi-frame super-resolution which can restore much of the lost quality. ‘SR’ indicator on the zoom buttons shows when it is active. 
MACRO MODE
Enable Macro from the viewfinder and capture stunning close-up shots. 
VIEWFINDER 
Provides a view of the camera parameters that will be used for capture, a live histogram of the scene, zebra striping that shows you where there are over-exposed areas in the image, and a level to help you capture straight images. 
LIGHTROOM INTEGRATION 
Adobe Lightroom for mobile is the most powerful photo editor in the App Store. Indigo filmstrip allows you to send an image directly to Lightroom mobile app for editing. In addition, our raw DNG files provide maximum compatibility with Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop. 
TECHNOLOGY PREVIEWS 
Technology Previews will be a place where we will offer an early look at technologies that may eventually be deployed in Adobe’s flagship products, or that already appear in these products in a slightly different form: 
- AI Denoise is a variant of the AI-based denoising from Camera Raw and Lightroom desktop clients. It uses DNG as input, and it saves a new DNG to your camera roll. 
- Remove Reflections is a variant of the technology from Camera Raw and Lightroom desktop clients. It uses DNG as input, and it saves a medium-resolution JPEG to your camera roll. It tries to remove reflections when shooting through plate glass windows covering most of the camera field of view. 
- Face Dewarp corrects warp on faces near the edge of images captured using wide-angle lenses. It uses DNG or JPEG as input and saves a JPEG to your camera roll.

bluejetty:00171787:ios.summary: TECHNOGYM LIVE is the new digital platform that empowers every TECHNOGYM MYRUN, TECHNOGYM ELLIPTICAL & TECHNOGYM CYCLE. With endless training possibilities, it inspires you to embrace exercise and make it part of your daily ritual to achiev
bluejetty:00171787:ios.description:
TECHNOGYM LIVE is the new digital platform that empowers every TECHNOGYM MYRUN, TECHNOGYM ELLIPTICAL & TECHNOGYM CYCLE. With endless training possibilities, it inspires you to embrace exercise and make it part of your daily ritual to achieve results.
To enhance your training experience, in addition to your cardio workouts, you have access to an extensive library of workout options. This library offers categories such as Strength, HIIT, Yoga, Pilates, Boxing, and more, providing a diverse range of training experiences. It also includes various Technogym products and tools that you can incorporate into your weekly cardio routine such as Unica, Kinesis, Technogym Bench, Dumbbells, and Kettlebells.
Thanks to Technogym App for Apple Watch you can now connect your Apple Watch to the Technogym Live App for iPad and share your heart rate in real time. Plus, your workout will sync directly with Apple Health and Fitness. You can download it searching ‘Technogym App’ on the App Store or Apple Watch App Store.
LET TECHNOGYM LIVE GUIDE YOU, REGARDLESS OF WHAT YOUR GOAL OR FITNESS LEVEL IS.
• Sessions (only available for Technogym Plus subscribers, library regularly updated) – Trainer led on-demand classes grouped into different goals with a variety of episodes. Keep yourself motivated and try to complete every stream to reach your goals.
• Outdoors – Let natural and urban landscapes captivate you while you’re working out. Be amazed by where your travels around the world can take you.
• Routines - Each Routine contains different movements and exercises, whose intensity is automatically set up by the equipment. You will receive step-by-step guidance by on-screen video loops.
• Custom – Maintain the focus on your training and complete profile-based exercises tailored to your characteristics. Train by intervals, set time or distance goals following your heart rate after pairing your Bluetooth HR monitoring device (also compatible with Apple Watch). Only on MyRun, it is also possible to completely design your personalized speed/inclination profile with the new Custom Profile Builder.
• Technogym Playlists, Spotify and Apple Music integration – Boost your workout with the exclusive embedded playlists for every genre or control your Spotify and Apple Music apps directly from Technogym Live App.
• Running Biofeedback (only on MyRun) – Get the right Cadence and Step Length during Custom exercises to improve your running style and efficiency. The algorithm compares data from individuals and gives standard ranges that you can follow to learn how to find the “sweet spot”.
• Activities repeat (only on MyRun) – Relive your outdoor tracked workouts to challenge yourself and improve your performance letting MyRun adjust both speed and inclination. Connect a Strava or Garmin account to Technogym Live to sync and replay all your runs, walks or trails.
All of this tailor made and goal-oriented contents, perfectly synched to TECHNOGYM scientific proven quality equipment, will guide you toward data-driven fitness and health progressions and results.
IMPORTANT: TO LET CUSTOMERS FULLY UNDERSTAND AND LOVE TECHNOGYM LIVE CONTENTS, ALL USERS WILL HAVE THE CHANCE TO ENJOY ONE MONTH OF TECHNOGYM PLUS SUBSCRIPTION TRIAL.
Read more: support.technogym.com
Read our full Terms of use at https://cdnmedia.mywellness.com/privacy/en/conditions.html and our Privacy Policy at https://cdnmedia.mywellness.com/privacy/en/privacy.html

bluejetty:00183081:ios.name: Bomber Friends!
bluejetty:00183081:ios.summary:
Place a bomb and hide behind a corner. BOOM! Did you blast the opponent or did they escape? Try again! Collect powerups from the map to get more powerful bombs! Watch out for evil curses!
You can enjoy Bomber Friends in both online Multipl
bluejetty:00183081:ios.description:
Place a bomb and hide behind a corner. BOOM! Did you blast the opponent or did they escape? Try again! Collect powerups from the map to get more powerful bombs! Watch out for evil curses!
You can enjoy Bomber Friends in both online Multiplayer and Single Player modes. Which Bomber mode do you like more?
Single Player features:
- Orcs have attacked the Bomber Village and you need to guide our Bomber Hero through 6 different worlds full of devious monsters and mind boggling puzzles to save all his Bomber Friends!
- Single Player Campaign mode with over 300 levels!
- Five special Quest modes with more challenging levels and epic Boss Fights!
- Dungeon run modes for those who like to challenge their Bomber Skills even more!
- Daily Bounty hunts! Can you defeat all of the villains hiding in the Bomber World?
Multiplayer features:
- Bomb your opponents and be the last one standing to win the match!
- Compete in the online arenas and gain medals by winning. Climb up arena by arena until you reach the Leagues! That’s where the highly skilled players match against each other in epic battles!
- Collect your own battle deck! Different cards give you different special bombs with (for example) bigger blast zones or shorter fuses, you can even call for an Air Strike or launch a Nuke!
- Face three opponents in the Arena free-for-all match. You can also play Duels one on one!
- Try out the immensely hectic King of the Hill where your team needs to capture the flag before the other team does!- 
- VS Friends Online Multiplayer for 2-8 players! Challenge your friends or play against random opponents. Play classic, team or reversi matches. Create a game room with your own settings and enable Ghost Mode to haunt other players as a ghost!
- Two weekly events with exciting gimmicks, fascinating maps and awesome rewards! This is how you gain gold coins, gems, cards and new accessories for your Bomber!
Customize your Bomber!
- Customize your character with cool hats, suits, accessories and bombs
- Use taunts and greetings in the matches
- Choose a special gravestone and go out in style!
- Send customize items as gifts to other players. Make a Wish list to let your friends know which items you want to get!
- Take part in the Fashion Show and collect Fashion tokens. Use the tokens to get new clothes and skins. Even Legendary items!
Monthly updates!
- New Season starts on the first Tuesday of every month
- Each Season has a Theme with Seasonal Rewards. Play daily to collect them all! More rewards with Bomber Battle Pass!
- Weekly events related to the Season theme!
- New Outfit Bundles available every week of the Season! 
- Seasonal leaderboards for best players and best clans!
And there’s more!
- Classic Bomber style gameplay, with controls polished for touchscreen!
- Complete Daily Tasks to get rewards
- Put your luck to the test and spin Bomber Wheel
- Join a Clan or create your own. Invite other players to join your clan. Work together to get a weekly Clan Chest.
- Universal game controller support.
- Introducing Bomber Journal in 2024
Get Bomber Friends now and join the fun online multiplayer game! Have a blast!

FNB Pasco Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FNB Pasco Mobile:
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Turn off your debit card if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FNB Pasco Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a FNB Pasco digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

If you wish to relax after a long day at work or a long commute, playing with bouncy balls is the most relaxing thing you can do! - A bottle can only contain a certain amount of balls. When it’s full you cannot pour more balls into it.
- No timer, no stress, take your time.

- Exercise your brain and stimulate your cognitive abilities with this challenging and addictive free puzzle game.
- Immerse yourself into beautiful graphics and a world full of colors

- Experience a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment as you successfully sort each level and witness the harmony of colors.

bluejetty:00069648:ios.summary: Sondakika, Türkiye ve Dünya’daki en önemli haberleri telefonunuzda hızlıca takip etmenizi sağlayan bir haber uygulamasıdır. Son dakika haber uygulaması siyaset, politika, magazin, spor, kadın, ekonomi, finans, futbol, 3. sayfa ve başka birç
bluejetty:00069648:ios.description:
Sondakika, Türkiye ve Dünya’daki en önemli haberleri telefonunuzda hızlıca takip etmenizi sağlayan bir haber uygulamasıdır. Son dakika haber uygulaması siyaset, politika, magazin, spor, kadın, ekonomi, finans, futbol, 3. sayfa ve başka birçok kategorideki en önemli haber içeriklerini bir araya getiren benzersiz bir uygulamadır. Son dakika uygulamasını hürriyet, milliyet, haber7, mynet veya habertürk gibi diğer haber uygulamalarından ayıran en önemli özelliği kolay ve anlaşılır bir yapıya sahip olması; aynı zamanda haberleri geldikleri saate göre listelemesidir. Böylece haberler arasında gezinirken en yeni gelen haberi en üstte görürsünüz. Bu da benzersiz bir haber deneyimi yaşatır.
Sondakika haber uygulaması ile;
* Zengin içerikteki haberleri geliş saatlerine göre takip edersiniz.
* 2 farklı liste tasarımından size en kolay gelen görünümü seçip kullanırsınız.
* Haberlerin detaylarını öğrenirsiniz.
* Bir haberden sonraki habere veya önceki habere sağ-sol kaydırma yaparak kolayca geçersiniz.
* İlginizi çeken haberi istediğiniz şekilde paylaşırsınız.
* Son dakika haber bildirimleri ile güncel gelişmeleri en hızlı siz öğrenirsiniz.
* Bildirim ayarlarından sadece istediğiniz kategoride bildirim almayı isteyebilirsiniz. Böylece ilgiliniz çekmeyecek kategorilerdeki haberler için rahatsız edilmezsiniz.
* Sondakika haber widget ile uygulamayı açmadan son gelişmeleri görürsünüz.
Sondakika uygulaması Apple Watch ile uyumludur ve Apple Watch’tan haber ve bildirimleri hızlıca almanızı sağlar.
Sondakika uygulamasını bedava indirebilirsiniz. Hiçbir özellik için ekstra para ödemek zorunda değilsiniz. Sondakika haber programı tamamen bedavadır.
Sondakika uygulaması 7 gün 24 saat kesintisiz haber yayını yapar. Her türlü öneri ve şikayetleriniz için bize ulaşabilirsiniz: destek@brokoli.com.tr

bluejetty:00121755:ios.description:
Naxos Music Library (NML) offers over 2.73 million tracks of fine classical music recordings from more than a thousand labels with their latest releases. What sets NML apart from other streaming platforms comes down to metadata. Each piece of music comes with a rich set of information, from composers’ biographies to programme notes, instrumentation to publisher’s details, all authored by qualified musicologists. Individual subscribers and authorised users of institution subscribers can create their own playlists on top of having access to playlists created by their teachers and professors for their assignments.
NML is more than just a huge classical music audio library available for streaming. The Resources section inside the library offers many valuable add-ons and study tools available through accessing the web version.
Please send comments to customer.service@naxos.com to help us further improve our app.

bluejetty:00073402:ios.description:
HOME PLANNER: THE ULTIMATE HOUSE DESIGN AND RENOVATION APP
Bring your dream space to life with Home Planner, the ultimate app for design and renovation enthusiasts. Featuring advanced tools like 3D modeling with home design AI, a built-in 3D scanner, and precise measure functionality, this house design app is perfect for both professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Whether you’re reimagining a single room or planning a complete overhaul, Home Planner offers everything you need to design, customize, and visualize your space effortlessly.
Transform Your Vision with Home Design AI and 3D Modeling
Craft stunning designs using Home Planner’s intuitive 3D modeling tools. Create detailed layouts in both 2D and 3D, allowing you to visualize every aspect of your project. The app’s advanced 3D modeling capabilities and top-notch home design AI enable you to experiment with different furniture arrangements and decor styles. Let your vision come to life with accuracy and ease.
Scan Your Space with the 3D Scanner
Home Planner’s built-in 3D scanner lets you capture your space in seconds. By scanning any room, you can instantly generate accurate dimensions and layouts. The 3D scanner ensures every detail of your space is accounted for, eliminating guesswork and saving you time. 
Measure with Unmatched Precision

bluejetty:00149350:ios.description:
Spa-quality wellness and personal care services delivered to you, on your schedule –– at home, at the office, or on the go.
Soothe is the largest and most trusted on-demand wellness platform in the world. The Soothe app connects you with top wellness professionals in your area, any day of the week. Providers on the Soothe platform are licensed, certified, and highly-skilled massage therapists, estheticians, and cosmetologists who can offer:
• Relaxing Swedish or Deep Tissue massage
• Recovery sports massage or Percussive Therapy
• Prenatal massage to promote wellness during pregnancy
• Skin care, including facials to help with hydration, aging, stress and acne
• Haircuts & styling
• Beauty services, including spray tanning...and more
ON YOUR SCHEDULE
Simply choose the type of service you want, the time and place you want the specialist to arrive, and Soothe’s platform will match you with the highest-rated provider in your area who meets your criteria. Whether you’re looking for a facial to look more youthful or a 5-star full-body massage, Soothe has you covered from head to toe!
PERSONALIZED ENHANCEMENTS USING INDUSTRY-LEADING PRODUCTS
Providers on the Soothe network can personalize your experience to ensure you’re getting the best treatment. Having neck strain due to too much time in front of the computer? Would you like to add hot stones to your massage? We’ve got you covered.
And Soothe has partnered with industry leaders in the wellness and self-care space, including companies like Therabody, Hydropeptide, PCA, Skin Care Authority, and Dermologica to ensure you’re getting the best products that match your specific needs.
A NETWORK OF PROFESSIONALS YOU CAN TRUST
With its award-winning Trust & Safety team, Soothe only accepts the most experienced, skilled, and background-checked wellness providers onto its platform. All providers in the Soothe network are licensed/certified and insured, and are continuously monitored to ensure the highest quality standards are met. They’ve had extensive experience and often possess multiple, specialized certifications.
GET EVEN MORE WITH AN OPTIONAL MEMBERSHIP
Soothe’s optional membership plan, Soothe Plus, allows you to book unlimited discounted services to help you make wellness part of a healthy lifestyle. Various plans and packages are available to meet your needs. Download the app for more details.
ADDITIONAL SOOTHE FEATURES & BENEFITS
• Book a Soothe spa party for a bridal shower or group pop-up event
• Purchase gift cards to say thank you to friends, family, or colleagues
• Refer friends to Soothe and earn free services

bluejetty:00035275:ios.summary:
Embark on a New Fishing Game Adventure!
Spin the wheel of fortune to get coins and unlock magical sea creatures! Win rewards, catch fish, raid, loot treasure, and attack your friends while you restore and build your island in this exciting
bluejetty:00035275:ios.description:
Embark on a New Fishing Game Adventure!
Spin the wheel of fortune to get coins and unlock magical sea creatures! Win rewards, catch fish, raid, loot treasure, and attack your friends while you restore and build your island in this exciting fishing game. Enjoy this arcade fishing game with the Captain and his Pingo crew.
Looking for multiplayer fun? In Fish of Fortune, you can play solo or with friends, raiding and attacking their islands as you compete for fishing game glory and become the ultimate fishing master. Take a classic fishing game, give it a coin game twist, and add fun multiplayer mechanics. Raid your friends and gather energy to build your dream island!
Not Your Average Fishing Game
Fish of Fortune is a unique fishing game mixed with a thrilling island adventure. Raid friends, loot treasure, collect coins, and spin the wheel to unlock special rewards in this one-of-a-kind fishing experience.
Spin the Wheel of Fortune to Earn Loot!
Spin the wheel to reveal your fortune! Will you land on attack time, loot, shields, raid, puzzle, or coins? The possibilities are endless! Earn coins to upgrade and build your island and advance through fish levels in this thrilling fishing game. Earn shields to protect your island from other players trying to attack. Become the fishing coin master with the strongest island and the most loot in this epic adventure!
Earn Free Coins in Your Fishing Game!
Collect coins by spinning the wheel and use them to restore, decorate, and build islands. If you’re feeling lazy—like a fish out of water—you can use the autospin mode to collect coins while you sit back and relax in your fishing world. Attack and raid islands to steal loot and become the wealthiest fisherman in the game!
Let the Fishing Game Raid Games Commence!
Spinning the wheel isn’t the only way to win! Attack friends, raid them, and loot their islands to steal treasures and coins in this competitive fishing game. Become the coin champion of this exciting multiplayer adventure!
Play with Friends in This Epic Fishing Game!
Join the best fishing Captain, cute Pingos, and big fish in this fun coin game! Spin the wheel to earn coins, raid your friends’ islands, and build your own to be the strongest of all. Join our growing Fortune Fishers community on Facebook to play together, meet new friends, and earn big rewards in this cool fishing game!
Collect All the Fish Cards in This Fishing Game!
It’s not just about loot—it’s also about collecting treasures! Spin the wheel to gather and upgrade dozens of fish cards featuring characters from Fish of Fortune in this incredible fishing game.
Follow Fish of Fortune on Facebook for exclusive offers and bonuses in this fantastic fishing game!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FishOfFortune
Something fishy in the air? Having problems?
Please contact us in the game by clicking on the menu > Settings > Support or email us at support@whalo.com

bluejetty:00062244:ios.description:
From the award-winning creators of Studycat for Schools, comes Learn English! The #1 way for kids to learn English!
From preschool and beyond, Learn English by Studycat inspires children's innate love of learning with interactive games and activities.
Our bite-sized lessons will keep your child motivated while they discover a new language and build bilingual skills for a lifetime!
WHY STUDYCAT?
• Learn English, in English. All our activities focus on virtual language immersion, which means your child will only be hearing English. This might be confusing at first, but trust us, it's the best way to learn.
• Everyday Language. Our lessons teach words and expressions that kids can apply in their everyday lives, so they can get a head start developing their bilingual abilities.
• Get Talking Fast. With our interactive speaking challenges, kids will be encouraged to speak entire words and phrases on their own! The earlier kids start their language-learning journey, the more likely they are to reach proficiency quickly.
• Vocal Variety. Our characters' voices use different tones, expressions, and accents so that kids can pick up on the subtleties of pronunciation from different speakers.
• Designed by Experts. All our activities are designed by language and early-education experts. Thoughtfully developed lessons will build your child's confidence with every step.
• Learner Profiles. Create up to four personalized profiles for different family members, allowing tailored learning paths and individual progress tracking.
• Safe for Kids & Ad-Free. Parents can rest easy knowing that there are no pesky ads to distract children from their learning. All content is appropriate for ages 3 and up.
• Offline Learning. On a plane, at a restaurant, or in a park? No problem! Learn English by Studycat is available for both online and offline use.
WHAT ARE PARENTS SAYING?
“As a parent trying to raise bilingual children at home, Studycat is a helpful app to start them off and create excitement about the language.” — Fluent in 3 Months
“Everything has been thought out carefully and the games and activities are really engaging.” — Bilingual Kidspot
“The concept is so simple but extremely effective. I even found myself learning at the same time.” — Bump, Baby & You
--
If you like Learn English by Studycat, try it out for 7 days free! Empower your child to learn like never before, and get extras like printable worksheets and animated stories.
If you choose to subscribe, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://studycat.com/about/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://studycat.com/about/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00041284:ios.description:
With the Ding app, you can top-up any number, anywhere, easily. As the world’s leading mobile recharge service, we’ll deliver your top in 3 seconds. We love keeping you and your loved ones connected. We’ve also got some of your favourite gift cards here, for you to choose. Whether it’s for yourself, or you want to gift that special someone, with the gift of choice. We’ve got it all for you, right here.
It's the little things that really matter. Whether it's a quick ""Hello"", or a video call to wish them a Happy Birthday, every moment counts. Since 2006, we've been helping people send top-ups safely and securely and we've sent over 500 million top-ups in more than 150 countries. 
Whether you call it top-up, recharge, refill, airtime, load, credit, or something else, you can send it on the Ding app. Our app is available in 7 supported languages. You can download and use the Ding recharge app in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German, or Russian.
Recharge 150+ countries
Add credit to your own phone or send it to your friend's and family's prepaid phones around the world. You can send airtime recharge to countries including Cuba, Jamaica, Philippines, Haiti, India, Mexico, Afghanistan, Ghana, Saudi Arabia, Dominican Republic, USA, Nepal and more.
The #1 international mobile top-up app
- The fastest way to send top-up: delivered in 3 seconds
- 24/7 multilingual customer support
- 100% secure online transactions processed by our dedicated fraud team
- Exclusive Ding discounts and promotions
- Over 1 million downloads
How to send top-up
 Download the Ding app and follow three easy steps to recharge your own phone or send mobile phone credit to a loved one anywhere in the world
1. Choose an amount of top-up to send 
2. Enter the number you want to recharge
3. Add your details & confirm
We'll do the rest; it really is that simple. In 3 seconds, the top-up will be delivered
Get the following and more with the Ding app:
Value for money
Choose from our range of data plans and bundles available from over 850 operators, to find what suits you best. You’ll also access exclusive in-app promotions and discounts. 
Already have an account?
If you already have a Ding account, login with your existing account and all your details and transaction history will follow you over. Easily send top-up, set auto top-up, or request top-up in app. If you haven't got your Ding account set up yet, don't worry it's just as simple.
Payment Methods
We accept all major payment methods, such as Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and more. Your details are protected with Trustwave 128-bit SSL encryption and monitored by our internal fraud team.
Auto top-up
To avoid you or a loved one running out of credit, our auto top-up feature helps you top-up right when you need to. You can choose to schedule auto top-up every 7, 14, 28, or 30 days. any discounts available, are automatically applied to auto top-ups. 
More than 600 mobile networks
We work with mobile carriers around the world to deliver your international mobile recharge in seconds. Choose from networks such as: Cubacel, Digicel, Nauta, Claro, Flow/Lime, Smart, Globe, Lycamobile, MTN, Movistar, Ooredoo, Orange, Airtel, Tigo, Virgin Mobile, Vodafone, Zain, AT&T, Telcel and many more.
So why wait any longer? Get the Ding app now for free and send a little joy so they know you're thinking of them."

bluejetty:00031144:android.summary: Unleash a new era of note-taking — crafted for Android tablets and stylus users. Whether you’re a student, educator, designer, or professional, this app blends the freedom of handwriting with powerful tools for organizing, annotating, and s
bluejetty:00031144:android.description:
Unleash a new era of note-taking — crafted for Android tablets and stylus users. Whether you’re a student, educator, designer, or professional, this app blends the freedom of handwriting with powerful tools for organizing, annotating, and syncing your ideas.
🖊️ Natural and Precise Handwriting
Experience ultra-low latency handwriting with pressure-sensitive brushes that respond just like pen on paper. Perfect for sketching, note-taking, or creating mind maps. Thousands of users call it one of the best handwriting experiences on Android.
🧠 Organize Your Thoughts, Your Way
Custom Canvas Options: Choose classic paper sizes or expand ideas freely on an infinite canvas — great for brainstorming and visual thinking.
Interactive Linking: Add clickable links between pages to build study guides, planners, or a personal knowledge base.
Notebook System: Create, sort, and search notebooks for fast access to all your materials.
📄 Import & Annotate Documents
Import and mark up documents in common formats — such as PDFs, images, Word or PowerPoint files. Highlight key points, add comments, draw diagrams, and even merge or split files for custom workflows.
🎨 Layer Support & Creative Tools
Use layers to separate handwriting, shapes, and highlights. Redesign without erasing. Create cleaner, more flexible content with ruler-guided pens and shape tools — ideal for diagrams, architecture, and study illustrations.
🔊 Audio Recording + Note Sync
Record meetings or lectures while taking notes
Tap handwriting to jump to specific moments in the recording
Playback tools let you adjust speed, skip silence, or loop key sections for study and review
🤖 AI-Powered Features (available in select regions)
Summarize Notes: Let AI extract the main ideas from your writing
Auto Outlines: Turn notes into structured outlines instantly
OCR + Translation: Convert handwriting or images into editable text, with built-in language translation
🎨 A Workspace That’s Yours
Personalize your workspace with custom paper templates, fonts, colors, grids, and stickers. Designed for those who value flexibility and expression.
📐 Precision Graphics Tools
Draw diagrams and illustrations with ruler-guided pens and shape tools — ideal for students, architects, or designers.
☁️ Cloud Sync
Sync your notes across devices using Google Drive or OneDrive. Your notebooks are always backed up and accessible — anytime, anywhere.
🚀 Don’t just take notes. Create, explore, and think freely with powerful tools designed for your Android tablet and stylus.
Download Notein today and bring your ideas to life.
