bluejetty:00145118:ios.name: SmartRow
bluejetty:00145118:ios.summary:
UNLOCK THE FULL POTENTIAL OF YOUR ROWING MACHINE
The SmartRow app works with SmartRow power meters to turn your rowing machine into a complete performance training system. Connect a SmartRow Power Handle or a SmartRow Power Pulley and upgra
bluejetty:00145118:ios.description:
UNLOCK THE FULL POTENTIAL OF YOUR ROWING MACHINE
The SmartRow app works with SmartRow power meters to turn your rowing machine into a complete performance training system. Connect a SmartRow Power Handle or a SmartRow Power Pulley and upgrade your existing rower with real power measurement, advanced stroke analysis, structured workouts, video workouts, challenges and long-term progress tracking.
A normal rowing app can only analyse the data it receives. SmartRow adds the missing measurement technology. By measuring real rowing power instead of estimates, every workout becomes more motivating, more measurable and easier to improve.
TRAIN WITH MORE MOTIVATION
When progress becomes visible, training becomes more rewarding. SmartRow helps you set goals, compare sessions, race against yourself or others, join challenges and track your improvements over time.
Power, pace, stroke rate, personal records and workout history give every session a clear purpose. Instead of simply finishing a workout, you can see exactly how your rowing is developing.
MASTER YOUR TECHNIQUE WITH THE FORCE CURVE
Power is only part of the story. How you produce that power determines your efficiency, consistency and progress.
The SmartRow Force Curve visualizes the force you apply throughout every stroke, helping you spot changes in timing, posture, power build-up and stroke consistency.
Use it to identify technical weaknesses, build a smoother stroke and recognize when fatigue starts to affect your technique. By making these changes visible, the Force Curve helps you row with more control and reduce unnecessary strain on your body.
COMPATIBLE WITH MORE THAN 60 ROWING MACHINE BRANDS
SmartRow power meters are compatible with more than 60 rowing machine brands, including Concept2, WaterRower, RP3, MERACH, FluidRower, Tunturi, First Degree Fitness, Rogue, Assault Fitness and many more.
Compatibility depends on the rowing machine brand, model and the SmartRow product used. Visit smartrow.fit for the complete and always up-to-date compatibility list.
WORKOUTS, VIDEO AND RACING
The SmartRow app includes more than 50 structured workouts, guided video workouts, live and on-demand rowing, challenges, rankings, races against yourself and other SmartRow users, workout history and personal records.
Whether you train for fitness, performance or better technique, SmartRow gives you the tools to stay motivated and improve every stroke.
YOUR DATA. YOUR PROGRESS.
With SmartRow, your training data stays available to you. Every workout can be reviewed in detail, from the complete session summary down to individual stroke data.
In the SmartRow Portal, you can download and analyse your rowing stroke by stroke, compare sessions over time and see how your power, consistency and technique develop across weeks, months and years.
CONNECT AND CONTROL
Share your workouts with Apple Health and Strava.
The SmartRow Power Handle includes Dual Bluetooth, allowing you to use the SmartRow app while connecting to EXR, MyWoosh, Kinomap, Peloton, Zwift, ErgZone and many more at the same time. It also includes four integrated buttons for controlling compatible apps, connected devices and multimedia during your workout.
EASY TO INSTALL. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
SmartRow power meters are designed for plug-and-play installation and can be ready within minutes. Both the SmartRow Power Handle and SmartRow Power Pulley provide up to 100 hours of training on two AA batteries.
There are no subscriptions and no hidden monthly costs. Install your SmartRow power meter, download the free SmartRow app and start training with real power.

Deepcheck is the all-in-one tool to uncover everything about any topic, person, company, or entity with an online presence. From social profiles and photos to press articles, bios, apps, interests, and more—Deepcheck gives you the full picture, instantly.
Whether you're meeting someone new, researching a brand, preparing for a job interview, or just curious—Deepcheck reveals everything the internet knows.

• People: Social profiles, education, jobs, photos, dating profiles
• Companies: Founders, team bios, news, reviews, media mentions
• Brands & Influencers: Social reach, collaborations, interests
• Events, Startups, Public Figures, Blogs—anything online
• Public articles, press releases, blog posts

Our proprietary DeepSearch engine scans the web in real-time to uncover public information from across social networks, news outlets, blogs, databases, forums, and more—all in one search.

• Research a company before applying or investing
• Investigate an influencer or brand before collaborating
• See your own online footprint
• Track mentions of a project, startup, or event
• Do due diligence on partners, clients, or suppliers
Why Deepcheck?
• Ultra-fast results
• Scans people, businesses, and brands
• Public, verifiable sources only
• Clean and intuitive design
• No sign-up required
• Safe, private, and secure

Deepcheck runs a full scan using Deepsearch engine across the internet

bluejetty:00131833:ios.name: My City: Paris Family Trip
bluejetty:00131833:ios.summary:
Alright, Boys & girls, pack your backpacks; your Paris exciting adventure is about to start. My City: Paris is a fun game for kids to create their own stories as they explore the city of light (Paris). 
From a visit to Eiffel Tower & Parc
bluejetty:00131833:ios.description:
Alright, Boys & girls, pack your backpacks; your Paris exciting adventure is about to start. My City: Paris is a fun game for kids to create their own stories as they explore the city of light (Paris). 
From a visit to Eiffel Tower & Parc Monceau to enjoying the Louver museum's beauty or shopping for fashion and beautiful clothes at the Champs-Élysées.
 There are many fun and exciting places to visit and have fun playing with, as this game comes with lots of new cute clothing & fun accessories &, of course, new characters you can move between all of My City games!
My City: Paris games features:
 Fun Locations: We have created many exciting new locations for kids to play and explore: Eiffel tower, Moulin rouge, Museum, Parc Monceau, Louvre Museum, Cafes, and discover why the famous painting and treasures are missing.
New Characters: We have lots of new characters you are going to LOVE! Ever wanted to dance with Moulin Rouge dancers? It is your chance to do so with My City: Paris.
Arch de Trimophe: visit the beautiful Arch and enjoy the dance area on the French cafe in the park.
Eiffel Tower: hang out with your family, eat some food, bake pizza and visit cafe or play with your mini-games and enjoy the view of the tower.
Moulin Rouge: Dance your way to the magnificent moulin rouge show. make up and discover treasures in this area.
Park Monceau: Visit the park. play with your family and friends and enjoy the beautiful attractions in the area.
Louvre Museum: Visit the paining on the museam and discover other treasures. Find out the mystery on why some of the treasures in the museum are missing.
Welcome to My City Paris
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00092152:ios.description:
Let CoAd help you save time while making the most of your HSA, HRA, and FSA health benefit accounts by quickly checking your balances and details. Our secure app makes managing your health benefits easy through real-time access and intuitive navigation to all your important account information on the go! Powerful features of the app include:
Easy, Convenient & Secure
• Simply login to the intuitive app using your same health benefits website username and password (or follow alternative instructions if provided) 
• No sensitive account information is ever stored on your mobile device
• Use Touch ID or Face ID to quickly log in to the mobile app
Connects You with the Details 
• Quickly check available balances 24/7 
• View charts summarizing account(s) 
• View claims requiring receipts
• Click to call or email Customer Service
• View your statements and notifications
• Scan product barcodes to determine their eligibility 
Provides Additional Time-Saving Options (if supported or applicable to your account(s)) 
• File a claim towards your FSA and HRA
• Take or upload a picture of a receipt and submit for a new or existing claim
• View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
• Pay bills from any account and add a payee
• Manage your expenses by entering medical expense information and supporting documentation
• View and Manage your HSA investments
• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX Health®

bluejetty:00060967:ios.description:
"Call & Voice Recorder App" lets you record your iPhones incoming and outgoing phone calls and voice.
This version will give you a fully functional trial to record and play back as many call as you'd like. You will not be charged during your trial and only will be charged at the end of your trial. 
SUBSCRIBE TO UNLOCK TONS OF FEATURES
√ Record your incoming calls 
√ Record your outgoing calls 
√ No limit on how long you can record a call for 
√ No limit on how many recordings you make 
√ Unlimited number of recordings
√ Access to call recording laws 
√ Beautiful easy to use interface 
√ Push notifications take you to the recording
√ New features added all the time 
√ One low subscription rate
√ Screen recorder
NOTE: "Call & Voice Recorder App" requires your carrier supports 3-way calling. SimpleTalk and H2o Wireless do NOT offer this in the US.
Information about subscription:
- Please note that "Call & Voice Recorder App" cannot record new calls without active subscription
- Price is based on the U.S. Dollar and price may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice.
- If the package has a trial period, then subscription starts after N days (the exact number will be indicated in the purchase description) of a free trial and will automatically renew each period (month or week) , if not, the payment will be paid immediately.
- Prices for subscriptions depends on which package you choose and will be seen in payment screen.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Pages:
- Privacy policy: http://callrecorderpro.app/privacy_policy?color=black
- Term of use: http://callrecorderpro.app/terms?color=black
- About: http://callrecorderpro.app/about?color=black
Support:
You can write about anything to info@callrecorderpro.app

bluejetty:00040465:ios.description:
In Bling’s newest Bitcoin-themed puzzle game, you’ll assist Bling’s Crumpty Dumpty as he sits on a wall of crypto blocks and awaits your help in coming up with an antidote for Leprechaunis Bitcoinitis! Bitcoin Blocks takes your classic fables and flips them on their head. 
This Bitcoin-themed adventure is a modern twist on the classic fable which answers the question ”What if Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall but didn’t have a great fall?” In our version Crumpty Dumpty sits on the wall but doesn’t fall. 
We begin as Leprechaunis Bitcoinitis is running rampant in the Kingdom of Crypto. The highly contagious disorder is infecting blockchain, and it is your prerogative to save the cryptoverse! As the protagonist our Bitcoin-shaped hero Crumpty, sits on the wall and guards the Kingdom of Crypto from having a great blockchain fall. 
Using his magical Bitcoin Blocks, he is able to keep Leprechaunis Bitcoinitis out of Crypto Kingdom. However, his blocks only carry a certain amount of BTC energy and in order to keep the forcefield strong, you must combine like-colored magical blocks in order to create a stronger Bitronus. 
In this post-apocalyptic crypto-themed combination sorting game, you’ll combine multi-colored bitcoin blocks creating powerful combinations to help clear up the blockchain. Crumpty Dumpty will help guide you through endless amounts of levels where using your color-matching skills you’ll create chain-clearing combination of Bitcoin Blocks. 
Help Crumpty Dumpty clear the blockchain, secure the bag, and earn Bling Points! 
Features: 
Hundreds of Levels 
Hilarious Puzzles 
Fables and Fairytales 
Magical Bitcoin Blocks 
Bitcoin Themed

• View Recent Transactions

● 이런 분들에게 추천해요!
º 온라인 쇼핑몰 3개 이상 이용 중.
º 어디서 샀는지 가끔 헷갈림.
º 택배가 가까워질수록 설레임.
[주요기능]
1) 대시보드 : 쇼핑정보, 배송정보, 쇼핑몰 주문 연동 등 주요한 기능들이 모여있어요.
2) 매일혜택 : 쇼핑몰 연결하고 택배만 받아도 매일 쏟아지는 포인트 혜택! 제휴몰 쇼핑과 출석체크로 더 크게 모아보세요.
3) 다이어리 : 쇼핑몰을 연결하면 자동으로 채워지는 쇼핑일기장!(직접 입력도 가능!)
4) 배송목록 : 국내 최다 택배사 연동으로 어떤 택배사든 놓치지 않고 배송상태를 알림받아요.
5) AI카테고리 : 쇼핑몰을 연결하면 스마트택배 AI가 상품 데이터를 분석해 카테고리를 자동 분류해요.
6) 택배예약 : 한진택배와 CU편의점 택배 예약 을 할수 있어요.
[친절한 고객센터]
 1) 이메일 : help@blumn.ai
[앱 접근 권한 안내]
 정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률 제 22조의2에 따라 ‘앱 접근 권한’ 에 대한 동의를 받고 있으며 스마트택배 앱에서 요청하는 권한 중 선택적 접근권한은 동의하지 않아도 서비스 이용이 가능합니다.
  ● 선택적 접근 권한
  1) 카메라 : 운송장 바코드 스캔 시 사진 촬영기능을 이용하기 위해 사용하는 권한입니다.
  2) 사진 : 운송장 바코드 스캔, 쇼핑 정보 입력, 이메일 문의 시 사진 첨부기능을 이용하기 위해 사용되는 권한입니다.

bluejetty:00131203:ios.name: brightwheel: Child Care App
bluejetty:00131203:ios.summary:
Brightwheel is an all-in-one childcare management software that saves time and simplifies operations for early education providers. 
From billing and parent communication to curriculum and admissions, it combines everything you need in one
bluejetty:00131203:ios.description:
Brightwheel is an all-in-one childcare management software that saves time and simplifies operations for early education providers. 
From billing and parent communication to curriculum and admissions, it combines everything you need in one easy-to-use platform. 
Trusted by millions of educators and families and backed by a dedicated support team, brightwheel strengthens family connections and ensures seamless operations with reliable performance and robust security. 
With brightwheel, you’ll spend less time on admin, more time with children.
Features include:
• All-in-one platform: Brightwheel combines billing, attendance, family communication, lesson planning, and reporting in one easy-to-use platform.
• User-friendly design: An intuitive interface that is quick to set up and easy for staff and families to use.
• Fast, quality support: An industry-leading, dedicated support team at your fingertips with 24/7 access to chatbot, tutorials, webinars, and community.
• Secure and reliable: Advanced security features like two-factor authentication and compliance with the highest data protection standards. With 99% uptime, the app is available virtually all the time.
• Billing and finances: Automated billing and payments for tuition and fees, customizable billing reports, and expense tracking.
• Family communication: Connect with families in real-time and centralize messaging, newsletters, and alerts.
• Photo and video sharing: Snap photos, record videos, and tag students with one click. 
• Daily reports: Log naps, meals, bathroom, and other activities. Families get a personalized feed and daily summary. 
• Calendar: Share events, holidays, and important dates with both families and staff.
• Lesson plans: Add, customize, and share your lesson plans with teachers. Upgrade to Experience Curriculum to enhance program quality with digital lessons and hands-on learning materials. 
• Assessment and observations: Make note of progress, achievements, and activities with pre-loaded state standards and a DRDP tool. Share with families or privately amongst teachers.
• Admissions and enrollment: Build custom admission packets, manage your waitlist, and make it easy for prospective families to apply online.
• Attendance: Easily track student and staff attendance via quick scan or a code. Stay in compliance with room ratio and capacity tools. 
• Reporting: Detailed reports of every brightwheel feature for billing and licensing requirements.
• Real-time syncing: Brightwheel stays up to date across all devices, including web and mobile. 
• Affordable: Both free and premium plans available to fit your needs.
And... much more coming! Brightwheel is the #1 rated childcare management software, leading the industry through continuous innovation, frequent enhancements, and new features driven by valuable customer feedback.

bluejetty:00171274:ios.name: ESET VPN
bluejetty:00171274:ios.summary:
ESET VPN requires a paid ESET subscription
ESET VPN is an easy-to-use app that allows you to establish a secure connection when using public and private networks. Simply connect to a location in the VPN app and your device will be assigned
bluejetty:00171274:ios.description:
ESET VPN requires a paid ESET subscription
ESET VPN is an easy-to-use app that allows you to establish a secure connection when using public and private networks. Simply connect to a location in the VPN app and your device will be assigned a new IP address. Your online traffic is then secured and encrypted in real time, preventing unwanted tracking and data theft and allowing you to stay safe with an anonymous IP address.
HOW TO ACTIVATE:
1. Purchase an ESET HOME Security Premium, ESET HOME Security Ultimate, or ESET Small Business Security subscription.
2. Create or log in to your ESET HOME account. Your subscription will be automatically added to your account.
3. In ESET HOME, start the "Add protection" process and choose whether to activate VPN for yourself or someone else.
4. If you're activating VPN for yourself, you'll be directed to a download page with setup instructions and your activation code. If you're setting it up for someone else, they'll receive an email with a link to a download page that also includes their activation code.
WHY CHOOSE ESET VPN?
• Rely on the powerful encryption of your online traffic
Stay safe from the pitfalls of online space. ESET VPN keeps your connection private and your online traffic encrypted. We use an AES-256 cipher with an SHA-512 algorithm for authentication and a 4096-bit RSA key.
• Say goodbye to bandwidth restrictions
Enjoy unlimited access to online content.
• Stay anonymous with our no-logs policy
We don't collect or store any logs or data from your online activities, so your information stays where it should—with you.
• Access VPN servers in over 70 countries
Connect to over 450 secure servers in more than 70 countries and 100 cities (depending on your subscription).
• Fine-tune your VPN with a range of connection protocols
Different connection protocols accommodate different online conditions—would you like to prioritize speed or security? Perhaps you’re dealing with poor network conditions. Either way, we’ve got you covered—choose between WireGuard, IKEv2, OpenVPN (UDP, TCP), WStunnel, and Stealth.
• Navigate the app in your language
This application supports 40 different languages—making it among the most accessible and user-friendly VPN apps.

bluejetty:00143965:ios.description:
StarLine Telematics: your vehicle is on your palm!
Download the free StarLine mobile application to manage your car security settings from your smartphone. The application will work with any StarLine GSM alarm systems, GSM modules and trackers. Use the demo mode to learn more about the application.
For non-commercial use only.
The positioning accuracy depends on the satellite signal strength and may vary according to the map service of choice.
APPLICATION FEATURES
Simple registration
- Register your car security system using a simple installation wizard.
Easy device selection
- Manage several StarLine devices: convenient for owners of several vehicles
Easy to set up and manage
- Arm and disarm your car security system;
- Start and shut down your engine at unlimited distance
- (*) Choose auto-start parameters with certain timer and temperature settings, set up a time for engine warm-up
- In emergencies use "Anti-hijack" mode: your vehicle's engine will shut down at a safe distance from you
- (*) If you pass your vehicle for repair or diagnostics, set your security settings to "valet" mode
- Find your vehicle on a parking lot by activating a short siren signal
- (*) Adjust shock and tilt sensor settings manually or turn them off when parking in a busy place
- Create shortcuts for often used commands
Intuitive vehicle's status indication
- Make sure that the alarm system is armed
- (*) The intuitive interface allows interpreting and understanding all security messages at a glance.
- (*) You can see your device’s SIM card balance, car battery voltage, engine and interior temperature
Get messages about any events with your vehicle
- Receive PUSH messages on any events with your vehicle (alarm, engine started, security disarm etc.)
- Select the types of messages you want to receive
- Browse the log list to control an engine start-ups
- (*) Learn device SIM card balance: low balance alerts delivered via PUSH messages
Monitoring of your vehicle
- (*) Comprehensive monitoring with track record. Review the routs length and speed on each part of track
- Find your car location at online map in just seconds
- Select the most convenient type of map
- Find your own positioning
Quick Help
- Call to StarLine Support hotline directly from your App!
- Rescue and assistance service numbers have been added (you change it to your local rescue numbers)
- Feedback form has been embedded.
We are always happy to answer your questions. The StarLine team is on call 24 hours

bluejetty:00130944:ios.description:
Textbook English may make sense on the page, but real conversations can still be hard to follow.
Distinction is an English learning app that helps you move from recognising English to actually using it.
It focuses on the words and phrases native speakers genuinely use in everyday life, but learners rarely meet in conventional study materials. With natural example sentences, native-speaker audio, word origins, English definitions, and pronunciation practice, everything you need to learn usable English is in one place.
Supports Distinction I–VI and Structures. Includes 2,530 carefully selected words and phrases and 5,320 practical example sentences, created with five native speakers from the US, UK, and Australia.
【What makes Distinction different】
• Carefully selected real-life words and phrases
• Natural example sentences and audio for every entry — American and British English
• English definitions and etymology that help ideas stick
• Pronunciation, listening, and speaking practice in one learning flow
• Fully offline once downloaded — study on your commute, on flights, or abroad without using mobile data
【App features】
• Study Mode based on spaced repetition and active recall
• Personalised study plans based on your time and goals
• Automatic review of weaker items
• Streaks, levels, XP, and completion certificates
• Fast search across headwords, examples, and explanations
• Speech recognition for pronunciation practice
 (main entries only; Structures excluded)
• Audio filters, autoplay, and shuffle
• Progress tracking with graphs and statistics
【Pricing】
• Free to try — 120 words + 7 structures included
• Unlock only the titles you want with one-time in-app purchases
• No subscription
• No external ads

bluejetty:00098842:ios.name: MOWD.io
bluejetty:00098842:ios.summary:
MOWD is a theme park planning and decision-support app designed to help you access important park information in one clear, easy-to-use place.
Whether you're preparing for a future trip or navigating a day in the parks, MOWD brings together
bluejetty:00098842:ios.description:
MOWD is a theme park planning and decision-support app designed to help you access important park information in one clear, easy-to-use place.
Whether you're preparing for a future trip or navigating a day in the parks, MOWD brings together wait time data, dining menus, crowd trends, and planning tools so you can make informed choices—on your terms.
What MOWD Offers:
- Live Wait Time Data
View attraction wait times sourced through third-party data providers and presented for convenience and planning purposes.
- Smart Filtering
Filter attractions, entertainment, and dining to quickly narrow down exactly what fits your day—whether that's thrill rides, live shows, or somewhere to eat.
- Dining Menus & Food Search
Browse full park menus available to all users, with optional premium food keyword search to help you quickly find items that meet your preferences.
- Crowd Calendars
See projected crowd levels based on historical attendance patterns and trends to help plan park days more effectively.
- Estimated Ride Reopening Insights
Access estimated reopening information for temporarily unavailable attractions, based on observed patterns and available data.
- Trip & Day Planning Tools
Build and organize daily itineraries using available wait time information and personal priorities.
- Trip Sharing
Share your trip with the people you're travelling with, so everyone you're planning with can stay on the same page.
Designed for Transparency:
MOWD is built to inform, not instruct. The app does not tell you where to go, what to ride, or how to plan your day. All information is presented as reference material so you can decide what works best for you and your group.
Important Notices:
MOWD is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by The Walt Disney Company, Universal Parks & Resorts, SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment, or any other theme park operator.
All wait times, crowd indicators, and reopening information are estimates and may change without notice.
Dining and allergen information is provided for informational purposes only and is not medical advice. Users are responsible for confirming ingredient and allergen details directly with park locations.
Availability of features may vary by location and time.
Premium Access:
MOWD offers optional subscription plans that unlock advanced features such as:
- Food keyword search
- Crowd calendar access
- Estimated attraction reopening insights
- Trip itinerary planning tools and sharing to premium and non premium members
Basic browsing of menus and core information remains available to all users.
Terms of Use: https://mowd.io/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mowd.io/privacy

Ignite your child’s love of speed with a safe, third‑party‑ad‑free kids racing game packed with thrill, color, and learning fun!
— Swipe, Drift, Boost!
• Easy left‑right lane change keeps little racers in control.
• One‑tap nitro for dazzling speed bursts.

• Encourages hand‑eye coordination and strategic thinking.
• Short races fit busy schedules; pause & resume anytime.
Download Racing World today and watch your child steer, drift, and smile lap after lap!

bluejetty:00032347:ios.description:
Discover "Spirit Voice", your personal gateway to the mystical realm.
This innovative app transcends the ordinary, offering users an unparalleled opportunity to engage 
in meaningful conversations with their guardian angels, spirits, and even ghosts. Whether you're seeking 
insights into love, health, wealth, or any other life question, "Spirit Voice" bridges the gap between our world 
and the beyond, delivering messages directly to you in clear, audible responses.
Key Features:
Dive into the mysteries of your life with the freedom to ask many questions. Whether it's guidance on personal 
matters or curiosity about the unseen, "Spirit Voice" is here to provide answers from a higher plane.
Audible Spiritual Responses: Experience the extraordinary as you listen to direct responses from the spiritual entities.
 "Spirit Voice" captures the essence of their messages, allowing you to hear wisdom that is meant specifically for you.
Direct Guardian Angel Communications: Connect with your personal guardian angel for guidance and protection. 
Our app facilitates a special connection, making it possible to receive personalized advice and support.
Engage with Spirits and Ghosts: Explore beyond the veil by initiating conversations with spirits and ghosts.
 Gain unique insights and understandings from those who reside in the spiritual realm, enriching your perspective on life and the afterlife.
Explore Various Life Themes: No matter the area of interest—love, health, financial prosperity, or personal 
growth—"Spirit Voice" offers guidance on all aspects of life, sourced directly from the spiritual world.
User-Friendly Design: Navigate through "Spirit Voice" with ease thanks to its intuitive interface, designed to 
make your spiritual journey as smooth as possible.
Privacy and Ethical Communication: We prioritize your privacy and the respectful treatment of spiritual entities.
 "Spirit Voice" ensures a secure and ethical environment for all interactions between users and the spiritual realm.
Why "Spirit Voice"?
"Spirit Voice" is not just an app; it's a revolutionary tool that opens up new dimensions of understanding and connection.
 It's designed for anyone drawn to the spiritual, from beginners to those deeply entrenched in spiritual practices. Our app 
goes beyond mere entertainment, offering a profound tool for personal growth and exploration.
Discover the voices waiting to guide you, the advice that can alter your life's trajectory, and the profound sense 
of connection that comes from communicating with the spiritual realm. "Spirit Voice" provides a unique, immersive experience,
 allowing you to hear the wisdom of the universe through the convenience of your iOS device.
Download "Spirit Voice" – where the unseen becomes heard, and the wisdom of the spiritual realm is just a question away.
Please note: 'Spirit Voice' has been thoughtfully developed for entertainment purposes. While it offers an engaging and immersive experience into the world of spiritual communication, it is important for users to approach the app with an understanding of its intended use. 'Spirit Voice' is designed to provide intriguing and enjoyable interactions with the spiritual realm, enriching your curiosity and offering a unique form of entertainment. We encourage users to engage with the app with an open mind and a light heart, enjoying the journey it offers into the mystical with the awareness of its creative purpose."

bluejetty:00152051:ios.description:
Baby Dreambox makes your baby sleep like an angel. More than 20 handpicked relaxing sounds and lullabies soothes your child, a smart timer stops playback when your little one starts dreaming, and you can even record your own songs or fairy tales.
KEY FEATURES
* More than 20 high quality soothing sounds and melodies - Choose between classic lullabies, nature, household or traveling sounds, and colored noises of various frequencies.
* Smart timer and monitor that listens to your baby and plays only when your baby is awake.
* Regular timer enabling you to stop playback after predefined time.
* Record your own song, lullaby or fairytale and your baby can fall asleep listening to it every night.
* Stream sounds wirelessly via Airplay.
* Support background mode.
SOOTHING SOUNDS
Colored noises
white noise, pink noise, brown noise
Sounds of Nature
Beach, Crickets, Forest, River, Rain and Storm , Whales, Heartbeat
Household sounds
AC, Shower, Vacuum cleaner, Fireplace, Clock, Washing machine
Traveling
Car ride, Airplane, Train
Lullabies
Twinkle Twinkle, Warm Kitty, Brahms' Lullaby
DESIGNED FOR PARENTS
Baby Dreambox is created by TappyTaps, developer of Bibino: Baby Monitor app that is used by more than half a million parents worldwide. It means that we have a lot of experience building apps for today’s busy parents.
To see how it works and find more information, go to http://babydreambox.com
Please send us your feedback to support@tappytaps.com. We love to implement new features based on your ideas!

bluejetty:00068444:ios.summary:
Lịch Vạn Niên - Lịch Âm là ứng dụng tra cứu lịch âm dương hiện đại dành cho người Việt, giúp tra cứu ngày tốt xấu, giờ hoàng đạo, văn khấn, tử vi và phong thủy trong một giao diện trực quan, dễ sử dụng.
Ứng dụng hỗ trợ xem nhanh ngày âm, n
bluejetty:00068444:ios.description:
Lịch Vạn Niên - Lịch Âm là ứng dụng tra cứu lịch âm dương hiện đại dành cho người Việt, giúp tra cứu ngày tốt xấu, giờ hoàng đạo, văn khấn, tử vi và phong thủy trong một giao diện trực quan, dễ sử dụng.
Ứng dụng hỗ trợ xem nhanh ngày âm, ngày dương, Can Chi, tiết khí, ngày hoàng đạo - hắc đạo, ngày rằm, mùng một và các sự kiện quan trọng. Phiên bản mới bổ sung thành ngữ theo chủ đề, Widget tiện lợi, đồng thời cải tiến giao diện giúp việc tra cứu lịch âm dương nhanh chóng và thuận tiện hơn mỗi ngày.
TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT
+ Lịch âm dương hằng ngày
Tra cứu nhanh ngày âm, ngày dương, Can Chi, tiết khí, ngày hoàng đạo - hắc đạo, trực ngày, sao tốt - sao xấu và nhiều thông tin hữu ích khác.
+ Widget màn hình chính và màn hình khóa
Theo dõi lịch âm dương ngay trên màn hình chính hoặc màn hình khóa mà không cần mở ứng dụng. Widget hiển thị ngày hiện tại, lịch âm và nhiều thông tin hữu ích giúp bạn cập nhật nhanh mỗi ngày.
+ Thành ngữ mỗi ngày theo nhiều chủ đề
Khám phá những câu nói truyền cảm hứng được tuyển chọn theo nhiều chủ đề như Phật pháp, gia đình, cuộc sống, lòng biết ơn, bình an và động lực. Có thể thay đổi chủ đề để mỗi ngày đều có một nguồn cảm hứng tích cực.
+ Lịch Tháng trực quan
Giao diện lịch tháng được thiết kế hiện đại, hiển thị rõ ràng ngày âm, ngày dương, ngày rằm, mùng một, các sự kiện và thông tin quan trọng của từng ngày.
+ Xem ngày tốt xấu và chọn ngày theo việc
Tra cứu ngày phù hợp để tham khảo cho các công việc như khai trương, cưới hỏi, xuất hành, động thổ, nhập trạch, ký kết, mua xe, cúng lễ và nhiều hoạt động khác trong đời sống.
+ Giờ hoàng đạo và hướng xuất hành
Xem giờ hoàng đạo, hướng xuất hành, tài thần, hỷ thần, tuổi xung, sao tốt, sao xấu và các thông tin liên quan để có thêm cơ sở tham khảo khi sắp xếp công việc.
+ La Bàn Phong Thủy
Hỗ trợ tham khảo phương hướng và các thông tin phong thủy cơ bản ngay trên iPhone với giao diện trực quan, dễ sử dụng.
+ Sổ tay văn khấn truyền thống
Tổng hợp nhiều bài văn khấn phổ biến dành cho ngày rằm, mùng một, lễ Tết, cúng gia tiên, Thần Tài, khai trương, nhập trạch và các nghi lễ truyền thống của người Việt.
+ Tử vi và phong thủy
Tham khảo tử vi, cung mệnh, thước Lỗ Ban, hướng nhà, tuổi hợp - tuổi xung cùng nhiều thông tin phong thủy quen thuộc trong đời sống.
+ Cá nhân hóa giao diện
Hỗ trợ thay đổi chủ đề ứng dụng theo ngũ hành Kim, Mộc, Thủy, Hỏa và Thổ, mang đến trải nghiệm gần gũi và phù hợp hơn với sở thích của bạn.
+ Tiện ích hằng ngày
Tạo ghi chú, đặt lịch nhắc nhở ngày lễ, ngày giỗ, ngày rằm, mùng một và các sự kiện quan trọng để không bỏ lỡ những dịp đáng nhớ.
+ Giải trí nhẹ nhàng
Tích hợp một số trò chơi trí tuệ quen thuộc như cờ caro, cờ tướng, cờ vua và nối khối giúp thư giãn trong thời gian rảnh.
VÌ SAO NÊN CHỌN LỊCH VẠN NIÊN - LỊCH ÂM?
- Giao diện hiện đại, trực quan và dễ sử dụng.
- Tra cứu nhanh lịch âm dương, ngày tốt xấu, giờ hoàng đạo và văn khấn.
- Hỗ trợ Widget tiện lợi trên màn hình chính và màn hình khóa.
- Khám phá thành ngữ ý nghĩa mỗi ngày theo nhiều chủ đề truyền cảm hứng.
- Tích hợp đầy đủ lịch âm, lịch tháng, chọn ngày theo việc, văn khấn, tử vi, phong thủy và la bàn trong cùng một ứng dụng.
- Thường xuyên cập nhật tính năng mới và tối ưu trải nghiệm sử dụng.
Tải ngay Lịch Vạn Niên - Lịch Âm để tra cứu lịch âm dương, xem ngày tốt xấu, giờ hoàng đạo, văn khấn, tử vi, phong thủy và khám phá những thành ngữ ý nghĩa mỗi ngày ngay trên iPhone.

bluejetty:00045711:ios.name: Perceny
bluejetty:00045711:ios.summary:
Perceny: Make Salons Easy for Everyone
Perceny is the all-in-one platform for salons, barbershops, spas, gyms and studios. Book clients, answer every call and text, check out, get paid and pay your team, from one app built for the people w
bluejetty:00045711:ios.description:
Perceny: Make Salons Easy for Everyone
Perceny is the all-in-one platform for salons, barbershops, spas, gyms and studios. Book clients, answer every call and text, check out, get paid and pay your team, from one app built for the people who run the front desk and the chair.
AI Receptionist and Percy
Your AI receptionist answers calls and texts around the clock. It books, moves and cancels appointments, remembers regulars, and hands off to your team when it should. Take over any live call, guide it privately, transfer or hang up, and replay every recording. Percy, your AI copilot, answers "how do I" questions, finds openings and helps you book, right inside the app.
Calls, Texts and Inbox
Make and answer business calls in the app. Every text, email and call lands in one inbox with photos, voice notes and attachments. Send scheduled blasts, use templates, and bring your own number or get a new one.
Appointments and Scheduling
A fast calendar with smooth pinch-zoom, all-day and multi-day bookings, drag-and-drop rescheduling, walk-in queues, recurring appointments and waitlists. Breaks in business hours, staff exceptions, rooms and resources, Google Calendar sync, multi-stop routes for mobile services, and service times that learn how long each client takes.
Point of Sale and Payments
Check clients out in seconds. Accept cards, Tap to Pay, card readers, cash and digital wallets. Offer Klarna, Affirm and Afterpay. Take deposits with timed holds, keep cards on file, refund by item, split tickets across team members, and see exactly why a card was declined.
Workflows and Automation
Automatically text, email, tag clients or alert staff when someone books, misses a visit, has a birthday or stops coming in. Start from templates and set rules for the whole business.
Memberships, Gift Cards, Rewards and Store Credit
Sell memberships and gift cards from any client's profile, run loyalty rewards that repeat every few visits or referrals, grow through referrals, and give clients store credit they can spend at checkout.
Client Management and Forms
Rich client profiles with history, notes, photos and lifetime value. Family accounts, group bookings on one bill, duplicate merging, and at-risk alerts. Send intake forms, waivers and consents with photos and signatures, ready to print or save as PDF.
Staff, Commissions and Payroll
Roles and permissions, tiered commissions, hourly pay or "hourly or commission, whichever is higher", tips, deductions and payouts. PIN-protected clock-in, GPS attendance, breaks, timesheets and recurring staff tasks. Every stylist sees exactly what they've earned.
Kiosk and Self Check-In
Turn a tablet into a full-screen kiosk for check-ins, walk-in sign-ups, booking, a live waitlist board and payment on the spot.
Multiple Locations
Run a chain from one place: shared clients, catalog and stock, earnings and payroll across locations, and bookings you can move between shops.
Your Own Booking Website and Client App
Every business gets a branded booking site with custom domains and custom booking links. Clients book, pay and manage visits in Perceny Go, the client app.
Reports and Insights
Sales, tips, average ticket, staff performance, retention, rebookings, no-shows and cancellations, product margins, chair utilization, attendance hours and a full audit log.
Built for Teams
Real-time updates across phones, tablets and the web, receipt and drawer printing, cash register reconciliation, expense tracking, push and SMS notifications, and webhooks to connect your other tools.
Perceny gives service businesses everything they need to book more clients, get paid faster, and run every day with confidence.

bluejetty:00115741:android.description:
"Step into the sizzling world of Cooking Dash: Crazy Kitchen 🍳, where delicious dishes, fast service, and smart strategies are the key to success.
In this highly addictive cooking game 🎮, you’ll travel across the globe 🌍, manage bustling restaurants, and take on exciting cooking challenges that test your speed and skill. From frying golden fries and flipping burgers to baking sweet cupcakes and blending exotic drinks, the kitchen never sleeps. It’s more than just cooking — it’s about timing, multitasking, and growing your own restaurant empire 👑.
Whether you’re a casual player or a time management pro, Cooking Dash: Crazy Kitchen is the perfect mix of fun, food, and frenzy!
Game Features You’ll Love:
👩🍳Cook Hundreds of Tasty Dishes: Serve meals inspired by global cuisines: burgers, steaks, sushi, cakes, and more!
🌐Unlock & Upgrade Restaurants Worldwide: Discover themed kitchens from around the world, each with its own unique vibe, menu, and gameplay style.
🔥Master Fast-Paced Cooking Challenges: Deliver orders under pressure, create combo chains, and keep your customers smiling for extra rewards.
🛠️Upgrade Kitchen Appliances & Ingredients: Boost your speed and efficiency by upgrading stoves, ovens, fryers, and serving counters.
🎉Daily Missions & Special Events: Take on new goals every day to win gold, diamonds, and exclusive chef rewards.
📶Play Anytime, Anywhere – No Wi-Fi Needed: This is the perfect offline cooking game to enjoy anytime you're craving a challenge.
🎨Stunning Visuals & Smooth Gameplay: Colorful graphics, lively animations, and intuitive controls make every level a delight to play.
How to Play:
Tap to Prepare👆: Select ingredients, cook dishes, and plate up orders fast.
Serve Customers🧑🤝🧑: Keep an eye on the queue and deliver food before time runs out.
Manage Time & Prioritize📋: Juggle multiple orders, combo opportunities, and upgrades under pressure.
Upgrade Smartly💡: Spend coins and diamonds to enhance appliances and unlock premium recipes.
Complete Levels & Unlock New Restaurants🚀: Travel the world, face tougher missions, and grow your kitchen empire.
Are You Ready for Cooking Madness? 🤩
Whether you're a fan of chef games, restaurant simulators, or just love the thrill of keeping up with a busy crazy kitchen, Cooking Dash: Crazy Kitchen is your new favorite addiction.
Perfect for those who enjoy time management games with a flavorful twist, this game offers a fun mix of strategy, reflexes, and creativity.
Download now 👇 and show the world what kind of master chef 🌟 you truly are!
Your apron’s waiting 🎽. The orders are piling up 📈. Let the cooking madness begin! 🥳"

bluejetty:00192360:android.description:
Become a professional buyer and make big money in Auction Wars: Storage King! 
Visit the storage auctions and battle against other buyers, make the right call and walk away rich! Can you find hidden treasure and beat your friend's score on the leaderboard? 
- EIGHT STORAGE AUCTION LOCATIONS 
Start out on the road to riches by bidding at the storage auctions. Make money and earn your right to compete at the world’s most prestigious auction houses! Work your way up through the ranks to trade in only the finest quality goods. 
- LEADERBOARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS 
Auction Wars: Storage King features global leaderboards and eleven achievements. Trade your way to the top of the leaderboards and beat the scores set by friends and strangers alike! 
- BEAUTIFUL RETINA DISPLAY HD GRAPHICS 
Auction Wars: Storage King takes full advantage of retina displays with beautiful and crisp high definition graphics. 
- RARE ITEMS & INVITE ONLY AUCTIONS 
Play well and you’ll receive an invite to a mysterious auction house that deals only in the world’s rarest items! Collect each of these items to earn BIG money! 
- ONLINE MULTIPLAYER (*Requires an in-app purchase)
Play online with your friends and strangers alike in your own virtual auction. 
- REALISTIC AI CHARACTERS 
Compete against realistic AI competitors, each with their own unique characteristics. Enter into quick fire bidding battles and face late calls. Hold your nerve to make the right call and walk away with big profits! 
- COLLECTIONS 
Collect a range of items. Keep track of your items on the collections menu. Can you hunt down each and every item? 
- MORE TO COME 
We make a commitment to supporting this game with regular updates. We promise to add more great items, more locations, more characters and more features very soon! 
Music by Kevin MacLeod.

bluejetty:00143970:ios.description:
ЗДРАВСИТИ - онлайн-сервис для поиска и заказа лекарств, аптечной косметики, товаров для здоровья. Здравсити это первый крупномасштабный проект, объединяющий аптеки по всей России. Соберите домашнюю аптечку быстро и легко. Товары привезут до ближайшей к вам аптеки или домой курьером. Оплачивайте как удобно: в момент заказа или при получении.
 Как это работает?
Вы находите нужный товар, добавляете его в корзину, выбираете из списка аптек-партнеров Здравсити ближайший пункт доставки и подтверждаете заказ. Или введите ваш адрес в адресную строку для доставки курьером. При поступлении товаров в аптеку, на указанный номер телефона придет смс с подтверждением. Вам останется только оплатить заказ в аптеке и получить его (если он не был оплачен ранее).
Приложение Здравсити - это целая аптека в вашем гаджете. В каталоге представлено более 46 000 наименований товаров для красоты и здоровья: лекарства, косметика, детское и здоровое питание, витамины. В аптеках- партнерах найдется то, что вы ищете. Ваша домашняя и автомобильная аптечка будут наполнены всеми необходимыми лекарствами и перевязочными средствами без лишних хлопот.
Какие товары представлены на Здравсити?
-Препараты и медтехника
- Витамины, БАДы
- Таблетки от похмелья
- Аптечная косметика (кремы для лица, тела от известных брендов)
- Косметика и товары для детей
- Товары для здоровья, линзы
- Перевязочные материалы и товары для ухода за больными
- Компрессионное белье и бандажи
- Товары для беременных, кормящих мам, детские смеси
- Все для домашней и дорожной аптечки
- Декоративная косметика и многое другое
Приложение Здравсити вам поможет:
1) Быстро заказать нужные товары 24/7 в ближайшую аптеку или домой.
2) Узнать о наличии лекарств в аптеке и заказать товары близким в другой город (и сразу же их оплатить).
2) Первым узнавать об акциях и специальных предложениях на препараты в разных аптеках.
3) Оперативно получать информацию о поступлении нужного товара на склад.
4) Отслеживать ваш заказ и контролировать все стадии доставки.
5) Мгновенно связаться с колл-центром Здравсити и получить консультацию.
6) Найти редкие лекарства, таблетки и товары, которые не представлены в аптеках.
7) Смотреть аналоги лекарств и читать инструкции, чтобы соблюдать правильный прием лекарств.
8) Следить за накоплением и списанием бонусных баллов.
9) Получать кешбэк 1% и скидки до 70% при заказе товаров для здоровья и красоты, среди которых: лекарства, косметика, питание для малышей, витамины.

Key feature
bluejetty:00039390:ios.description:
Complete all your border procedures with the official Seychelles e-Border government app.
Simply provide the requested information and you can submit your Travel Authorization, Disembarkation and Embarkation Information Forms.
Key features:
- The fastest way to submit your application.
- Available for all people traveling to and from the Seychelles.
- Securely store your passport and contact information for yourself and anyone in your family to save time when you next apply.
- Store other documents, such as yellow fever vaccination certificates securely within the app
Please note that all data submitted via the app is used for the sole purpose of your Travel Authorization or Disembarkation and Embarkation Information Forms, unless you specifically opt-in to receive information from third parties.
To find out more, visit https://seychelles.govtas.com/ 
We look forward to seeing you in the Seychelles!

Enter your target pace or speed and instantly convert between them, then see projected finish times across popular distances from 400m and the mile to 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, Marathon, 50K, 50 Mile, and 100 Mile.

 - Enter a goal finish time to see the pace you need
 - View finish times across short, long, and ultra distances

 - Switch between miles and kilometers

 - Use Pace on Apple Watch with Digital Crown support
Pace Pro
A one-time purchase that removes ads and adds finish time widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, plus splits in Siri answers.

bluejetty:00096835:ios.description:
Your entire knowledge library. Always with you. Always private.
DEVONthink To Go is your document repository when you're not at your Mac. Collect, organize, edit, and annotate. Use generative AI to work with your stored knowledge or create new documents. Automate with Shortcuts. Our time-tested technology keeps all your data in sync between your Mac, iPad, and iPhone, privately and securely.
The professional document and information manager for iPad and iPhone. From DEVONtechnologies, driving innovation since 2002.
- Students: Annotate research papers with AI-powered summaries
- Teachers: Organize your materials, use AI to create handouts and tests
- Researchers: Have your data with you in a robust, powerful knowledge manager
- Lawyers: Keep all case files organized and encrypted
Have your important documents with you at all times:
- Never lose an important document again, keep everything organized
- Store PDFs, notes, images, bookmarks, just about any type
- File your documents in groups, even more than one group at a time
- Use tags, mark documents with flags or as unread, give them a star rating
- Versioning lets you return to a previous state of a document
- Revision-proof databases prevent edits to documents with special requirements
- Sync your data between Macs, iPads, and iPhones, securely and privately
Work with your documents:
- Edit texts, Markdown files, or rich text documents
- Annotate and edit PDFs with common tools
- Make scans, scanned PDFs, or images searchable with the built-in, on-device OCR
- Add custom, searchable metadata fields to enrich your documents
Use generative AI:
- Work with your favorite provider and model
- Chat with your documents, analyze or summarize them
- Transform text or extract text from images and even handwritten notes
- Create new images from your data
- Find documents using natural language with the AI-powered search assistant
- Let the AI make order from chaos, rename documents, add tags, or label or rate them
DEVONthink To Go is well-integrated with other apps:
- Link to your documents from other apps with universal links
- Access all your documents also through the Files app
- Clip data from almost any app with the Clip to DEVONthink extension
- Use drag-and-drop, inside DEVONthink To Go or between apps
- Automate repetitive tasks with Shortcuts actions
DEVONthink To Go is great standalone but also works perfectly with DEVONthink for Mac and across multiple devices. Synchronize your databases securely and privately over the local network or through a cloud service of your choice. You decide what data is synced, when, and where. Strong encryption makes sure that your data belongs to you, not to your service provider or us.
Privacy policy: https://www.devontechnologies.com/r/privacy
End user license agreement: https://www.devontechnologies.com/r/eula

bluejetty:00019537:ios.summary:
DESIGN ANYTHING WITH CANVA
Canva is your all-in-one creative app for photos, videos and designs. Edit photos, remove backgrounds, make collages, cut videos and create logos, posters, resumes and presentations – all in one place. No design e
bluejetty:00019537:ios.description:
DESIGN ANYTHING WITH CANVA
Canva is your all-in-one creative app for photos, videos and designs. Edit photos, remove backgrounds, make collages, cut videos and create logos, posters, resumes and presentations – all in one place. No design experience needed – just open the app and start creating.
CREATE ANYTHING YOU CAN IMAGINE WITH CANVA AI
Skip the blank box. With Canva AI, you can start with visual inspiration, shape it your way, and make something that feels uniquely yours. Canva AI helps you get started with a look you love, then it's over to you to make it unmistakably yours.
BRING YOUR IMAGES TO LIFE WITH THE AI PHOTO EDITOR
Edit photos like a pro in a few taps. Remove backgrounds in one tap, erase unwanted objects with Magic Eraser, swap or add anything with Magic Edit, and fine-tune brightness, contrast and saturation. Add text, filters and effects, or generate brand new images from a simple prompt.
MEET THE SIMPLEST, MOST POWERFUL CANVA VIDEO YET
Introducing the new Canva Video, as edited by you. Shaped by community feedback, we've built a cleaner timeline, added smarter shortcuts, and unlocked more creative control. Simple by default, with more power when it matters. Oh, and the duration button is back!
COLLAGE MAKER
Bring your favorite moments together with photo grids, layouts and video collages. Mix photos, clips and text, then customize every detail with your own style.
SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
Design posts, reels, stories, thumbnails and memes for all your favorite platforms. Create a reel, a post and a story in the same project, then plan and schedule content so your feed stays fresh.
LOGO MAKER
Build a logo for your business, side hustle or team in minutes. Pick a template, tweak the fonts and colors, and keep your brand looking sharp everywhere.
POSTER MAKER & FLYER DESIGNS
Create eye-catching posters, flyers, invitations and banners with thousands of templates. Ideal for events, promotions, parties and school projects.
RESUME BUILDER
Craft a polished resume or CV that stands out. Browse professional templates, personalize your layout and download it as a PDF, ready to send.
WHITEBOARD & PRESENTATIONS
Brainstorm ideas on an infinite whiteboard, then turn them into slides. Build presentations, slideshows and visual docs that make your ideas easy to follow.
MILLIONS OF CREATIVE ASSETS
Explore a huge library of photos, videos, graphics, audio tracks and hundreds of fonts. Everything you need to make your designs look amazing is right at your fingertips.
TRANSLATE & RESIZE
Translate designs into over 100 languages and resize them for any format in a few taps. Reach more people without starting from scratch.
WORK TOGETHER
Share designs with friends, classmates or teammates, collaborate in real time and gather feedback fast. Your projects sync across your phone, tablet and computer, so you can pick up right where you left off.
CANVA FOR EDUCATION
Canva for Education gives eligible K-12 teachers and students a school-managed Canva experience built for the classroom, with built-in moderation and age-appropriate controls for safe, collaborative learning.
Download Canva today and start with a look you love.
Terms of Use: https://www.canva.com/policies/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://www.canva.com/policies/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00063234:ios.description:
Days of Empire is the first true war game to restore the history of the Ottoman Empire.
The war at sea is over, but the war on land is just beginning. As the designated successor of the aging Ottoman sultan, you must unite the great warriors of this mighty, historic empire. Eliminate your enemies; rescue captive heroes; amass great armies; build an impenetrable fortress; bolster your economy; and take over the reigns of the empire! 
 Game features 
 Puzzles with rewards：Solve brain-wracking puzzles to pull the pin, help heroes destroy monsters and find treasure!
 Faithfully recreating the Ottoman Empire : Experience exquisite Ottoman architecture and take part in epic campaigns!
 Summon historical Ottoman heroes : Over 50 real leaders from the Ottoman Empire await your commands!
 Large-scale battlefields : PVP, PVE, and Kingdom War; fight for glory!
 Strategic battles : A wide variety of troop types, weapons, and flexible hero combinations; experience strategy on a global scale!
 Naval Warfare competition : War engulfs both land and sea, harking back to real historical campaigns!
 Global interaction : Awesome real-time translations and language chat features!
 Alliance battles : Form powerful alliances, occupy strategic strongholds, plunder resources, and expand your empire!
 Real player comments 
"The game is completely faithful to history, the music is inspiring, and the whole experience is immersive"
"It's intuitive and easy to play and the graphics are exquisite"
"It's addictive and you can play for free"
"After entering the game there are so many alliances waiting to welcome you, it's a really tight-knit community and everyone works together to fight enemies!"
 Official website : http://boe.onemt.com/
 Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/daysofempiregame
 Customer support 
If you have any feedback or recommendations, then don't hesitate to send us a message at serviceBOE@onemt.com
Privacy Policy: http://www.onemt.com/policy.html
Terms of Service: http://www.onemt.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00169235:ios.summary:
تطبيق مفاتيح الجنان يحتوي على كتاب مفاتيح الجنان للشيخ عباس القمي والصحيفة السجادية للإمام زين العابدين عليه السلام.
مفاتيح الجنان للشيخ عباس القمي أحد أشهر كتب الأدعية للمسلمين الشيعة يحتوي على الأدعية والزيارات والمناجاة والأعمال العباد
bluejetty:00169235:ios.description:
تطبيق مفاتيح الجنان يحتوي على كتاب مفاتيح الجنان للشيخ عباس القمي والصحيفة السجادية للإمام زين العابدين عليه السلام.
مفاتيح الجنان للشيخ عباس القمي أحد أشهر كتب الأدعية للمسلمين الشيعة يحتوي على الأدعية والزيارات والمناجاة والأعمال العبادية المروية على لسان النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وأهل بيته عليهم السلام.
أما الصحيفة السجادية فهي مجموعة من الأدعية المأثورة عن الامام زين العابدين علي بن أبي طالب من أئمة أهل البيت الذين أَذهب الله عنهم الرجس وطهرهم تطهيراً.
تم تطوير هذا التطبيق وفق أحدث التقنيات بتصميم مبتكر ليوفر تجربة استخدام سهلة ومميزة للمستخدمين لقراءة الأدعية والاستماع لها. كما يقدم تجربة صوتية مميزة للاستماع عبر عرض قائمة كبيرة بالقرَّاء لكل دعاء من خلال مكتبة صوتيات متنوعة. 
يحتوي التطبيق على عدة أقسام: أعمال اليوم، التعقيبات، الأدعية، الزيارات، والمناجاة. أعمال اليوم يتم فيها عرض الأعمال اليومية مثل دعاء الصباح، دعاء اليوم، زيارة اليوم، كما يتم كذلك عرض الأدعية المشهورة مثل دعاء كميل يوم الخميس ودعاء الندبة والسمات يوم الجمعة وكل هذه الأدعية تحتوي على الصوتيات. أما في قسم التعقيبات فهناك قسمان: قسم التعقيبات الخاصة والتعقيبات العامة. أما قسم الأدعية ففيه قسمان: قسم الأدعية الشهرية ويتم فيه عرض أدعية الشهر العربي بشكل تلقائي حسب الشهر الحالي مثل أدعية شهر رجب، أدعية شهر شعبان، وأدعية شهر رمضان. أما قسم الزيارات ففيه الزيارات العامة: مثل زيارة عاشوراء وزيارة أمين الله وغيرها من الزيارات، والجزء الآخر هو قسم الزيارات الخاصة للأئمة عليهم السلام.
المزايا الأساسية للتطبيق:
* تصميم مبتكر وجذاب يوفر تجربة استخدام سهلة وبسيطة تناسب جميع المستخدمين.
* باقة غنية ومتنوعة من الصوتيات لعدد كبير من القراء.
* تشغيل الصوت في الخلفية والقدرة على التحكم به من خلال مركز الإشعارات.
* قائمة بالأعمال اليومية (دعاء الصباح، دعاء اليوم، زيارة اليوم،…) في الشاشة الرئيسية.
* عرض تلقائي لأعمال الشهر العربي الحالي في واجهة البرنامج.
* تنسيق واضح وجميل للنصوص مع ميزة تكبير وتصغير الخط.
* ميزة البحث السريع من الشاشة الرئيسية.
يتم تحديث التطبيق باستمرار ليشتمل على عدد أكبر من الأدعية والصوتيات والمميزات.
ملاحظاتكم وآرائكم هي محل اهتمام وتقدير.

bluejetty:00023036:ios.description:
Take command of your wireless service, anywhere at any time! The TracFone My Account App lets you manage most aspects of your wireless service right from your phone.
Here is how it works:
-Once downloaded, open the app and after agreeing with the End User License agreement, you will have the option to log in (if you already have a TracFone Account) or you can create an account by selecting Create an Account.
- Once logged in, you will be able to see your Service End Date, keep track of your Balance on your home screen, refill your Airtime by selecting Buy Airtime or Add Airtime if you have an Airtime PIN.
-Other features include Credit Card management, Adding or Deleting a Device from the Account, viewing your transaction history or you can use our retail locator. 
Airtime PINs are located on the back of the TracFone Service Card or on your register receipt. To read the PIN on the TracFone Service Card, simply locate the grey strip on the back of the card. Scratch off the gray strip in order to reveal the Service Card PIN.
Service Cards are sold at over 80,000 retail locations across the United States.
Not a TracFone customer? Switch now! Visit us at http://www.tracfone.com/ for more information
Tracfone from TracFone Wireless, a Verizon company.

Do you want to learn Python or are you preparing for Python Interview? Get ready to experience the most comprehensive and unique Python Learning app.
Using the PythonX app, you can self learn Python Programming Language or brush up your skills in Python. UNIQUE FEATURES
"Python X" is one of the best and most loved apps to help you learn Python on your smartphone. Below features of the app make it unique - 
• Comprehensive Guide to learning Python
• Get a certification in Python at the end of the course
• Practice Quiz/Questions at the end of each topic
• Hundreds of code example to help you practice
• Online Code Compiler to compile your code and view output
• Projects to help you prepare better
• Speech Enabled learning
The course content is bite sized and helps you prepare for interviews or examinations. The app is suited for anyone who wants to get started with Python learning.

• Hands on with Python

The app also covers real life projects so that you can master the programming language and prepare for job interviews or written tests. It's a must have app for students and working professionals.

bluejetty:00064420:ios.description:
Play WWE Champions, an immensely challenging World Wrestling Entertainment mobile game. Compete in Contests based on NXT, Raw, SmackDown and more. Collect over 500 Superstars including The Rock, Cody Rhodes, and Becky Lynch. Enjoy action RPG and puzzle battles. Join over 35 million players and feel the excitement of the WWE Universe. Try to stay undefeated on the Road to WrestleMania in the ultimate match 3 RPG!
COLLECT HUNDREDS OF WWE SUPERSTARS AND LEGENDS
* The Rock, Roman Reigns, Alexa Bliss, and John Cena - Start your roster with top WWE Superstars and Legends.
* Bret "Hit Man" Hart, Andre the Giant, and more - Add legendary heavyweights to your team.
* Choose The Undertaker, Stone Cold Steve Austin, and all-time Attitude Era icons.
* Add Asuka, Becky Lynch, Charlotte Flair and other top Women’s Superstars.
* The NWO, New Day, DX, and all the greatest factions are here.
* Lucha Libre greats like Rey Mysterio and more await. Choose your style!
ACTION RPG GAME, WWE STYLE
* Use your skills to earn XP in this unique RPG Puzzle Battle Game.
* Win matches to customize moves and upgrade your team.
* Action RPG gameplay lets you choose how to battle.
* Hire Trainers to boost your Superstars’ abilities.
* Strategize! Pick the best Class to beat opponents. Choose from Technicians, Strikers, and more.
CAN YOU STAY UNDEFEATED IN WWE EVENTS & CONTESTS?
* Join the WWE Universe in new weekly bouts and events.
* NXT, Monday Night RAW, and SmackDown themed battles.
* Upgrade to use the Stone Cold Stunners, Rock Bottom, Styles Clash and more..
* Enter monthly title events and recruit up-and-coming WWE Superstars.
* Rank up from NXT beginnings to main eventing arenas around the world.
* In-game Contests update every week to match on-air storylines.
MATCH 3 RPG PUZZLE BATTLES MEET WWE MOVES
* Match 3 gems to obliterate rivals.
* Use signature WWE Superstar moves.
* Upgrade to use the Stone Cold Stunners, Rock Bottom, Styles Clash and more..
* Puzzle battle RPG combos and finishing moves
PVP SHOWDOWNS
* PvP WWE battles with enhanced worldwide multiplayer matchmaking.
* Showdown Shop store delivers exclusive rewards & prizes.
FACTIONS & ALLIANCES, WWE STYLE
* Join a Faction to play with friends and to heal and help teammates.
* Strategize with Faction members in your own Headquarters.
* Exclusive Faction Missions earn rewards and loot.
CUSTOM TITLES WITH ABILITIES & BUFFS
* Collect straps and medals to craft specialized Titles.
* Customize and upgrade each Title. Thousands of different combinations.
VIP MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTIONS
* Subscribe to WWE Champions exclusive memberships.
* Play as Triple H - King of Kings, DX Triple H, or DX Shawn Michaels.
* Access to exclusive content, contests and special rewards.
**WINNER! Webby People's Voice Award (Sports Games)**

bluejetty:00129123:ios.description:
About California Escapades:
Build your own farm, explore mysterious lands, and follow the adventure story in this Wild West game.
Hey, adventurers, welcome to California Escapades! Explore historical California's rich and dangerous lands while building up and maintaining your own farm and city with Jim, a gold miner, and Emma, a country farm girl. Everyone knows chasing after gold and treasure has its risks, no matter how careful you are. Join Jim and Emma on their adventures and find some rare treasure along the way!
Features:
• Build up your city with unique buildings, factories, production buildings, and decorations!
• Complete various missions to explore and unlock the secrets of Gold Rush California!
• Build and maintain your own farm with animals and crops!
• Meet all kinds of bizarre characters and join special events during your adventure exploring the mysterious land!
• Collect and produce items to build your own commercial empire through quests and completing orders!
• Explore mysterious and magical lands!
Let's explore historical Gold Rush California! Enter the game and start your adventure through a magical land of lush valleys, vast deserts, pristine snowfields. The home base has the perfect land to build your own farm where you can raise animals and harvest crops. Expand your farm into a city where you can buy and sell real estate, decorate with unique decorations, and conduct business transactions. When you're feeling adventerous, embark on a journey through the mysterious wilderness. Who knows what you'll find and who you'll meet! Play California Escapades now!
If you have any problems and questions during your adventure, or if you'd like to share your experience with us, please feel free to contact us in the following ways:
Send an email to: californiaescapades2077@gmail.com
Or
Comment on Facebook: www.facebook.com/AdventurCA

bluejetty:00127312:ios.description:
Zombie Sniper War 3
Zombie Sniper War 3 is an offline first-person shooter where you battle through a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead. Complete story missions, upgrade a powerful arsenal of weapons, defeat epic bosses, and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak. Every mission brings you one step closer to humanity's survival.
Explore 9 Unique Regions
Travel through ruined cities, abandoned forests, military facilities, underground tunnels, deserts, and high-tech laboratories. Every region introduces new enemies, mission objectives, and a unique boss encounter.
Hundreds of Missions Across Six Game Modes
• Story Missions
• Sniper Missions
• Side Missions
• Defense Mode
• Contract Missions
• Lucy Story Missions
Experience both classic stationary sniper missions and free-movement combat. From long-range precision shooting to defending fortified positions against overwhelming enemy waves, every mission offers different objectives, challenges, and strategies.
Epic Boss Battles
Every region ends with an unforgettable boss fight. Face terrifying enemies including Bio-Mutants, Tunnel Dwellers, Cyborg Ninjas, Arachnid Queens, and many more. Learn their attack patterns, adapt your tactics, and fight for survival.
Weapons & Progression
Unlock and upgrade a huge collection of firearms, including:
• Sniper Rifles
• Assault Rifles
• SMGs
• LMGs
• Shotguns
• Sidearms
Upgrade every weapon, unlock Prestige, and continue improving your favorite firearms instead of leaving them behind as you progress through the game.
Customize your arsenal with unique weapon skins, including themed and seasonal designs.
Special Equipment
Bring advanced equipment into battle to gain the upper hand.
Use Grenades, Healing Packs, Thermal Vision, Focus Mode (Stimpack), Infinite Ammo Packs, Ion Strikes, and Missile Barrages to overcome the toughest encounters.
Character Progression
Collect helmets, tactical gear, and military equipment that provide unique gameplay bonuses. Complete armor sets to unlock additional upgrades, and discover seasonal gear during limited-time events.
Key Features:
• Offline gameplay — no internet connection required
• Play the complete campaign offline anytime, anywhere
• More than 700 missions
• Stationary and free-movement gameplay
• Nine unique regions with epic boss battles
• Story, Sniper, Side, Defense, Contract, and Lucy Missions
• Extensive arsenal of upgradeable firearms
• Prestige weapon progression
• Character progression with armor and gear
• Detailed 3D environments
• Smooth and responsive controls
• Weapon skins and seasonal equipment
• Daily Challenges and Achievements
• Seasonal events and regular content updates
Download Zombie Sniper War 3 and experience an offline first-person shooter featuring nine unique regions, deep weapon progression, challenging boss battles, and intense survival gameplay.

bluejetty:00027366:ios.description:
If your iPhone is running out of space frequently, or you love to take a lot of photos and videos, then you definitely need this app – Phone Cleaner!
This phone cleaning app helps you to smartly free up your iPhone and iCloud space and instantly recover the storage capacity. It automatically detects all the useless files, including similar and duplicate photos/videos, large files on both your iPhone and iCloud, through a patent-winning algorithm. With this phone cleaner, you can always keep your iPhone clean and secure.
Use Phone Cleaner to
- Free up your iPhone and iCloud storage in seconds
- Clean up your useless photos/videos intelligently on your iPhone and iCloud
- Compress your large videos and photos, reduce the file size
- Batch merge duplicated contacts and remove incomplete contacts
- Backup your phone book to iCloud periodically
- Hide your secret contacts and photos in the password-protected secret space
- Private browser that leaves no trace
- Provide cleanup guidances to do further phone storage cleanup in other categories
- Save battery
[Features]
[Smart Scan]
Automatically computes duplicate and similar photos/videos, to allow you to delete them within a few taps.
[Photo and Video Cleanup]
Clean up your photo album for each category, intelligently figure out the useless photos and videos in your iPhone and iCloud.
- Clean up similar photos, duplicate photos
- Clean up large files
- Organize and clean up photos automatically by AI categories
- Clean up screenshots, screen recordings
- Clean up similar videos
- Cleaner for burst photos
- Clean up by Places
- Cleaner Internet downloaded photos and videos
[Manage Contacts]
- Back up and restore your point-in-time phone book with iCloud
- Intelligently group and merge duplicate contacts
- Delete/edit iPhone contacts in batch
- Detect incomplete contacts and delete/edit them directly
[Compressor]
- Compress your photos & videos without losing quality
- Reduce the size for your photos & videos
- Resize your photos & videos
[Game Mode]
Organize your photos and free up storage space in an efficient manner by Swipe gesture.
- Swipe left to delete
- Swipe right to keep
- Swipe up to mark the photo as favorite
[Secret Space with Password Protection]
The secret space is always protected by password. Even it goes to the background, it comes with a screen cover. 
- Secret Albums: Hide your private photos and videos here to keep it secret.
- Secret Contacts: You must have your reasons for wanting your contact list to be private. With this feature, the names of people in your secret contact lists will not appear in the history of calls and messages sent to or from your device.
- Private Browser: The private browser has no cache and leaves no trace. It does not occupy additional storage space on your iPhone, and will not track any browsing history at all. It is always safe to use the private browser to visit website with your privacy protected.
[Tips for Saving Storage]
It provides some other efficient ways to free up your iPhone’s storage space. The tips from the iPhone clean master who invents this app can help you to smartly clean up the phone storage with a few operations.
[Widgets]
Add widgets to your homescreen to monitor your iPhone space usage and give you suggestions on what’s cleanable.
[Phone Cleaner Pro Unlimited Subscription]
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00187662:ios.description:
Truly unique among magazine apps, the Forbes app acts as your gateway to the ultimate Forbes experience by combining the power of the dynamic and content-rich Forbes.com with Forbes magazine — all optimized for mobile and enabled for easy saving and sharing. The app offers the freedom to glide between platforms to discover and share what you find interesting, valuable and inspiring: stories about entrepreneurs and executives changing the world; innovative companies that are changing how businesses work; strategic insights to help shape your investment strategies and more. The app opens with Forbes.com and features easy navigation that showcases breaking news, the latest posts, feature stories, video and trending content. In the Magazine channel, subscribers will find each issue organized for mobile and available as a PDF, too. Experience straightforward navigation and a fully integrated environment that allows you to move seamlessly through all that Forbes offers. Enable notifications and never miss a breaking story or magazine issue. 
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS The Forbes app is free to download. All readers can explore Forbes.com content and a sample of the magazine. Complete issues are available to app subscribers.
ABOUT FORBES MEDIA The defining voice of entrepreneurial capitalism, Forbes champions success by celebrating those who have made it and those who aspire to make it. Forbes convenes and curates the most influential leaders and entrepreneurs who are driving change, transforming business and making a significant impact on the world. The Forbes brand today reaches more than 140 million people worldwide through its trusted journalism, signature LIVE events, custom marketing programs and 40 licensed local editions in 70 countries. Forbes Media’s brand extensions include real estate, education and financial services license agreements. For more information, visit the Forbes News Hub or Forbes Connect.
