bluejetty:00175282:ios.summary: Take control of your day with SKAI! Track storms, hurricanes, and lightning strikes with ease. Access real-time weather radar, receive timely severe weather alerts, and plan ahead with accurate hourly forecasts featuring detailed precipitat
bluejetty:00175282:ios.description:
Take control of your day with SKAI! Track storms, hurricanes, and lightning strikes with ease. Access real-time weather radar, receive timely severe weather alerts, and plan ahead with accurate hourly forecasts featuring detailed precipitation outlooks.
STAY AWARE WITH INSIGHTFUL WEATHER MAPS:
- Past and Future Weather Radar: Track storms, rain, snow, as they move across your region. Get detailed precipitation forecasts for the next 24h.
- Wind Speed and Gusts: Stay informed with a 10-day wind speed and direction map.
- Live Weather Cameras: Get real-time views from local webcams for instant clarity on conditions.
- Global Temperature Forecasts: View the 7-day temperature forecast map.
- Snow Depth Forecast: Strategize up to 14 days in advance with our color-coded Snow Depth Forecasts.
- Air Quality Map: Keep track of the AQI and monitor the levels of air pollutants.
- Cloud Cover Map: See the clouds movement on the global map.
TRACK EXTREME WEATHER EVENTS:
- Wildfire Tracker: Track the progress of fires in real-time.
- Hurricane Tracker: Get precise hurricane path predictions! Monitor the storm’s current position and see its next move.
- Lightning Tracker: View the recent lightning strikes on the map.
- Storm Cell Tracker: See where hail, heavy rain, or tornadoes are headed and how fast they're moving.
- Severe Weather Alerts: Check active warning zones and get full alert details with a tap.
PLAN SMARTLY:
- 10-Day Hourly Forecast: Get a precise weather forecast for the next 10 days, including hourly temperature, chance of precipitation, humidity, wind speed, visibility, dew point.
- Daily Local Forecast Details: See chance of precipitation, precipitation amounts, UV Index, Air Quality, barometric pressure, visibility, dew point, humidity and wind.
- Minute-by-Minute Precipitation Forecast: Plan your day with greater precision with our minute-level rain and snow forecasts.
- Pollen Count: View daily pollen counts by species and get helpful health tips.
- Notifications: Stay in the know with weather alerts. Get Today's and Tomorrow's forecast notifications.
- Widgets: Get instant access to current weather conditions.
GET SKAI’S PRO FEATURES:
Access exclusive features like our Future Radar, Hurricane, Storm Cells and Lightning Trackers, Global Temperature Forecast Map, Snow Depth Forecast, Air Quality Maps, Wildfire Tracker, Minute-by-Minute Precipitation Forecast, Wind Map.
Enjoy Ad-free Experience.
Coverage:
Observed radar images: United States, Puerto Rico, Guam, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Germany, Ireland, United Kingdom, Switzerland, France (northern), Belgium, Netherlands.
Hurricane and lightning tracker; air quality index and map; detailed weather information; basic precipitation details, future radar, temperature, cloud cover, wind and snow maps; widgets - global.
Pollen count: Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Hong Kong, Israel, Japan, Jordan, South Korea, Mexico, Mongolia, Nepal, New Zealand, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, United States, the majority of European countries.
Wildfire map: United States, Canada.
Storm cells tracker, live cameras & weather alerts: United States.
SKAI PRO Experience:
When you confirm your purchase, your App Store account will be charged for the subscription cost. Remember, your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew or cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Jumping into a premium subscription from a free trial? Any unused portion of your trial will be forfeited. Renewal costs will be based on your chosen Subscription Plan.
You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal by heading to your Account Settings after purchase. Need assistance? Our Customer Support is here to help.
Disclaimer: Contains AI-generated content & synthetic performers by Tightrope Interactive, Inc.
Privacy Policy: https://skaiweather.com/privacy-policy/
Terms: https://skaiweather.com/terms-of-service/

Meet new Filipino friends from all over the world. Find people that match your interests. Connect and start conversations through live streams on Kumu.

We make it easy for you to meet new pals! kumu’s video livestream feature allows you to stream solo, or co-host with up to 9 streamers. Feeling shy? Kumu’s audio-only stream allows you to casually converse without the pressure.

Ready to hang out and have fun? Download Kumu now for free, and join the Kumunity! For more information, visit www.kumu.ph
For all the latest updates and happenings, follow us here!

Organize, Discover, and Connect: The Ultimate App for Movie Buffs and Binge-Watchers.

WHY DOWNLOAD WATCHFOLIO?
A Complete Movie & TV Tracker

The Social Network for Entertainment
Watchfolio has evolved. Connect with friends and other pop culture enthusiasts:
- Social Feed: See what your friends are watching and rating in real time.

- Detailed Profiles: Follow users with similar taste and expand your horizons.

Your journey through the world of movies and TV starts here.
Download Watchfolio now and turn every play into a story worth sharing.

bluejetty:00029041:ios.name: Phonics & ABC: Learn to Read
bluejetty:00029041:ios.summary:
The Phonics app for children is a powerful educational tool designed to teach children the 44 phonemes and letter sounds through fun and interactive read along books, learning activities, and flashcards. 
Developed by Smart Kidz Club with
bluejetty:00029041:ios.description:
The Phonics app for children is a powerful educational tool designed to teach children the 44 phonemes and letter sounds through fun and interactive read along books, learning activities, and flashcards. 
Developed by Smart Kidz Club with the "just right" reading condition without any animations and distractions, this app uses human voice narration and is designed to make learning phonics focused, easy, and enjoyable for young children.
The Phonics app will help children
• Build a solid letter sound knowledge
• Help with speech and language development
• Enhance their early literacy and reading skills
• Get a head start at school with higher reading readiness
The app introduces children to each of the 44 phonemes (letter sounds) and their corresponding graphemes, letters that make up that sound.
Each phoneme is taught through a list of that contains that sound and is supported by an image. There is a separate book and flashcard for the beginning, middle, and ending sounds of vowels, consonants, and digraphs.
Once children have learned the phonemes and letter sounds, they can move on to the practice activities. These learning activities are designed to help children practice their phonics skills such as matching sounds to pictures. 
The activities are interactive and provide immediate feedback, allowing children to learn from their mistakes and improve their phonics skills.
The app also includes a comprehensive set of flashcards that children can use to practice their phonics skills. 
The flashcards are organized by phoneme and include pictures and words that use the corresponding sound. Children can swipe through the flashcards at their own pace, listening to the sound and practicing saying the word. This feature is perfect for children who prefer to learn at their own pace and for parents who want to help their children practice phonics skills outside of the app.
The Phonics app for children is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive, with simple navigation and clear instructions. The app is suitable for children of all ages, from preschoolers to early elementary school students. It can be used both in the classroom and at home.
The Phonics app for children is an excellent tool for teaching children the 44 phonemes and letter sounds. Whether used in the classroom or at home, the Phonics app for children is an excellent tool for supporting children's literacy development.

bluejetty:00090288:ios.description:
Proposal is the first free Muslim matrimonial and wedding planners app, now also helping you find your spouse through your local masjid.
Marriages are a big part of your life, and weddings are even bigger in the Muslim community. Whether you're looking for a spouse, planning your dream wedding, or hoping to meet someone through your local masjid, you can do it all on Proposal.
New: Proposal at the Masjid
Now launching soon: a first-of-its-kind masjid matchmaking feature.
We’re partnering with mosques to help you find the ONE, faith-based matchmaking experiences. Join the waitlist in the app and be part of the next chapter of intentional Muslim matchmaking.
Proposal Marriage App
Proposal is a free, fast-growing Muslim marriage app that helps you find your ideal spouse through AI-powered compatibility matching. Answer psychology-based questions like “Are you an introvert or extrovert?” and get matched with other Muslim singles based on your personality and values.
On Proposal, likes and matches expire after 48 hours, no ghosting, no endless waiting. Everyone, regardless of gender, both gender must make a move within 48 hours, encouraging serious Muslim matchmaking.
Proposal hosts the best Muslim singles events, halal, safe, and culturally respectful. Our IRL events are structured, fun, and designed for meaningful in-person connections. Find weekly and monthly events near you, only on the Proposal app.
Proposal: Muslim Wedding Planners App
The proposal is the world’s first wedding planner app. On Proposal Wedding Planners, you can find Muslim wedding vendors such as your Muslim makeup artists for your big day or Hijabi photographer to capture the best moment of your life, Muslim DJs who know exactly when and what song to play at your wedding, and Halal caterers, all based on your location or worldwide from your comfort zone.
KEY FEATURES:
- Likes & Matches Expire After 48 hours. Believe us, no one likes to be ghosted.
- Chats expire after 48 hours.
- Match based on your compatibility.
- In-person weekly and monthly meetups, speed dating, and networking events.
- Find your favourite Muslim makeup artist or photographer, or let your parents plan your wedding on the Proposal Wedding Planners App.
- Meet Singles through your local Masjids.
Safety Features
- Screenshots or video recordings are not allowed. We know sharing is caring, but we have a better way of sharing a profile.
- Add Guardian to your chats. Invite your parents to your chat.
- Private profiles. Make your profile blurred until you feel comfortable.
- Verified profiles. We manually verify all profiles on our app.
How does a proposal work?
1. Sign up today and create a profile.
3. Use good pictures and write a bio about yourself.
4. Wallah, you are all set; find your proposal near you.
5. If one likes you, you have 48 hours to like or pass them. Once you both like each other, you have 48 hours to start the conversation. After 48 hours, likes, matches, and chats expire.
6. Answer at least 10 questions to find the one based on your personality.
7. Take control of your privacy; go ahead and make your profile private until you feel comfortable with the ONE.
8. Find Proposal IRL events near you.
9. Get the proposal app to get married.
The proposal is available for free download and use. We also offer optional premium subscriptions (proposal coins for instant messaging and proposal premium for unlimited profiles, unlimited 48-hour time extension, unlimited profiles, and rematch).

https://proposalapp.co/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00187641:ios.summary: Benchmark Gensuite® Mobile is a best-in-class Mobile App enabling subscribers with EHS; Sustainability; Quality; Operational Risk and Compliance; Product Stewardship and Supply Chain Risk, and ESG disclosure reporting and management. Over
bluejetty:00187641:ios.description:
Benchmark Gensuite® Mobile is a best-in-class Mobile App enabling subscribers with EHS; Sustainability; Quality; Operational Risk and Compliance; Product Stewardship and Supply Chain Risk, and ESG disclosure reporting and management. Over 230K users and ~300 enterprises across the globe use Benchmark Gensuite® Mobile improve workforce engagement, gather real-time data, and accelerate issue resolution! Take your compliance programs & management systems everywhere with our Mobile App!
*Mobile Access & Actions*
Unlock the power Benchmark Gensuite® anywhere – not just on your desktop! With Benchmark Gensuite® Mobile, you can access audits/inspections, corrective actions, assigned tasks, and more while on-the-go!
*Photo Attachment with Drawing Capability*
Easily snap and attach photos and videos within Benchmark Gensuite® Mobile, whether logging a concern or completing an inspection. Drawing capabilities allow you to add detail to the photo before submitting, to make sure any issues can be seen and understood clearly.
*Scan QR Codes*
Scannable QR codes can be placed on equipment, locks, and more to integrate with Benchmark Gensuite® apps. You’ll never need to spend time searching for an inspection or a Safety Data Sheet again.
*No Internet? No Problem*
With Benchmark Gensuite® offline forms, you can access and complete key tasks from anywhere, giving you working flexibility without having to rely on internet access.
*Go There with GPS & Beacons*
Smart-tech like GPS allows you to quickly zero in on sites near you; connected beacon devices use Bluetooth technology to communicate tasks to your Mobile device.
*Quick Notes & Follow Up* 
Our Quick Notes feature allows users to record notes in the field without requiring an active connection; share them with another user if applicable; and manage follow-up to closure on Mobile or desktop!
*Voice To Text Input*
Benchmark Gensuite® voice-to-text capability allows you to work hands-free in any environment, allowing you to take notes and complete tasks more quickly.
To learn more about Benchmark Gensuite® , visit us at https://benchmarkdigital.com/

bluejetty:00080183:ios.description:
My Wallet (formerly MyTonWallet) is a secure, self-custodial wallet for everyday use across 11 networks.
Store, send, and receive crypto in one app covering Bitcoin, Arc, Ethereum, Solana, Hyperliquid, TON, TRON, BNB, Base, Robinhood, Monad, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Dogecoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Zcash, and Optimism, with more networks coming soon.
Here's what you can do in My Wallet:
• Easy on-ramp and off-ramp • Buy crypto and withdraw to a bank card where supported.
• Portfolio tracking • Track net worth, P&L charts, and performance across all 11 chains in one place, with flexible date ranges, token filters, and clear asset, chain, and staking breakdowns.
• Earn crypto • Stake GRAM and USDe and start earning daily rewards.
• Built-in smart agent • Talk to it in natural language to manage assets or get answers about prices, portfolio, and market sentiment.
• Gasless transfers • Send stablecoins and other supported tokens on TON and Solana without holding native tokens.
• Explore Web3 • Enjoy hundreds of useful decentralized apps, dive into DeFi, manage NFTs and Telegram Gifts.
• Hundreds of other handy features • Connect Ledger, hide balances, personalize the interface, send multiple transfers at once, view other wallets, and much more.
My Wallet is self-custodial by design: the team can never access your funds, recovery phrase, private keys, or passwords.
The app is open-source and audited by CertiK, with a top-7 wallet security ranking.
Install My Wallet and manage your crypto across major networks from one simple, secure place.

bluejetty:00127147:ios.name: SPORTSCHAU
bluejetty:00127147:ios.summary: Die Sportschau-App liefert dir die wichtigsten Nachrichten und Hintergründe aus der Welt des Sports. Mit unseren Livetickern, Live-Audio-Streams und Video-Streams verpasst du außerdem nichts mehr - kein Tor der Bundesliga, kein Überholmanöv
bluejetty:00127147:ios.description:
Die Sportschau-App liefert dir die wichtigsten Nachrichten und Hintergründe aus der Welt des Sports. Mit unseren Livetickern, Live-Audio-Streams und Video-Streams verpasst du außerdem nichts mehr - kein Tor der Bundesliga, kein Überholmanöver in der Formel 1 und keinen Breakball beim Tennis. Übrigens auch im Auto: Nutze Apple Carplay und verfolge dein Sportevent im Livestream.
Im Bereich “Live & Ergebnisse” siehst du direkt, was heute wichtig wird: Was läuft gerade live? Welche Matches gab es schon? Und wer spielt am Abend?
Fußball, Tennis, Formel 1, Basketball, Handball, Eishockey, Radsport, Wintersport und vieles mehr - alle Live-Ticker, Streams und Ergebnisse an einem Ort.
Bist du unterwegs und dein Verein in der Bundesliga spielt gerade? Dann höre dir das Spiel in voller Länge und ohne Unterbrechungen in der Audio-Reportage an. Wir übertragen jedes Spiel aus der 1. und der 2. Bundesliga von der ersten bis zur letzten Minute. Den Stream, den zugehörigen Liveticker und viele Statistiken rund ums Spiel findest du an einer Stelle - klicke dafür einfach auf die Partie im Live-Bereich.
Das funktioniert auch im Auto: Mit Apple Carplay kannst du dein App-Erlebnis ins Auto verlängern. Genieße Live-Sport beim Fahren, tauche in unsere Podcasts ein oder informiere dich aktuell über die wichtigsten Sportereignisse während du unterwegs bist.
Mit den "Live Aktivitäten" bleibst du immer immer am Puls des Geschehens – Echtzeit-Updates direkt auf dem Sperrbildschirm halten dich über Spielstände auf dem Laufenden.
Unter “Meine Sportschau” kannst du dir deinen persönlichen Bereich bauen. Stelle deine Lieblingsvereine, Lieblingswettbewerbe und -sportarten zusammen. Alle Infos und Ergebnisse zu deinen Favoriten sind dann nur noch einen Klick entfernt.
Du willst außerdem keine Nachricht und kein Ergebnis deines Lieblingsclubs verpassen? Dann abonniere die Push-Mitteilungen und wir benachrichtigen dich, wenn es Neuigkeiten gibt.
Du kannst dort auch den Top-Nachrichten-Push auswählen, um alle Breaking News und besondere Geschichten und Recherchen aus der Sportschau-Redaktion auf dein Smartphone zu bekommen. Oder du wählst den Push für einen bestimmten Wettbewerb oder Verein aus - ganz, wie es dir gefällt.
Du hast wenig Zeit und willst einen schnellen Überblick über die aktuellen Nachrichten aus dem Sport bekommen? Dann scrolle durch unseren Newsticker, hier findest du immer die aktuellsten Berichte aus allen Sportarten.
Im “Home”-Bereich gibt es wie gewohnt alle wichtigen Infos und Hintergründe, ausgesucht von der Sportschau-Redaktion. Auf der Übersicht gibt es den Gesamt-Überblick über alle Sportarten, swipe nach rechts, um dich gezielt über einzelne Sportarten zu informieren.
Die Sportschau-App der ARD und alle Inhalte gibt es natürlich kostenlos.
Für den Abruf der Livestreams und der Videos aus Mobilfunknetzen empfehlen wir eine Flatrate, da sonst Verbindungskosten anfallen können.
Wir freuen uns über Feedback, Anmerkungen und Bewertungen!

bluejetty:00166245:ios.description:

bluejetty:00099649:ios.description:
Meet Juno, your personal health assistant for life with chronic illness - trusted by over 250,000 users globally. 
Text Juno the same way you would message a friend. Say, “My migraine is 7 out of 10 and started after lunch,” and Juno can log the symptom, severity, and context for you. Prefer talking? Use voice instead.
Juno brings compassionate support, symptom tracking, medication management, energy pacing, health insights, and community into one place—without making you complete another exhausting form.
LOG SYMPTOMS BY TEXT OR VOICE
Too tired for forms? Simply describe what is happening in your own words.
Use Juno to:
- Log symptoms, pain, mood, energy, and health notes through conversation
- Record symptom severity and useful context without navigating long forms
- Talk through a difficult symptom day or 3 AM flare
- Remember details from your health journey
- Prepare questions and talking points for medical appointments
Juno personalizes support using the conditions, symptoms, and routines you choose to share, so you don’t have to explain everything again each time. No toxic positivity. No judgment. No pressure to “push through.” Juno meets you where your energy is today.
TRACK SYMPTOMS AND SPOT PATTERNS
Build a simple health diary that works even through fatigue, pain, and brain fog.
- Review your symptom history and explore trends
- Compare symptoms with activities, medication, and cycle information
- See how symptoms change across days and weeks
- Create PDF symptom reports to share with your care team
MANAGE MEDICATIONS
Keep your medication routine in one place.
- Add scheduled and as-needed medications
- Set medication reminders and mark doses as taken
- Review your medication history and consistency
- Share an organized medication list when needed
PACE YOUR ENERGY
Juno understands spoon theory and the reality of post-exertional crashes.
- Set your energy level
- Plan tasks around your available spoons
- Estimate the energy cost of activities
- Build routines that respect your changing capacity
CONNECT YOUR HEALTH DATA
Bring supported health and wearable data including Apple Health, Oura, Garmin, Bearable, Visible and CareClinic into Juno for a more complete view of your day. Review sleep, steps, heart rate, and activity alongside the symptoms and context you record.
FIND PEOPLE WHO GET IT
Join a chronic illness community shaped around real lived experience.
- Discover posts from people with similar conditions
- Join condition-based groups
- Share experiences, questions, and photos
- Connect through replies, profiles, and private messages
BUILT FOR CHRONIC AND INVISIBLE ILLNESS
Juno supports people living with fibromyalgia, POTS and dysautonomia, ME/CFS, Long COVID, endometriosis, EDS and hypermobility, MCAS, FND, lupus, arthritis, migraine, IBS, MS, chronic pain, chronic fatigue, autoimmune conditions, neurological conditions, rare disease, and other chronic or invisible illnesses.
PRIVATE, SECURE, AND IN YOUR CONTROL
Your health data is private and secure. We take privacy seriously and do not sell your personal health information. 
Juno is a supportive health and wellness assistant, not a doctor or medical service. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace professional medical advice. If you may be experiencing an emergency, contact local emergency services.
Join over 200,000 people using Juno to feel more understood, more organized, and less alone.

Privacy Policy: https://junocompanion.com

iPlayer is a powerful local music player that perfectly supports multi-platform use on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. With comprehensive audio format support, flexible import methods, and intelligent music management features, it keeps your music collection organized and enhances your listening experience.
Core Features
I. Full Format Support
- Complete support for mainstream audio formats: MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC
- Professional support for lossless audio: AIFF, APE, DSD, DSF
- Comprehensive compatibility with other formats: M4A, M4R, OGG, OPUS, WMA
II. Diversified Import
- WiFi wireless transmission: Easy and quick
- Local file import: Intuitive and convenient
- Video audio extraction: One-click conversion
III. Intelligent Music Management
- Automatic classification and organization: By album, artist, and folder
- Custom playlists: Unlimited creation and flexible organization

bluejetty:00099314:ios.description:
Cold Turkey – Break Free from Addiction & Reclaim Your Life
Join thousands taking control of their habits and living life on their terms. Cold Turkey is the #1 recovery app for addictions like fast food, gambling, and alcohol. Whether you're seeking a life reset, starting your nofap journey, or looking for a comprehensive dopamine detox solution, our proven system empowers you to reset your brain, rebuild discipline, and unlock your full potential. Backed by neuroscience and habit-change psychology, Cold Turkey combines the power of a website blocker, abstinence counter, and complete recovery toolkit in one app.
Free 3-Day Trial • Then Subscription Required for all features.
WHY PEOPLE TRUST COLD TURKEY
REWIRE YOUR HABITS
Our step-by-step recovery framework is rooted in neuroscience and behavioral science—the same principles used in smart recovery and celebrate recovery programs. We guide you through mental rewiring so you can finally break the cycle—no willpower exhaustion required. Think of it as your personal quitter coach and self control companion.
DAILY PROGRESS, REAL RESULTS
Replace temptation with motivation using daily exercises, micro-challenges, and reflection prompts that create lasting change. Our unfap-inspired methodology and detox me features help you build sustainable habits, one day at a time.
SEE YOUR GROWTH
Track improvements in focus, mood, relationships, and physical health with real-time stats and streak counters. Our built-in abstinence counter shows exactly how far you've come on your recovery journey. Watch your transformation unfold as you quit now and stay committed.
POWERFUL RECOVERY TOOLS
From blocking triggers with our integrated website blocker (similar to stoppr and quittr) to guided meditations and AI-powered accountability features, Cold Turkey arms you with everything you need to stay on track—whether you're quitting fast food, gambling, or alcohol. Perfect for anyone addicted and ready for change, our tools provide the self control you need when you need it most.
A SUPPORTIVE COMMUNITY
You're not doing this alone. Share wins, join challenges, and connect with people who understand your journey—from nofap warriors to those pursuing complete life reset transformations. Whether it's breaking one habit or many, find support from others in recovery who know what you're going through.
LIFE AFTER QUITTING
Imagine waking up energized without alcohol. Feeling in control when faced with gambling urges. Breaking free from compulsive gambling use through a structured dopamine detox. Reclaiming health and confidence by leaving fast food behind. That's the life you can build—starting today with quit now determination and the right recovery tools.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
A Cold Turkey subscription gives you full access to all features, programs, and content. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off in your iTunes settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
DISCLAIMER: Always consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns or before making significant lifestyle changes.
By subscribing to Cold Turkey you agree to the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA) (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/).

bluejetty:00100370:ios.description:
Welcome to Imposter Party Online — the ultimate social deduction party game you can play anywhere!
Ask clever questions, bluff your way to survival, and expose the Imposter before they outsmart everyone. Perfect for game nights, group chats, or playing with friends anywhere in the world.
How It Works
Every round, players receive a secret role. Most players share the same location or scenario… except one. The Imposter has no idea what’s happening and must fake confidence while trying not to get caught.
Players take turns asking creative questions, reading reactions, and voting on who seems suspicious.
If the group catches the Imposter — they win.
But if the Imposter correctly guesses the secret location before they’re exposed… they take the victory.
Features
• Online or local play with friends
• Beautiful, clean UI designed for fast and fun sessions
• Hundreds of locations & roles (with even more unlockable)
• Choose gameplay mode: locations only, roles only, or both
• Custom settings: number of imposters, timers, player count
• Fast rounds perfect for parties or travel
• Fun psychology-based gameplay — bluff, act, observe, WIN
• Premium packs with advanced roles, extra imposters & more
• No accounts needed — join any game instantly with a code
Why Players Love It
Imposter Party mixes strategy, humor and social chaos. One moment everyone is laughing — the next they’re pointing fingers, defending themselves, or accusing their closest friends. Every round feels different and unpredictable.
Perfect For
• Parties & game nights
• Family gatherings
• Traveling
• Discord/voice chat groups
• Students
• Anyone who loves mystery games like Mafia, Spyfall, Among Us, or Who’s the Spy
Always Updated
New roles, new locations, seasonal themes, and ongoing improvements keep the game fresh and exciting.
Think you’re a good liar? Think you’re good at spotting one?
Play Imposter Party Online and prove it.
Trust No One.

bluejetty:00028829:ios.description:
TapTap Match is a matching game where you need to pair tiles with identical pics. The task is simple - find identical images and link them together with three lines max. Try to solve each puzzle before the time runs out! 
How to play
Tap one time to select a tile. Then find an alike tile to link it with. Try to imagine a future path between them. The puzzle allows to draw three lines maximum connected at a 90 degree angle. Can you link tiles like that? If yes, you're good to tap for the second time. By the way, the longer the path - more bonuses you'll get. Use your brain and logic!
Doesn't sound challenging enough? Well, try the bomb mode, where certain tiles are blocked and very explosive! Or check out the sliding mode, where each row slides aside as you crush a pair of blocks. 
Why we love TapTap Match:
- Colorful collections of tiles with sweets, fruits and other cute images on them!
- More than 1000 levels
- Challenging extra modes
- Various hints 
- Progress saving puzzle game
Such a simple and cool application to relax and train the brain! What else is needed?
Try to download and play now!

bluejetty:00039817:ios.summary:
With Rejsebillet you can buy tickets and commuter passes for bus, train, metro, and light rail in all of Denmark.
If you are travelling one time from A to B, you can buy a ticket by entering your point of departure and arrival and complete
bluejetty:00039817:ios.description:
With Rejsebillet you can buy tickets and commuter passes for bus, train, metro, and light rail in all of Denmark.
If you are travelling one time from A to B, you can buy a ticket by entering your point of departure and arrival and complete a purchase. The ticket is valid for one progressive journey on the route shown on the ticket. If you accept localization, your point of departure will be your current position by default.
You can also buy a zone ticket. It allows you to travel unlimited with bus, train, metro, and light rail in the selected zones within a certain time period.
If you buy a Commuter Pass you get unlimited access to journeys by bus, train, and light rail within a specific area and a certain time frame. You can choose to buy access to DSB 1’ as an addition to your Commuter Pass. On Zealand you can buy a Commute20.
If you travel in the capital area and want to travel by metro with your commuter product, you can buy a metro supplement as a part of your pass. If you chose not to buy metro supplement with your pass and want to travel by metro a given day, you can purchase a supplementary metro ticket to gain access to the metro from day to day.
It is also possible to buy a ticket for your bicycle if you are travelling with the metro. You can also buy a supplementary ticket for DSB 1’ if you want to travel first-class by train from day to day. Each product requires that you already have a ticket that covers your journey.
Rejsebillet is developed by Rejsekort and Rejseplan A/S. Rejsekort og Rejseplan A/S ensures the collaboration between Arriva Tog, DSB, Nordjyllands Trafikselskab, Trafikselskabet Movia, FynBus, Sydtrafik, Midttrafik, Bornholms Amts Trafikselskab, and Metroselskabet to help create a cohesive public transport system in Denmark.
To start using Rejsebillet you need to enter your phone number, which all your future purchases will be linked to. If you are buying a commuter product, you need to enter further information, including name, email, and date of birth.

listings.name: Rejsebillet
listings.description:
With Rejsebillet you can buy tickets and commuter passes for bus, train, metro, and light rail in all of Denmark.

If you are travelling one time from A to B, you can buy a ticket by entering your point of departure and arrival and complete a purchase. The ticket is valid for one progressive journey on the route shown on the ticket. If you accept localization, your point of departure will be your current position by default.

You can also buy a zone ticket. It allows you to travel unlimited with bus, train, metro, and light rail in the selected zones within a certain time period.

If you buy a Commuter Pass you get unlimited access to journeys by bus, train, and light rail within a specific area and a certain time frame. You can choose to buy access to DSB 1’ as an addition to your Commuter Pass. On Zealand you can buy a Commute20.

If you travel in the capital area and want to travel by metro with your commuter product, you can buy a metro supplement as a part of your pass. If you chose not to buy metro supplement with your pass and want to travel by metro a given day, you can purchase a supplementary metro ticket to gain access to the metro from day to day.

It is also possible to buy a ticket for your bicycle if you are travelling with the metro. You can also buy a supplementary ticket for DSB 1’ if you want to travel first-class by train from day to day. Each product requires that you already have a ticket that covers your journey.

Rejsebillet is developed by Rejsekort and Rejseplan A/S. Rejsekort og Rejseplan A/S ensures the collaboration between Arriva Tog, DSB, Nordjyllands Trafikselskab, Trafikselskabet Movia, FynBus, Sydtrafik, Midttrafik, Bornholms Amts Trafikselskab, and Metroselskabet to help create a cohesive public transport system in Denmark.

Compatible with many IP cameras
Originally designed for Heden cameras, this app also works with many other brands like Foscam, Tenvis, Wanscam, and more. If your model isn’t listed, simply select the closest match from the list—it will likely work just fine.
Modern interface and powerful features
This new version comes with a clean, modern look and offers a wide range of features:
 • Image adjustments: brightness, contrast
 • Image orientation: flip or mirror
 • Control the LED and infrared night vision
 • Enable or disable the motion alarm
 • Adjust the camera’s movement speed
 • Select your camera by model photo
 • Advanced automatic camera detection on the local network
 • Automatic public IP detection for use over 3G/4G
 • Dual IP setup for Wi-Fi and mobile networks
 • Smart IP switching based on your connection
Remote access made easy
To use your camera over 3G/4G, you’ll just need to set up port forwarding on your router. This is the only manual step required.
Need help?
If you experience any configuration issues, you can easily send a support request through the app’s menu.
Remove ads
A one-time in-app purchase is available to permanently remove ads and support future development.

bluejetty:00180480:ios.summary: Battle Run is here, in a brand new non stop action filled experience! Fire your weapons, free your team, defeat the invading bots in high-speed epic battle runs across the royale Island to save it from the influx of menacing robots! Smash c
bluejetty:00180480:ios.description:
Battle Run is here, in a brand new non stop action filled experience! Fire your weapons, free your team, defeat the invading bots in high-speed epic battle runs across the royale Island to save it from the influx of menacing robots! Smash crates, avoid obstacles and defeat the oncoming enemies…Can you defeat the bot bosses? – all with thousands of possible character combinations!
** Battle Run is a brand new endless running experience **
- Run, slide and jump with your favorite battle royale characters.
- Play across iconic locations and explore the suburbs , the forest, the epic evil robot fort and so many more!
- Surf into Portals that will transport you to a secret location to complete in missions and find secret items
- Battle the best bosses across the island and unlock cool rewards.
- Build up your running skills and scout the Island to defeat all Robot minions in epic battles.
- Beat them with style: customize for extra XP points!
- Drop into the gameplay with your glider
- Get a better view of the landscape while riding the flying PInata! Pinata Party Time!
Upgrade your weapons and hoverboards and make quick work of your task!
- Crash into different crates to collect your upgrades
- Go on battle runs and unlock rewards to build up, upgrade and customize your runner.
- Go on the run and unlock challenges, characters and rewards to give your game a boost.
- Classic endless runner gameplay with a shooter spin.
Shoot your gun to take out the cool robot enemies from afar. Enter the portal missions to take out as many bad guys as you can to earn stars. Watch out for the boss robot. You can also perform new special attacks against robots by running at them like flying kicking the robot minions. Collect ammo boxes to get more bullets to fire. Blast through the walls of the robot base using your gun, there are 15 amazing guns to collect, including the tommy gun and the missile. As well as fun and wacky shooters like the pizza tosser.
Wall run to pass over and around enemies to collect coins and tokens. You can use tokens to upgrade your character or to unlock new special characters. 
Avoid vehicles like cars, buses and taxis as you rush through the streets, hop on to your hoverboard to enter super fast action. Dodge the crazy drivers in this dynamic 3D world. With miles of roads and turns you can dash through the city for hours. Each environment has unique gameplay features to increase the fun, avoid barrels and run through the cabins in the forest, fight robots and avoid electricity in the robot fort and watch out for traffic in the city.
Collect the rare Keys to unlock legendary chest to unlock super rare character tokens, hoards of experience and epic guns and boards.
Characters are unlocked for free by levelling up, you do not need to buy characters. There are 100 levels for you to unlock, battle the robots, compete in portal challenges and open supply crates to get experience. With easy and hard daily missions there is an unlimited amount of objectives to provide non-stop action.
a 
From the team that brought you Angry Gran Run brings you a brand new adventure that brings the best parts of endless running and mixes in extreme competition with battle royale gameplay!

bluejetty:00016449:ios.description:
From the creators of Puzzle Quest comes the ultimate evolution of the Puzzle-RPG-Strategy mashup, Gems of War!
Immerse yourself in a world of adventure as you collect heroes from across the realm and battle foes with the power of the puzzle board. Unlock new realms with kingdoms to conquer and hundreds of troops to collect.Join the war and start your journey to becoming a puzzle legend today!
Features: 
Match-3 Puzzles - Dive into this fun, easy to play puzzle game where you match gems for crazy combos
Build Your Team of Heroes - Collect over 300 troops and unlock spells to attack your enemies
Play Endless Mini Games - Enjoy different modes of play with a robust catalog of side activities and mini games
Conquer New Realms - Unlock the Krystara & Underworld maps with over 30 Kingdoms and 350 Quests to complete
Complete Weekly Events - Join live events and complete endless puzzle missions
Collect Daily Bonuses - Login daily to collect free bonus rewards
Play With Friends - Battle in asynchronous PvP and rise up the global ranks
Fans Have Spoken – reviews from real players:
“This game is Awesome! Challenging and entertaining. Not just some gem or gummy game. Terrific find!”
“This is like the version of Puzzle Quest I never knew I wanted. Oodles of quests, challenges, guild activities, cool monsters, arena fights, ranked fights, and man I could just play that treasure mini game all day.”
“This is gems and fee to play done right. You don't need to spend money but if you can, you will. It won't make you overpowered, but you will have fun with it. The game play is great and varied. There are tons of different options.”
“Different than other match 3 games, very fun and addicting. Keeps me entertained for hours.”
“This game is FANTASTIC! I was a huge fan of the original game 
"Puzzle Quest" and this game is created by the same people. The other "Puzzle Quest" sequels have been disappointments and I haven't enjoyed them. This game however, has the same great game play.”
“It's refreshing to see a game without timers or stamina. I can play this game for hours without needing to wait.”
“This helped cure me of candy crush.”
“Over the years, many games have come and gone on my phone. But this one is always there. Free. No ads. No limited-play "lives" (think Candy Crush). No real downside. Your standard colored-gem matching game with a wonderfully nerdy twist!”
“My wife almost leave me because of this game, and it happened twice. Nuff said."

bluejetty:00123825:ios.description:
Death is not the end.
Play as a failed alchemic experiment and explore the sprawling, ever-changing castle to find out what happened on this gloomy island…! 
That is, assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers.
Dead Cells is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.
Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.
First available on PC and consoles, the indie hit Dead Cells is now slaying foes on mobile!
Main Features
• Roguevania: The progressive exploration of an interconnected world, with the replayability of a rogue-lite and the adrenaline-pumping threat of permadeath
• Frantic and Dynamic 2D Action: Learn your enemies’ patterns to stay alive, or prepare to be sent back to your cell before you can say “baguette”
• Nonlinear Progression: Unlock new levels with every death, opt for the path that suits your current build, your playstyle or just your mood. 
Surely, the ramparts can’t be as bad as the sewers, right?
• Play at your own pace: Will you explore every nook and cranny of the castle, or rush to the end?
*Latest updates are available: Clean Cut & The End is Near*
RETURN TO CASTLEVANIA DLC
Time for some vampire slaying
• New storyline - overcome the Ruler of Darkness alongside Alucard and Richter Belmont,
• 2 new biomes - Explore Dracula's Castle and its outskirts
• 9 new monsters - Werewolves, haunted armors, and medusas are waiting for you
• 14 new weapons - wield the Vampire Killer or the Holy Water to defeat creatures of the night,
• 3 new bosses - go fangs to fangs against Death and Dracula himself
• 20 new outfits - dress as your favorite Castlevania characters such as Simon and Richter Belmont or Alucard
• Alternative soundtracks - play along 51 Castlevania original tracks and 12 tunes reimagined in the style of Dead Cells
THE BAD SEED DLC
You reap what you sow
• New levels to lose your head in the not-so-peaceful Dilapidated Arboretum and the noxious Morass of the Banished
• New monsters to rip to pieces: get to know the locals, such as the Jerkshroom and the Yeeter
• New weapons to play with: trim sticking-out heads with the Scythe Claw, or make them dance to the sound of the Rhythm n' Bouzouki
• New boss to fight against: Mama Tick is dying to meet you
FATAL FALLS DLC
Ready for a leap of faith?
• 3 new biomes - Get some fresh air at the Fractured Shrines, splash around at the Undying Shores and take a picture at the Mausoleum
• 8 new monsters - The Cold Blooded Guardians and their friends would love to teach you about their culture. ... Wait, aren't those relatives of yours in the Undying Shores...?
• 7 new weapons - Lil' Serenade is perfect for breaking the ice with the locals, although the Snake Fangs would make for a perfect souvenir...
• 1 new boss - The Scarecrow is very proud of his gardening skills and won't hesitate to show off
QUEEN AND THE SEA DLC
Take it to the sea!
• 2 new biomes - Battle your way through a rotten shipwreck, or scale a burning lighthouse and confront your deadliest foe yet.
• 9 new weapons, including a throwable shark, a trident and a pirate hook hand (eyepatch not included). 
• 2 new bosses - Don't lose your head before you meet the Queen!
This DLC also gives you the usual extras: 
- A not-so-cute pet. 
- Loads of new outfits. 
- New enemies to bash.
WARNING: Devices with less than 2 Gb of RAM may not be able to run this content correctly. We recommend not to take this DLC if your device is under 2gb of RAM.
Carefully redesigned for mobile with a revamped interface
• Two game modes available: Original & Auto-Hit
• Custom controls & More touch controls options available: Change the buttons’ position and size to your liking, swipe to dodge…
• MFi external controller support
• No ads, no F2P mechanics!
If you run into a problem, please contact us at support@playdigious.mail.helpshift.com
 with as much information as possible on the issue.

bluejetty:00031939:ios.description:
UNLOCK EVERY MOMENT OF YOUR MEMBERSHIP
Download the Life Time app and unlock everything your membership includes. Reserve studio classes, connect with a Dynamic Personal Trainer, order from the LifeCafe, book LifeSpa services, and track your workouts, all from your phone. Your membership, fully realized.
L•AI•C — YOUR PERSONAL CONCIERGE
Meet L•AI•C ("lay-see"), your AI-powered guide to the club, built on Life Time expertise. More than an assistant, L•AI•C is your coach, guide, and concierge, tailored to you.
• A concierge that gets you. Find classes, reserve courts, schedule appointments, and discover experiences personalized to your habits and your club. 
• Personalized plans, real results. Dynamic workouts built for your goals, schedule, and lifestyle. Whether you are training for a race, building strength, or improving sleep, L•AI•C keeps you moving forward. 
• Expert answers, instantly. Ask anything from "How do I recover faster?" to "What's a high-protein breakfast?" and get advice grounded in Life Time expertise. 
NAVIGATE THE CLUB 
• Check in to the club and manage your day from the app with hours, amenities, and reservations at your fingertips. 
• Find your perfect group fitness class, with 40-plus formats to choose from, including strength, cardio, yoga, barre, Pilates, and studio cycling. 
• Reserve sports and courts, kids activities, and recovery appointments in seconds.
•Order a meal or protein shake from the LifeCafe after a workout, or head to the Beach Club and order food and beverages poolside. 
TAKE TRAINING FURTHER 
• Get matched with a Dynamic Personal Trainer who can help you achieve your goals. Or experience the transformative effects of classical Pilates and Dynamic Stretch sessions. 
• Follow nutrition plans built by registered dietitians and nutrition coaches. 
• Get personalized workouts curated by L•AI•C based on your goals, preferences, and lifestyle. 
• Guided meditations, stretching, and breathwork help you recover intentionally. 
STAY ACCOUNTABLE TO YOUR PLAN 
• Follow a training program and track every detail of your workouts within the app. 
• Track steps, sleep, weight, and body composition in one place. 
• View your club visits and watch your progress build over time. 
FOR ATHLETIC EVENTS PARTICIPANTS
Training for a race takes more than a training plan. The app supports you from registration to the finish line. 
• Find and register for Life Time's premier athletic events nationwide, including marathons, cycling races, and triathlons.
• Follow expert-designed training and recovery programs built to boost endurance and speed up recovery. 
• Access your digital event pass and check in seamlessly on race day. 
FOR GUESTS OF MEMBERS
As a guest of a member, you will claim your guest pass right in the app and see what you've been invited to.
• Claim your digital guest pass and check in to the club with a simple scan. 
• Ask L•AI•C anything, from club hours to what to bring, and get answers built for your first visit. 
• Browse the full class schedule and see what's live in the studios, from studio cycling to strength training to yoga. 
• Discover club amenities, LifeSpa services, and the cafe menu, and see what a full membership includes. 
• Loved your visit? Find the nearest club and join the community in a few taps 
FOR CLUB MEMBERS 
ENHANCED FEATURES FOR OUR CLUB MEMBERS
• Check in to the club and sign up for events.
• Reserve classes, camps, and more.
• Order from the café, bistro, or book LifeSpa services.
• Manage your membership anytime. 
Manage your membership anytime, right in the app. Download today and start unlocking everything Life Time has to offer. 
Some features may require a Life Time membership. Consult a physician before starting any fitness program.
Privacy Policy: https://my.lifetime.life/policy/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00149445:ios.description:
PrefixPlus allows you to add the prefix number to phone numbers in Contacts at once.
Phone numbers with the prefix number will not be replaced but added to contacts.
For example, if you set the number "+81" and the label "Call(JP)", contacts will be updated as follows.
[Before update]
Home: 03-1234-5678
Mobile: 090-1234-5678
[After update]
Home: 03-1234-5678
Mobile: 090-1234-5678
Call(JP) Home: +81-3-1234-5678
Call(JP) Mobile: +81-90-1234-5678
(Caution)
Be sure to back up contacts as security against accidents. For example, if you back up to iCloud, you can restore contacts at some point in the past.
Please note that you can add prefix numbers to contacts synchronized with local, iCloud, Gmail only.

bluejetty:00044537:ios.name: Tape Measure App・Ruler & Level
bluejetty:00044537:ios.summary: Tape Measure App・Ruler & Level is a professional-grade digital measuring software for iOS. This high-precision application utilizes advanced AR technology and integrated smartphone sensors to replace bulky physical tools. Access a comprehen
bluejetty:00044537:ios.description:
Tape Measure App・Ruler & Level is a professional-grade digital measuring software for iOS. This high-precision application utilizes advanced AR technology and integrated smartphone sensors to replace bulky physical tools. Access a comprehensive suite of virtual instruments, featuring a smart digital ruler and a precision bubble level interface designed for maximum accuracy in any mobile environment.
Using advanced Augmented Reality (AR) and LiDAR technology, this app allows you to measure distances, heights, and areas with professional accuracy. Whether you are an architect, a contractor, a DIY enthusiast, or just need to measure a room for new furniture, our tool is designed for you.
KEY FEATURES:
◉ AR Tape Measure & Ruler
Measure linear sizes in cm, m, mm, inches, or feet. Simply point your camera and tap to measure length, width, and height of any object in the real world.
◉ Distance & Height Tool
Instantly measure the distance from your device’s camera to a specific point. Easily determine the height of walls, doors, or people.
◉ Area & Floor Plan
Need to calculate square footage? Select the corners of a room or surface to instantly get the area measurement. Perfect for flooring, painting, and construction estimates.
◉ Bubble Level Tool
Ensure your paintings hang straight and your shelves are perfectly aligned. Our precise digital level works on both vertical and horizontal surfaces.
◉ LiDAR Scanner Support
Utilize the power of the LiDAR sensor (on supported devices) for faster, more accurate scanning and room mapping.
◉ Save & Share
Save your measurements and floor plans directly in the app. Share them with clients or family members in a few taps.
WHY CHOOSE US?
- User-friendly interface: clean and intuitive.
- High precision: powered by Apple’s latest ARKit.
- All-in-one utility: Ruler, Tape Measure, Level, and Plan Maker.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
Subscribe to get unlimited access to all Pro features, including Area Tool, Floor Plan export, and Ad-free experience.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://measureapp.biz/Terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://measureapp.biz/Privacy-Policy.html

bluejetty:00013670:ios.summary: Start your reading adventure with immersive chat stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Whether you are a fan of terrifying horror tales, gripping thrillers, sweet romances, or funny comedies, there is something here for every
bluejetty:00013670:ios.description:
Start your reading adventure with immersive chat stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Whether you are a fan of terrifying horror tales, gripping thrillers, sweet romances, or funny comedies, there is something here for everyone.
Get ready to be pulled into stories that blur the lines between fiction and reality. Our app has a unique chat-based format that makes reading feel like a real conversation. You're not just observing the story; you're in it, living every plot twist and turn with the characters.
But that's not all! Unleash your creativity and write your own chat stories. With our easy-to-use tools, you can craft and edit your narratives, bringing your ideas to life. 
~ Genre Variety & Story Interactivity
Scary, funny, mystical, adventurous—we've got stories for every taste. Pick a story that matches your mood and start reading short chat messages that will keep you hooked from start to finish! Our stories include interactive elements such as photos and videos to make the experience even more engaging.
~ Reading Tracker & Favorites
Enjoy a smooth reading experience with our app. You can easily track how much is left in each chapter and the entire story. Like your favorite stories with a single tap and add others to your bookmarks for future reading. See a list of stories you've already finished and those you're eager to start next.
~ Story Creation & Editing
Have you ever wanted to write your own story? Our app gives you the tools to do that. Use your imagination to create the scariest, most mysterious chat story ever, filled with ghosts, vampires, zombies, and more! You can create complex characters, weave intricate plots, and build suspense with every message. Whether you're an experienced writer or just starting out, our app is the perfect place to unleash your creativity.
~ Chat Settings & Customization
Personalize your reading experience to match your preferences. Adjust the font size for optimal readability, select from various color schemes to suit your style, and customize the chat bubble shapes to give your stories a unique look.
What will you choose to read today?
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe and get right now:
1. Premium stories.
2. Story style customization.
3. Regular updates.
4. Content without ads.
Make your life easier with premium access: 
- Paid subscription is divided into 3 types: weekly, monthly and annual.
- The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $9.99. Monthly - $15.99. Annual - $49.99.
- The amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel a subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE it will be automatically renewed.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
- Any unused portion of the free period will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription.
- Please read our privacy policy and EULA
https://appenvisions.com/privacy.html
https://appenvisions.com/eula.html

• Share your notes via email, messages, and more

bluejetty:00127992:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00127992:ios.description:
TriPeaks Solitaire Classic is a relaxing, smooth version of the popular Tri Peaks Solitaire game. This card game is easy to learn and a delight to play.
Tripeaks (sometimes known as Tri Towers or Tri-Peaks Solitaire) is an original card game with simple rules. All you must do is match cards that are one higher or lower than the card in your hand. An Ace is both high and low, and you place a 2 or King on it. The longer the run the better. Use the free wildcard for when things get a little too tough. If you can’t find a match, just turn over another card from the deck and continue! To win remove all three peaks of cards.
Features:
* Many ways to score and bonuses, and our original Score Build Mode.
* Intuitive controls make playing as easy as breathing!
* Beautifully designed and easy to read cards.
* 20 different card layouts.
* Wildcards to help you remove the three pyramids. 
* Luxurious sound effects and atmosphere (optional!)
Tripeaks Solitaire Classic: Sophisticated, relaxing, and oh so satisfying.

bluejetty:00042641:ios.description:
Gear up, pilot! In Air Commander: War Shooter, you’ll take control of a powerful military aircraft and provide critical aerial firepower to your comrades on the ground. 
This is not just another shooter game – it’s an immersive war experience that puts you in the cockpit of a heavily-armed gunship. Your mission? Defend your squad from relentless waves of enemies using an arsenal of devastating weapons. 
Dive into intense battles as you face diverse enemy units, from infantry and armored vehicles to helicopters and drones. Each wave brings new challenges that will test your reflexes and tactical thinking. Equip yourself with cutting-edge weapons like machine guns, missile launchers, and even powerful bombs to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of war in your favor. 
The stunning graphics and immersive sound effects bring the chaos of war to life. Feel the roar of your engines as you unleash destruction from above and experience the adrenaline rush of aerial combat. With smooth controls and thrilling missions, Air Commander delivers an action-packed shooter experience like no other. 
Upgrade your gunship, unlock new weapons, and customize your loadout to adapt to different battle scenarios. Whether you’re a casual player or a seasoned shooter fan, this game offers endless action and strategic depth. 
Join the fight today in Air Commander: War Shooter and become the ultimate guardian of the skies. War is calling, soldier – are you ready to answer?

Whether you need a simple remote control for TV or a powerful smart TV remote, iMote transforms your smartphone into the perfect TV controller that works with all major TV brands. This universal remote app offers a seamless TV control experience that puts a smart TV remote and remote control for TV right in your pocket.
Seamlessly manage your TV control with a single app: adjust volume, switch inputs, launch apps, or cast your favorite media with ease. iMote is the smart TV remote designed to simplify your entertainment experience and provide a universal remote solution for all your TV control needs.
Download iMote now — the best universal remote for your TV — and unlock full control at your fingertips with this smart TV remote and TV controller app!
◉ FREE FEATURES:
√ UNIVERSAL REMOTE CONTROL FOR TV
√ SCREEN MIRRORING
Experience real-time screen mirroring with zero lag or interruptions. Stream your phone screen to your TV effortlessly, perfect for showing slideshows, watching movies, or playing mobile games on the big screen. This screen mirroring feature works flawlessly with your smart TV remote.
√ CAST MEDIA
Easily cast videos, photos, and music from your smartphone or tablet to your Smart TV. Enjoy seamless media casting with just a few taps using your universal remote control for TV.
√ INTUITIVE REMOTE UI
Navigate your TV with a sleek, easy-to-use interface designed to mimic traditional remotes, making your TV controller experience smooth and straightforward.
√ APPS SCREEN
Manage and launch TV apps directly from your phone. Browse streaming services and installed apps without the need for the physical remote control.
√ PERSONALIZE SETTINGS
Customize iMote to fit your preferences. Adjust settings for a personalized TV control experience with your smart TV remote.
◉ PREMIUM FEATURES:
√ NO ADS
Enjoy an uninterrupted, ad-free experience when upgrading to iMote Premium.
√ ADVANCED REMOTE FUNCTIONS
Unlock advanced playback controls such as fast forward and rewind, plus customizable button layouts for a truly personalized TV controller.
√ UNLIMITED CASTING & SCREEN MIRRORING
Cast and mirror any media without restrictions. Stream videos, photos, and music or mirror your device screen to your TV in real-time, completely interruption-free with this powerful smart TV remote and universal remote control for TV.
√ PRIORITY SUPPORT
Get fast, priority assistance with iMote Premium customer support for any questions or issues.
Take your TV control to the next level with iMote — the universal remote control for TV that combines simplicity, power, and smart TV remote features all in one app. Download now and enjoy total TV control!

bluejetty:00023044:ios.description:
Break history and wreck the meta! Asia's beloved RPG released in English with a new tutorial & jacked up rewards to gently guide you into the ultra-violent wastelands!
【Free stuff! Great values! 】
Enjoy tons of rewards every day! Get 20 lucky draws for free upon login to the game. Get the famous legend Zhao Yun for free after logging in for seven days. Get up to 30,000 Gold, an exclusive skin for free within the first week! A lot of bonuses will help you grow fast! 
【Top-class character paintings, reshaping Chinese legends】
We created a wonderful game world with a combination of fantasy and real history! Hundreds of top-class painters work hard to create a brand new design of the epic heroes with the combination of classics and modern tastes. We use fantasy paintings to reshape the famous stories.
【Strategic Combos! Choose your own ultimate skills!】
An advanced combo system gives you the freedom to craft your own strategy. Dozens of combos and synergies are at your disposal! A variety of training paths await. Fight with your wisdom and courage! Smooth cinematic battles give you ultimate visual experience!
【Evolve historical scenarios or experience the tactical RPG campaign mode】
The game has a unique Historical mode which combines the fun of a top-down RPG game with an advanced tactical battle system. Meanwhile, you may become legendary heroes like Zhao Yun and Lu Bu to re-experience the epic historical battles and create your own stories. There is always something to do no matter what level you are!
【Gathering together to fight for your Legion】
Once we become brothers and sisters, we will fight until the end of the world! Grow your legend with your friends. Fight against the most dangerous enemies and explore the mysterious Instances. Keep developing and growing to conquer the world.
Find more about the game news and bonus: https://www.facebook.com/dynastyscrolls/

bluejetty:00180286:ios.summary: Sweetwater is your VIP pass to pro audio equipment and instruments including guitars, drums, orchestral, electronic, and more. Check out daily deals and promotions. Browse gear demos and instrument news. Or get in touch with a Sales Enginee
bluejetty:00180286:ios.description:
Sweetwater is your VIP pass to pro audio equipment and instruments including guitars, drums, orchestral, electronic, and more. Check out daily deals and promotions. Browse gear demos and instrument news. Or get in touch with a Sales Engineer — your personal advisor for guitars, drums, pro audio, and live sound. Download today!
Why Download the Sweetwater App?
The Sweetwater app puts your favorite Sweetwater and Gear Exchange features at your fingertips for instant gear gratification. Whether you’re a daily deals shopper or a vintage treasure hunter, with the Sweetwater app, you’re just a tap away from your dream gear.
The Sweetwater app is designed for musicians, recording enthusiasts, live sound pros, content creators, and parents of aspiring artists. Experience our white-glove approach to music retail, including post-purchase checkup calls and expert product support. Join a community of fans who love music gear when you use the Sweetwater app!
App Features:
- See Front Page Deals & Demos — The Sweetwater home page is where you’ll find the latest pricing blowouts, B-stock, and giveaways. It’s also where we share current buying guides, gear shootouts, and tech overviews. Every day is a new adventure. Tune in daily for the latest!
- Explore 70,000+ Music Products — For over four decades, Sweetwater has been the professional’s choice for guitars and amps, horns and strings, bass gear and drums, live mixers and PAs, mics and studio monitors, and more. Shop the coolest music gear at the best prices with the Sweetwater app.
- Build Your Wish List — Are you the type of gearhead who keeps several wish lists at a time? You’re in good company! The Sweetwater app makes it easy to dream big and keep your favorite guitars, drums, and effects plug-ins saved for future purchasing ease.
- Increase Your Buying Power — The Sweetwater Card unlocks promotional financing on drum kits, guitars, and more, so musicians can enjoy new gear today and pay it off over time. See if you pre-qualify (with no impact to your credit score) using the Sweetwater app! The Sweetwater Card is subject to credit approval. See sweetwater.com/financing for details.
- Find Your Dream Axe with Guitar Gallery — Our on-site photography studio (Guitar Gallery) lets you browse thousands of acoustic and electric guitars and basses by serial number to then view each individual item in stunning detail.
- Buy and Sell Used Gear — Gear Exchange helps you turn used gear into cash. With the Sweetwater app, it’s easier than ever to create a listing, take photos, and publish right from your iPhone. The best part? Redeem earnings in the form of a Sweetwater Gift Card and pay ZERO fees. It’s the music gear marketplace you’ve been waiting for!
- Choose How You Stay in Touch — Did you miss the latest print publication of ProGear or Worship Connect? Request a copy through the app. You can also choose how often you receive special offers and gear recaps via email with the flip of a switch.
- Dive Deep into the Latest Tech — Access inSync news through the Sweetwater app. Explore hundreds of up-to-the-minute shopping guides — from the best headphones for podcasters to the best drum kits for metal — along with thousands of gear articles so you can stay up to date on the latest music tech.
- Rent Your Instrument with Confidence — Our band and orchestra instrumental rental program is getting more students into concert and marching ensembles than ever before! Are you interested in growing your musical repertoire by renting a saxophone, trumpet, or cello for a reasonable monthly fee? Apply instantly via the Sweetwater app.
- Need Help? — Access 24/7 offline support with SweetCare, our detailed knowledge base with tens of thousands of answered questions. Need direct support? Contact your Sales Engineer or reach out to our team of product support specialists directly through the app.

bluejetty:00094147:ios.description:
War Drone: AC-130 Gunship Military Game
Engage in Realistic Aerial Combat Warfare
• Command advanced military drones and the legendary AC-130 Gunship in this modern shooter experience.
• Take part in explosive firefights from the skies, defending allied forces and executing real-time airstrikes.
• Use strategic flight paths, locking systems, and weapon calibration to simulate real-life drone control.
• Navigate immersive 3D battlefields with accurate targeting systems and realistic drone physics.
Tactical Shooter Gameplay
• Enter the battlefield as a high-tech air force marksman with access to lethal weapon systems.
• Shoot down waves of hostiles in fast-paced combat encounters with precision and skill.
• Fire 25mm Gatling guns, launch Hydra 70 rockets, and deploy Hellfire missiles to wipe out enemy squads.
Simulate True Drone Warfare
• Experience realistic mission objectives based on military drone operations.
• Plan your attacks using satellite recon, engage in close air support, and simulate UAV command roles.
• Control weapon heat, ammo supply, and targeting drift like a real drone operator.
• Every mission requires tactical awareness, flight control, and calculated decision-making.
Upgrade & Customize Your Arsenal
• Equip your drone with customizable loadouts: guns, rockets, missiles, and countermeasures.
• Unlock advanced gear like signal jammers, auto-tracking turrets, and enhanced flight controls.
• Build the ultimate combat drone through realistic progression systems and gear trees.
Call in AI-Controlled Support Units
• Use reinforcement mechanics to deploy tanks, soldiers, and airstrikes.
• Coordinate air-to-ground tactics and suppress enemy forces from multiple fronts.
• SuperWeapons include EMP drones, cluster missile barrages, and drone swarms.
Varied Enemy Types for Shooter Fans
• Engage against:
 • Infantry, rocket teams, and machine gun nests
 • Armored vehicles and moving convoys
 • Attack helicopters, jets, and drones
 • Strategic structures and mobile bases
Complete Missions, Unlock Rewards
• Earn gold, cash, and rare upgrades by completing high-risk combat simulations.
• Conquer wave-based shooter scenarios, time-sensitive bombings, and escort operations.
Note: Internet connection required to play.
VIP Club Subscription
Now you can subscribe to the VIP Club for access to exclusive benefits.
Subscriptions are $7.99 USD weekly
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
You will be able to use VIP Club benefits for the duration of the subscription.
Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one week" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the weekly package.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information.
You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
Any unused portion of a free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a VIP Club subscription.
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

Bimi Boo Drawing is both fun and educational! 
Our game is designed to entertain while nurturing your child's creativity and cognitive development.
Our app offers many exciting features that are perfect for both kids and parents.
— Various topics: From animals and cars to dinosaurs, fairies, and princesses — there’s something to spark every child’s curiosity and keep kids focused.
— Drawing and Colouring All-in-One: Develops essential skills such as creativity, imagination, critical thinking, and hand-eye coordination.

— Colorful Patterns & Templates: Use playful templates — stars, rainbows, glitters, and more

— 100% Safe content: Age-appropriate materials ensure a secure environment, parents can rest assured that their kids are playing in a safe space.

Various Creative Modes: Dive into guided outline coloring, freeform sketching, kaleidoscopic mirror effects, neon-glitter magic and more — today’s favourites plus fresh artistic surprises in future updates.

Dive into a world of colour, creativity, and learning with Bimi Boo! Join our game and enjoy an experience that is not just entertaining, but also a stepping stone to a brighter, more imaginative future for your little one.

We always strive to improve and make your child's experience better and warmly welcome any feedback and suggestions.

bluejetty:00141730:ios.description:
宝宝记——守护孕期，记录宝宝
宝宝记是美柚出品的“以宝宝为中心”的孕育工具。从备孕、怀孕到育儿，宝爸宝妈不仅可以了解到不同时期的孕育知识，还可以全程记录宝宝的成长。宝宝记支持使用小视频、照片、文字进行记录，仅限邀请的亲友可见。
#主要功能
【记录成长】
支持小视频、照片、文字，记录宝宝的成长点滴；可以设置家人共享，牵挂的亲友，可以同时看到宝宝的记录；仅限邀请的亲友可见，严格保护宝宝的隐私。
【孕期助手】
模拟B超图像，清晰捕捉宝宝的每日变化；能不能做、能不能吃一查便知，提供孕期不同阶段的营养食谱；每一次产检提醒和数据解释，轻松看懂产检单；在线了解孕期症状，告别孕慌慌，让妈妈孕期无忧。
【育儿助手】
备孕到育儿，医生专业背书，权威科普的趣味小视频，从预测排卵到记录胎动，从怀孕到拍嗝，从胎教音乐到宝宝儿歌，从备孕知识到营养辅食……丰富的孕育知识，齐全的孕育小工具，解决宝宝成长中的小烦恼。
【宝妈社区】
千万宝妈在线交流，分享备孕、怀孕、育儿中的感受经验和生活日常；还有同城、同龄、同预产期的妈妈圈，轻松找到归属感。
【全面记录】
分类记录宝宝的身高体重、疫苗接种、吃喝拉撒睡、长牙换牙、宝宝档案；支持邀请亲友共同记录、仅自己可见、亲友点赞评论、记录多个宝宝、原图保存等。
【母婴商城】
每日精选品质有保障的特卖商品，宝妈足不出户买遍母婴好货。
宝宝记已接入HealthKit，可以从健康App同步您的运动数据。
#用户评价
NFeir：从孩子出生前开始用，记录宝宝日常，越攒越多。
虾球喵： 我从孕期一直用到产后到现在，可以免费使用照片和视频的上传功能，我之前手机坏掉了内存的照片全丢了，幸好之前传了很多宝宝照片视频在柚宝宝，不然真的要哭死啦 这个功能真的是特别特别良心！！！

listings.name: 宝宝记-美柚出品，原柚宝宝孕育
listings.description:
宝宝记——守护孕期，记录宝宝
宝宝记是美柚出品的“以宝宝为中心”的孕育工具。从备孕、怀孕到育儿，宝爸宝妈不仅可以了解到不同时期的孕育知识，还可以全程记录宝宝的成长。宝宝记支持使用小视频、照片、文字进行记录，仅限邀请的亲友可见。

#主要功能
【记录成长】
支持小视频、照片、文字，记录宝宝的成长点滴；可以设置家人共享，牵挂的亲友，可以同时看到宝宝的记录；仅限邀请的亲友可见，严格保护宝宝的隐私。

【孕期助手】
模拟B超图像，清晰捕捉宝宝的每日变化；能不能做、能不能吃一查便知，提供孕期不同阶段的营养食谱；每一次产检提醒和数据解释，轻松看懂产检单；在线了解孕期症状，告别孕慌慌，让妈妈孕期无忧。

【育儿助手】
备孕到育儿，医生专业背书，权威科普的趣味小视频，从预测排卵到记录胎动，从怀孕到拍嗝，从胎教音乐到宝宝儿歌，从备孕知识到营养辅食……丰富的孕育知识，齐全的孕育小工具，解决宝宝成长中的小烦恼。

【宝妈社区】
千万宝妈在线交流，分享备孕、怀孕、育儿中的感受经验和生活日常；还有同城、同龄、同预产期的妈妈圈，轻松找到归属感。

【全面记录】
分类记录宝宝的身高体重、疫苗接种、吃喝拉撒睡、长牙换牙、宝宝档案；支持邀请亲友共同记录、仅自己可见、亲友点赞评论、记录多个宝宝、原图保存等。

【母婴商城】
每日精选品质有保障的特卖商品，宝妈足不出户买遍母婴好货。

宝宝记已接入HealthKit，可以从健康App同步您的运动数据。

bluejetty:00082197:ios.description:
The Wetrooms is a surreal liminal space pools horror game
If you're not careful and you slip through the wrong crack in reality, you'll find yourself in The Wetrooms, where nothing exists but the cold, unyielding touch of endless damp tiles and dark pools. The oppressive silence broken only by the distant echo of dripping water, and the unnerving sensation of being watched by something just beyond your sight. The labyrinth of pools rooms stretches out in all directions, an infinite maze of dimly lit, glistening corridors and eerily still pools. Every turn feels dangerous, every step echoing louder than the last. Move quickly if you catch a glimpse of something moving beneath the water's surface—because it has definitely noticed you.

bluejetty:00098425:ios.description:
Core Feature Highlights
1. Intelligent Chat: Your 24/7 AI Companion
Deep Conversations: Powered by cutting-edge large language models, the AI understands complex queries, engages in chats, solves problems, sparks creativity, and even crafts poems and stories.
Multilingual Support: Supports 30+ languages, breaking communication barriers for study, work, or travel.
Personalization: Customize your AI’s personality (e.g., humorous, professional, or empathetic) for a tailored dialogue experience.
2. AI Real-Time Voice Chat: Natural Conversations Like a Friend
Zero-Latency Interaction: Speak and translate instantly with real-time responses, mirroring human-like fluidity.
Realistic Voice Library: Choose from diverse voices, tones, and speaking speeds, with support for emotional tones (e.g., cheerful, serious, gentle).
Scenario-Based Use: Language learning partner, mock interviews, travel phrase assistant… Your portable language coach.
3. AI HD Art Generation: Bring Imagination to Life
One-Click Art Creation: Input text prompts to generate 4K-resolution images instantly, spanning styles like realistic, anime, and abstract.
Endless Creativity: Use built-in smart editing tools to adjust composition, colors, and details, or expand infinitely from original artworks.
Commercial-Ready Output: Directly use images for design, social media, marketing, and more—unleash your creativity.
Subscription Service
Pricing: Offers VIP plans for yearly, monthly, and weekly periods.
Payment: Subscriptions are charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation and at each renewal cycle.
Auto-Renewal: Your iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. Renewal extends the subscription automatically.
Cancellation: Cancel anytime via your iTunes account settings. To avoid charges, cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or subscription period ends. Trials automatically convert to paid subscriptions unless canceled. Manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.qq.com/doc/DR2FUSktxSXJRR05s

bluejetty:00064279:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00064279:ios.description:
**Build your own city in one of best sim games on mobile**
Sim game lovers of all ages will enjoy this city building game that will transport players to a magical place of imagination where you are the architect. Escape to this tropic island paradise and build your own village or town. 
If you’ve fantasized about owning your own tropic island, starting from a barren island and building a city and world of your own, you’ll love this engaging simulation town building sim game situated in an exotic paradise of various islands. 
**Tropic Paradise Sim: Town Building City Game**
Gamers young and old can establish their own personalized resort on their own virtual beach in this deserted isle simulator and watch as it grows from a simple village to an entire town. We feel it is one of our best city sim games so far. Do you agree?
With great graphics and colorful buildings, escape your daily life and start this sim with a tiny town on your own personal virtual resort. As you play, your village will expand from a little to a big city, and eventually into a metropolis. Keep the simulated residents of your metropolis happy as you build so construction of ever more elaborate residences and businesses can continue. If you take good care of your residents, then the game will take very good care of you. 
Play by yourself, with friends, or be the city designer with the entire family. Appropriate for all age groups, the game allows players to unlock more exciting levels as they expand their little city and town into a big virtual paridise sim that they control and manipulate.
In this exciting construction simulation designer city builder sim game, build the tropical island village of your dreams, just the way you want it. You can establish whatever kind of little settlement you like on your very own island, from a tiny rustic village to a magnificent, bustling metropolis. The only difference is how much effort and imagination you choose to put into creating a world of your own. Let your dreams be the limit and your creativity carry you away. 
One of most engaging casual city building sim games so far. Get virtually marooned in this virtual world. Let it transport you to the land of your dreams where you rule over the world, starting with your own small town that you built up from practically nothing into the civilization sim of your wildest imaginings in this virtual island sime game world where you are the boss. One of our best sim games yet.
