Play by yourself, with friends, or be the city designer with the entire family. Appropriate for all age groups, the game allows players to unlock more exciting levels as they expand their little city and town into a big virtual paridise sim that they control and manipulate.

In this exciting construction simulation designer city builder sim game, build the tropical island village of your dreams, just the way you want it. You can establish whatever kind of little settlement you like on your very own island, from a tiny rustic village to a magnificent, bustling metropolis. The only difference is how much effort and imagination you choose to put into creating a world of your own. Let your dreams be the limit and your creativity carry you away. 

One of most engaging casual city building sim games so far. Get virtually marooned in this virtual world. Let it transport you to the land of your dreams where you rule over the world, starting with your own small town that you built up from practically nothing into the civilization sim of your wildest imaginings in this virtual island sime game world where you are the boss. One of our best sim games yet.

bluejetty:00133698:ios.description:
“On that day, corruptors… devour the realms. Will you reverse the destiny?”
Ever wanted to lead a troop of heroes from the past to save the Realms of another spacetime? Here, in Lost Realm: Chronorift, your dream comes true! This brand-new mobile game is an action-packed fantasy RPG with distinctive graphics and unique gameplay. You, as the Keeper of Rift Hall, will be guarding this lost land, wiping out corruptors, competing with players around the world for glory!
GAME FEATURES:
Exquisite Graphics with Unique Plots
Prepare to be mesmerized by the stunning visuals that brings the lost Realms to life. Each scene is meticulously crafted to transport you to a Realm filled with mythical creatures and enchanting landscapes. The storylines, rich with twists and turns, offer a compelling narrative for players to explore. What’s the real identity of Eureka? What are the secrets of all those Realms? Come and find out yourself!
Meet 100+ Heroes and 40+ Artifacts
With a vast array of heroes to choose from, each with their own background story, you can uncover their potential and abilities. Even heroes of lower quality have the opportunity to shine in battles. Unlock and wield divine artifacts that augment strength of heroes, further enhancing your strategic options. Collect all legendary heroes, unleash their power, and destroy corruptors!
Strategize Squads of Your Own
Customize your heroes in ANY way you want. Equip them with powerful gear. Enhance their skills. Upgrade, evolve, and promote them. Awaken them to unlock special talents. Tailor your team plan according to preferences and playstyle of your own. Adjust formation and seize the good timing of skill activation in battles to counter your opponents' lineups. What tactics will you choose to win the battle?
Tons of Modes and Rich Gameplay
Experience a wide range of gameplay modes that cater to different preferences and challenges.
-Glory and Outland Arenas: Test your skills against other players in thrilling arena battles. Compete in two different modes to climb the ranks and achieve glory.
-Affairs: Take on a multitude of assignments, each offering unique rewards and challenges. You may even uncover the unknown sides of the heroes as you finish their miscellaneous quests!
-Areopagus: Join forces with members from the Areopagus to face off against evolving Bosses in Elite Trial. Coordinate with your Leader to tackle different Lairs of Horrors based on each member's strength, aiming for higher scores collectively.
-Trials of Wonderland: Encounter a variety of brain-teasing dungeons, including Ancient Tomb, Fensalir, Trials of Light and Gloomy Abyss, each with its own difficulties. Test your wits in battles that feature Bosses with a myriad of skills. Devise multiple lineups to gain an advantage and emerge victorious.
-Enigma of Seals: Step onto the grids, embark on an exciting adventure with teams led by five other adventurers! Will there be fierce monsters or abundant supplies, reliable allies or tough enemies? As the toxic fog draws near, the imprints gradually emerge. Collect imprints, unlock the seals, and face the ultimate challenge!
Start this thrilling RPG adventure today, where you'll witness the clash, unearth the secrets, and shape your destiny in a world brimming with strategy. Are you ready to become the Keeper? The fate of this mystical Realm awaits!
Follow us on Facebook for updates, reward events and more!
https://www.facebook.com/lrchronorift/
You can also reach us via mailbox：
lostrealm@droidhen.com
PLEASE NOTE
Network connection is required.
Lost Realm: Chronorift is free to download and play, some in-app items can also be purchased for real money. In-app purchases can be disabled through your device’s settings.
By downloading this app, you agree to our privacy policy and terms of use. http://www.droidhen.com/Policy.html

bluejetty:00180629:ios.description:
MyBIAT est une application conçue en partant des besoins et des retours de nos clients. Hautement sécurisée et dotée d’un design simple et intuitif, MyBIAT est une application innovante qui offre à son utilisateur une expérience digitale unique. Elle sera continuellement améliorée avec de nouvelles fonctionnalités et des adaptations inspirées par nos clients et par les avancées technologiques.  Les fonctionnalités de MyBIAT sont comme suit :  
Accès à MyBIAT : 
-Un accès rapide et sécurisé à l’application, après la définition de vos coordonnées d’accès, par biométrie ou par un PassCode de 6 chiffres.
Suivi de vos produits :  
-Consultation de vos comptes, des transactions réalisées, des documents y afférents (relevé de compte, avis de débit/crédit…) 
-Consultation de vos crédits, de vos produits Projets Avenir, de vos placements, de vos produits titres ainsi que de vos comptes AVA.
-Téléchargement des attestations de régularisation fiscale relatives à votre Projet Avenir  
Gestion des cartes :   
-Consultation de la liste des cartes, des transactions réalisées, des avantages offerts et téléchargement de l’attestation d’assurance voyage pour les cartes éligibles 
-Désactivation et activation immédiate des cartes 
-Chargement des cartes prépayées BIAT en TND et en DVS
-Modification du plafond hebdomadaire
Virements :  
-Virement simple, planifié pour une occurrence donnée ou bien programmé sur une période, sécurisé en dinars et en devises, avec validation par code SMS ou par validation biométrique 
-Suivi des virements réalisés 
-Gestion des bénéficiaires: Validation sécurisée de l’ajout des bénéficiaires
Gestion de chéquiers :
 -Commande et suivi des chéquiers
-Association RIB au compte TuniChèque
Consultation des comptes des enfants
Autres services :  
-Simulateur de crédit
-Simulation assurance vie PA
-Marketplace BIAT Privilèges pour les services extra-bancaires
-Catégorisation des dépenses par carte et création gestion de budget
-Paiement des frais de scolarité
-Module d’assistance avec historique des messages envoyés et reçus de la part de la BIAT 
-Recharge téléphonique 
-Paiement des factures STEG et SONEDE et recharge des abonnements Tunisie Autoroutes
-Gestion des notifications push

Order your favorite meals and groceries and get them delivered straight to your door!

DISCOVER YOUR FAVORITE DISHES AND RESTAURANTS
Explore a variety of cuisines at your fingertips. From delicious pizzas to tasty burgers, including traditional Algerian dishes, order from your favorite restaurants in Algiers. Search by cuisine type, restaurant name, or specific dish. Whether you're craving couscous, shawarma, pizza, or sushi, Fast has what you need!

ORDER ANYTHING, ANYTIME
Need groceries? Fast also delivers your essential products. Order from supermarkets and shops: fruits, vegetables, dairy products, meats, baby products, toiletries, and much more. Everything you need.

NEW: FAST GO - PARCEL DELIVERY
Send and receive your parcels easily between individuals with Fast GO. A fast, secure, and economical service for your deliveries throughout the city.

SIMPLIFIED DELIVERY IN JUST A FEW CLICKS:

Set your delivery address
Choose a restaurant, store, or Fast GO for your parcels
Select your items and add them to your cart
Confirm your order
Track your delivery in real-time
Enjoy your meal, groceries, or send your parcels!

DISCOVER OUR PARTNERS
From local restaurants to major chains, Fast offers you a wide selection. Explore different cuisines: Algerian, Italian, French, Lebanese, Asian, and many more!

Download the Fast app now and make your life easier!

bluejetty:00131891:ios.name: My Pet - The Pet Record Maker
bluejetty:00131891:ios.summary: My Pet is the ultimate all-in-one app for organizing your pet’s health, records, and daily care. Built out of a love for animals and trusted by thousands of pet owners, veterinarians, breeders, and pet professionals, My Pet keeps every impo
bluejetty:00131891:ios.description:
My Pet is the ultimate all-in-one app for organizing your pet’s health, records, and daily care. Built out of a love for animals and trusted by thousands of pet owners, veterinarians, breeders, and pet professionals, My Pet keeps every important detail about your pets safe, connected, and always within reach.
Easily store your pets’ information, create detailed medical records, and track everything—from incidents and medications to measurements, expenses, and boarding. Collaborate with your veterinarian by sharing records securely through the My Pet cloud. Set reminders, manage contacts, customize your experience, and access your data anywhere.
Pet Profiles & Records
- Store detailed profiles for multiple pets
- Import and organize photos, videos, and documents
- Create complete medical histories: vaccinations, treatments, exams, visits & more
- Track incidents, medications, preventive care, vitals, measurements, feeding, and exercise
- Monitor glucose levels, insulin, allergies, health milestones, body condition and chronic diseases
- Record heat cycles, breeding, litter and pregnancies
- Generate expense, health, and activity reports
- Create pedigree charts and behavior logs
- Quick access to essential info with QR-based Pet Pass
- Backup & restore your entire database anytime
Collaboration & Cloud
- Share or upload records directly with your veterinarian
- Sync data across multiple devices
- Access records via web and cloud
- Export emergency files or boarding info in PDF or HTML
Tools for Everyday Care
- Notes for behavior, training, and activities
- Reminders for medications, appointments, and events
- Contact lists for vets, trainers, groomers & more
- Classified ads: post, browse, and respond to pet listings and services
Health, Safety & Guidance
- First aid guides with videos
- Pet care advice (feeding, grooming, safety)
- Symptom checker for dogs, cats & horses
- Physical exam checklists
- FDA food recall alerts & lost-and-found notifications (U.S., U.K., Australia)
- Parasite infection risk for your pets (U.S. & Canada)
- AI companion
Finders, Lists & Resources
- Vet, trainer, groomer & boarding facility finders (U.S., Canada & Australia)
- Dog park locator (U.S., Canada, Australia)
- Pet name catalog
- Dog & cat breed lists with comparison tools
- Handy calculators: chocolate toxicity, ideal weight, food portions, hydration & more
- Growth charts, BCS guides, lifespan calculators & more
- Online shopping & RSS news feeds
- Get pet food nutrition facts using pet food scanner
My Pet puts powerful tools, expert information, and smart record-keeping in the palm of your hand. Keep your pets healthy, happy, and safe with the most comprehensive pet-care app available.
Download My Pet today and give your pets the care they deserve!
Terms of Use & Privacy: https://mypet.com.gr/index.php/terms-of-use-privacy

bluejetty:00170990:ios.summary: Welcome to "Numbers 123" - an educational and engaging mobile game designed for kids aged 2 to 5. Dive into a world of numbers, counting, and basic mathematical operations while having loads of fun! This educational game is the perfect choi
bluejetty:00170990:ios.description:
Welcome to "Numbers 123" - an educational and engaging mobile game designed for kids aged 2 to 5. Dive into a world of numbers, counting, and basic mathematical operations while having loads of fun! This educational game is the perfect choice for kids who want to build a strong foundation in math.
Key Features:
Educational Game for Kids: Join our adorable character with a signboard as you pop colorful balloons in this educational game for kids. Each balloon burst reveals a number, and the character will cheerfully announce the quantity. It's a blast of excitement combined with fundamental math practice.
Numbers for Kids: Start with the basics by getting to know each number individually. The game introduces numbers one by one, helping your child associate them with their names. "This is the number 1!" Numbers for kids have never been this much fun!
Number Matching Fun for Kids: Dive into a world of learning and fun with numbers as you play with soap bubbles. Match the number to the correct quantity of objects, reinforcing your child's understanding of numbers.
Interactive Number Tracing: Let your child's creativity shine as they trace numbers with a lovable character who rolls up a ball of yarn. The auto-fill feature ensures that even the littlest fingers can achieve success in this interactive educational game.
Dynamic Games with Learning Elements for Kids:
Number Race for Kids: Get ready for an exciting race while counting to the finish line. This dynamic game combines learning and fun for kids.
Platformer Adventure for Kids: Jump, hop, and collect numbers while exploring various levels of platforming challenges (recommended for ages 5 and up). It's an adventure that's perfect for kids learning numbers.
Greater or Lesser Game for Kids: Challenge your child's number knowledge by comparing numbers in a captivating game (recommended for numbers between 10 and 20). This educational game for kids is a fantastic way to reinforce their math skills.
"Numbers for kids" is more than just a game; it's a comprehensive educational game tailored to the needs of young children. It fosters a love for math from an early age, providing a solid foundation for future academic success. With its vibrant graphics, interactive gameplay, and gentle guidance, this educational game is the perfect companion for your child's educational journey.
Give your child a head start in math and make learning numbers a joyous adventure with "Numbers for kids," the ultimate educational game for kids. Download "Numbers for kids" today and watch your little one's math skills grow while having a blast! Learning has never been this much fun!

bluejetty:00095293:ios.description:
Welcome to Infantoo Games, the ultimate sensory adventure for babies and toddlers! With over 40 engaging games designed for little ones from newborn to age 4, Infantoo creates a fun and interactive environment for early development.
Playing these games helps boost cognitive, sensory, and motor skills while fostering curiosity and creativity. Infantoo combines entertainment and learning, giving your child the perfect start to their developmental journey
All-in-One Infant Baby Games
Baby Mini Games: Fun tap-and-play games like changing glasses, popping popcorn, and feeding friends. Cheerful animations and simple controls help kids build motor skills and learn cause and effect, hygiene, and coordination.
BusyBoard Games: Digital busyboards bring tactile fun with themed boards like Simple (letters/words), Farm (animals/shapes), and Music (instruments/rhythm), designed to boost sensory play, motor skills, and early vocabulary.
High Contrast Games: Bold, high-contrast shapes, soft animations, and calming music support newborns’ visual development, encourage tracking, and soothe fussy moments.
Why Choose Our Sensory Baby App?
Sensory & Cognitive Play: Explore baby sensory games that stimulate sight, sound, and touch. High-contrast visuals help newborns focus, while fun animations and sounds engage toddlers in meaningful interaction.
High Contrast Visuals: Perfect for a baby’s first games! Bright, bold shapes and adorable characters like fruits and animals help babies build visual tracking and perception.
Busy Board Activities: Tactile exploration through simple controls and charming themes like animals and instruments strengthens fine motor skills and encourages independence.
Made for Little Hands: Infantoo is safe, simple, and intuitive, with large buttons, joyful sounds, and colorful feedback that makes learning feel like play.
Musical & Learning Games: Sing, tap, and dance along with rhythm-based activities that build auditory recognition and memory.
Features for Infant Development
Sensory Play: Bright visuals, gentle animations, and cheerful sounds engage your baby’s senses, encouraging discovery.
Motor Skills & Hand-Eye Coordination: Tapping, popping, and swiping games help develop fine motor skills and coordination.
Baby’s First App: A safe, distraction-free introduction to digital play, designed for infants and toddlers.
Fun Digital Toys: Interactive games mimic real-world toys, offering screen-based play that feels hands-on.
Songs & Sounds: Musical games introduce rhythm, sound recognition, and auditory experiences perfect for little ears.
Toddler & Preschool Games: Simple, educational games for growing toddlers, supporting developmental milestones for ages 0-4.
Gentle Games for Newborns: High-contrast visuals and slow animations designed for the earliest learners — perfect for tummy time and quiet bonding moments.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.timpygames.com/privacypolicy.php
Terms of Service: https://www.idzdigital.com/terms_of_service.php
Whether it’s your baby’s first app or your toddler’s favorite toy, Infantoo offers enriching, calm screen time that promotes learning. Download today and let your infant play, learn, and grow.

Refract is the screen time blocker that helps you build self control, reduce distractions, and block the interruptions holding you back.
Refract combines everything you need to stay focused and make progress: an intuitive task list to stay organized, AI-powered goal tracking to keep your big picture in view, personalized app blocking to clear mental space, and intelligent reflections that appear when you try to open a blocked app, helping you pause, reset, and choose your priorities. Distraction Redirect: Replace impulse opens with task prompts or motivational goal nudges

Motivational Nudges: Stay focused with reminders connected to your vision

Daily Task List for Productivity & Self Control

Whether you're trying to concentrate, reclaim your freedom, or build screentime control, Refract gives you the tools to choose intention over impulse, rivaling apps like Clearspace, Opal, and ScreenZen.
Refract is the screen time blocker that helps you stay focused and get things done.
Turn your phone into a tool for growth — not distraction. Download Refract and start your journey today.

bluejetty:00187753:ios.description:
Aplikacioni Autoshkolla është një aplikacion inovativ dhe praktik për të mësuar dhe përgatitur për patentë shofer. Aplikacioni ofron literaturë të detajuar dhe të përshtatshëm për patentë shofer për kategoritë A, B, C, C1 dhe D. Përmes leksioneve të strukturuara dhe informacionit të rëndësishëm, do të mësoni rregullat e qarkullimit rrugor dhe teknikat e nevojshme për çdo kategori.
Autoshkolla ju mundëson që përmes testeve, pyetjve, literaturës dhe kuizeve të ndryshme të përgatiteni për pjesën teorike për marrjen e patentë shoferit.
Testet & Pyetjet:
Aplikacioni përmban një koleksion të gjerë të testeve dhe pyetjeve të ndara në kategori për secilën kategori të patentës shofer. Ju do të keni mundësinë të praktikoni njohuritë tuaja duke zgjidhur pyetjet e testimeve dhe të merrni rezultate të menjëhershme. Kjo ju ndihmon të përgatiteni në mënyrë efektive për provimet e patenteve shofer. Përmes testeve dhe pyetje të ndryshme do të keni shumë të lehtë përgatitjen e Testit Final.
Literatura:
Aplikacioni furnizon një bibliotekë të pasur me literaturë të ndryshme të rregullave të qarkullimit rrugor, sigurisë rrugore dhe teknikave të shoferimit. Informacioni është i përditësuar dhe i bazuar në ligjet dhe udhëzimet më të fundit, duke siguruar që ju të jeni në gjendje të merrni informacionin e saktë dhe aktual.
Kuizet:
Një lojë argëtuese dhe edukative është përfshirë në aplikacionin Autoshkolla. Me lojën "Luaj & Mëso", ju do të mund të sfidoni veten dhe të testoni njohuritë tuaja mbi rregullat e qarkullimit rrugor. Duke zgjidhur pyetje dhe situata të vështira, do të zhvilloni shkathtësitë tuaja shoferuese në një mënyrë interaktive dhe argëtuese.
Profili: 
Përmes krijimit të një profili personal në aplikacion, ju do të keni mundësinë të ndiqni përparimin tuaj në mesim dhe testim. Profili juaj ruaj statistikat e testeve të kaluara dhe rezultatet e arritura, duke ju ndihmuar të vlerësoni zhvillimin tuaj dhe të identifikoni fushat që kërkojnë përmirësim.

After reading each passage of the Bible, the
bluejetty:00068825:ios.description:
The Bible app for kids! From Genesis to Revelation. "I Read - The Bible for Kids" takes children on an exciting journey through the Biblical account by means of short stories, no wifi necessary.
After reading each passage of the Bible, the child will answer a few questions to show their understanding of what they read. Includes a scoring system based on stars to help motivate the child. Your kids will love it!
== CONTENTS ==
- Old Testament (48 stories)
- New Testament (50 stories)
Some Bible stories included:
- Adam and Eve
- Noah’s Ark
- The Tower of Babel
- The Birth of Jesus
- Jesus in the Temple
- Jesus Teaches How to Pray
- Jesus Calms the Storm
- Jesus Walks on the Water
- Jesus Gives Sight to a Blind Man
- Jesus and the Children
If bedtime story time is a struggle instead of wholesome family fun, this education app can help teach your child that reading is a game!
== THIS APP IS KIDS FRIENDLY! ==
- Short stories from the Bible your kids will love to read!
- No advertisements
- No wifi needed (offline)
- No personal information requested
- Security feature to access parent section (for setting up users and in-app purchases)
- Perfect for car trips and other journeys, can be used offline, no wifi needed.
Your child will know they are making progress in the game when every correct answer is rewarded with a fun chime to encourage them to keep reading and learning!
By making reading the Bible a fun activity you can give your kids a gift that will benefit their education and encourage learning throughout their lives. 
For questions or suggestions, please write to:
==> hello@sierrachica.com
More educational apps in:
==> www.sierrachica.com

bluejetty:00063729:ios.name: Screen Mirroring Panasonic TV
bluejetty:00063729:ios.summary:
The best screen mirroring app for Panasonic TV!
Application to mirror the screen of your iPhone or iPad to any Panasonic Smart TV. No wires and no additional hardware needed! You can mirror any app on your iPhone or iPad to your Panasonic
bluejetty:00063729:ios.description:
The best screen mirroring app for Panasonic TV!
Application to mirror the screen of your iPhone or iPad to any Panasonic Smart TV. No wires and no additional hardware needed! You can mirror any app on your iPhone or iPad to your Panasonic TV.
Please enable DMR (Digital Media Renderer) in TV Settings: WIth your remote control, go to: Menu / Setup / Network / Application / DMR: ON
This works on any Panasonic Smart TV from the 2012 models onward. For the latest Panasonic TV models, please enable DMR (Digital Media Renderer) in TV Settings: WIth your remote control, go to: Menu / Setup / Network / Application / DMR: ON
In using the app, there will be a couple of seconds of latency (usually between 1 and 3). 
However, it is very suitable for watching movies, giving presentations, watching photos, and much more!
How the app works:
1. Make sure that your iPhone or iPad is connected to the same local network as your Panasonic TV. 
2. Launch the Mirror for Panasonic TV app. It will start looking for your Panasonic TV(s) on your local network. When a TV is found, please select it. When you use this app for the first time, depending on your model Panasonic TV, the TV might ask you to "allow" the connection. In that case, take your TV Remote Control and press OK to allow the connection from your TV to your iPhone or iPad.
3. Turn on notifications for this app. We will not spam you, but we will use this to let you know if your TV is working correctly or not. So please, please allow it, otherwise when things don't work as they should, you are left in the dark.
4. Click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on the TV that is currently selected. After that, you can just go to any other app on your iPhone or iPad and the mirroring just continues to run.
5. To stop mirroring, there are two options. (1) click on the red top bar that you will see on your iPhone or iPad. (2) Go to the Mirror for Panasonic TV app and click on Stop Mirroring.
Limitations and known issues:
DRM
Some apps block Screen Mirroring. This means that application developers can choose themselves if they want to block Screen Mirroring. For instance, Netflix, Disney and AppleTV+ have decided to block this.
There is a simple test that you can do to see if the app that you want to mirror has blocked Screen Mirroring:
Open that particular app and slide up Control Center on your iPhone/iPad. Then, click on Screen Recording and start recording the screen to your Camera Roll. Watch the app that you want to mirror and at some point stop the screen recording. Then go to your Photos app and watch the video that was recorded. If the recorded video shows the app you want to mirror, it works fine. If the video is empty, then the app you want to mirror does not allow Screen Mirroring.
You can purchase the Mirror for Panasonic TV Pro Version through an in app purchase.
The Pro Version has the following features:
1. Adds audio to the screen mirroring
2. Provides for free lifetime updates of the app
3. Gives the option to choose higher screen resolutions, like 720p and 1080p

Some apps block Screen Mirroring. This means that application developers can choose themselves if they want to block Screen Mirroring. For instance, Netflix, Disney and AppleTV+ have decided to block this.

There is a simple test that you can do to see if the app that you want to mirror has blocked Screen Mirroring:

Open that particular app and slide up Control Center on your iPhone/iPad. Then, click on Screen Recording and start recording the screen to your Camera Roll. Watch the app that you want to mirror and at some point stop the screen recording. Then go to your Photos app and watch the video that was recorded. If the recorded video shows the app you want to mirror, it works fine. If the video is empty, then the app you want to mirror does not allow Screen Mirroring.

bluejetty:00188057:ios.description:
The Amazon Relay mobile app is for carriers, owner-operators and drivers who want to manage their Relay freight on the go. From the grocery store checkout line to the parking lot of fuel stop, carriers and owner-operators can use the app to book and manage loads anywhere they get a phone signal. And truck drivers can use the Relay app to find the safest route for their Amazon cargo, along with site-specific information about facilities that makes entry faster. 
If you’re a carrier or owner-operator, you’ll like… 
* Load Board that makes it easy to book loads that fit your schedule
* Suggested Reloads that maximize drivers’ schedules by surfacing additional trips along their routes
* Post A Truck, which automatically books loads that match truck availability
* Trips page, where you can view booked loads and assign or update drivers
* Push notifications about important updates and announcements from Relay
Drivers will enjoy…
* Free navigation on truck-friendly routes, including routing to Amazon truck entrances
* Lane guidance that tells drivers which lane they should be in while approaching their next turn
* Notifications when loads are ready for pick up, when loads get cancelled, or when new loads get added to a driver’s schedule
* Load History, where drivers can view the last two weeks of loads hauled for Amazon
* Ability to report delays or disruptions to company dispatchers and Amazon
* Digital proof of delivery and bills of lading documents that make it easier to track paperwork
By using this app, you agree to the Amazon Relay Terms of Use (relay.amazon.com/terms (http://relay.amazon.com/terms) and Privacy Notice (www.amazon.com/privacy (http://www.amazon.com/privacy).

bluejetty:00083521:ios.description:
Use modern weapons against ancient foes in this ultimate tower defense experience. Conquer the Ages! 
Step into a world where history and strategy intertwine in Ancient Allies Tower Defense, an exhilarating Tower Defense game that blends time travel, strategic depth, and epic battles. Traverse 125 richly detailed maps, deploy 26 unique towers, and ally with iconic figures like Julius Caesar and Genghis Khan to fend off alien invaders!
DEEP STRATEGY AND ENDLESS VARIETY Strategize with 26 distinct towers and a multitude of upgrades in Ancient Allies Tower Defense. Each player's journey is unique, thanks to the game's extensive customization options. With 125 maps, 62 enemy types including 15 bosses, and 28 allied units, every battle offers new strategic challenges. Towers can be upgraded to enhance damage, fire rate, range, and more, adding layers of strategy to your defense. Each tower has a "super upgrade" that significantly changes its game mechanics.
UNMATCHED GAMEPLAY AND CAPTIVATING STORYLINE The year is 2089, and Earth faces an alien threat with near-impenetrable shields. Your mission? Travel back in time to recruit the finest close-combat warriors and bring them to the present. Experience the perfect blend of strategy and action, where each level demands fresh tactics and ingenuity.
REVOLUTIONARY FLYING PLATFORM MINI-GAME Introducing the Flying Platform mini-game, a groundbreaking addition to the Tower Defense genre! Command a battle-ready platform soaring through the skies, deploying towers dynamically rather than on fixed positions. This arcade-style mini-game offers a 5-minute strategic challenge where the goal is to achieve the highest score possible.
RICH CONTENT AND SATISFYING PROGRESSION Ancient Allies TD is packed with strategic content. Tackle challenging campaign missions that play like intricate puzzles, and dive into trial modes with varying difficulties. The endless progression system ensures every game session is rewarding and productive.
DAILY CHALLENGES AND ACHIEVEMENTS Infinite progression awaits with numerous levels, achievements, and rewards. Engage in daily challenges, earn valuable loot, unlock tower skins, and gather gold and upgrades.
COMPETITIVE LEADERBOARDS Climb the ranks and secure your legacy in the Hall of Fame. With seasonal leaderboards, compare your strategic TD prowess against others, driving you to continually improve and rise to the top.
Ancient Allies Tower Defense offers something for every tower defense enthusiast and strategy game lover.
Immerse yourself in this time-traveling adventure and defend Earth through the ages. Your epic journey begins now in Ancient Allies Tower Defense!

bluejetty:00029163:ios.description:
Number Match - Ten Pair Puzzle is a classic logic game with simple rules - match pairs of numbers to clear the board. This puzzle game is also known as Ten Pair, Digits, Numberama, Take Ten, or 10 Seeds. You might play this classic board game by using a sheet of paper before, but nowadays you can conveniently play it online on your mobile phone anytime and anywhere.
How to play
-The goal is to clear all the numbers on the board.
-A pair can be removed from the number grid if either the two digits are same (2 and 2, 6 and 6) or the sum of the two digits is 10 (1 and 9, 3 and 7).
-Tap on the two numbers one by one to cross out them on the board and get points.
-Pairs can be cleared in adjacent horizontal and vertical cells, as well as at the end of one line and the beginning of the next.
-If you run out of moves, you can add the remaining numbers to extra lines at the bottom.
-Boosters will help you to speed up the progress and get more chances to clear the board.
-You win once all the numbers are removed from the number puzzle blocks.
Features
-Delectable and enjoyable graphics
-Relaxing, addictive and challenging
-Classic logic gameplay with numbers
-No time limit
-Useful boosters: hints, bombs, swaps and undos
Number Match is an easy to learn logic puzzle game but may harder than you think when you play further. Take a break in your busy life and play Number Match - Ten Pair Puzzle whenever you feel tired, bored or want to relax. Train your logic and math skills while solving addictive math number puzzles!

bluejetty:00015482:ios.description:
MIO is an educational app for children aged 1 to 8, created by educators and speech therapists. It contributes to diversified child development in a fun, fascinating, and professional manner.

MIO skillfully transforms learning into a compelling game. Children learn their first words, complete speech exercises, and solve funny puzzles with great interest. Overall, the app contains 100 interactive exercises to develop speech and motor skills, expand vocabulary, and improve coordination.
INTERACTIVE PUZZLES
MIO offers puzzles adapted to your child’s age and skills. They stir up interest in the tasks and make them more diverse. Jigsaw puzzles intentionally consist of parts with irregular forms: this way, they better develop the child’s motor skills, coordination and special thinking.
МІО app features:
- Seven categories of educational tasks: jigsaw puzzles, learning words and numbers, training exercises, etc.
- Over 200 speech exercises: training cheeks and tongue, forming the most complex sounds (R, SH, S).
- Great for kids aged 1 to 8.
- Personalized learning program for each child.
- Parental control.
- Approved by children and educators.
- Modern animations that are captivating both for a toddler and an 8-year-old.
- Gaming process adapted for kids.
Parents across the world choose the MIO app. Download it and enjoy how easily and efficiently your child develops. Most importantly, all of it is possible with your minimum participation.

bluejetty:00098708:ios.description:
Ready to finally achieve on your fitness goals? Meet Chompy, your AI-powered health sidekick that makes nutrition, workouts, and wellness simple, smart, and fun. Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, eat better, or just finally learn what to do with that lonely zucchini in your fridge, Chompy’s here to help.
All-in-One AI Fitness Assistant
Chompy is powered by advanced AI to give you everything you need to reach your health goals faster - from accurate calorie tracking, personalised meal plans to custom workouts, recipe generation, and daily reports. It’s like having a coach, chef, and gym bro all in your pocket but way cuter.
Nutrition Made Easy (and Tasty)
• Meal Tracker — Track your calories with AI-assisted food tracking.
• Custom Meal Plans - Chompy builds nutrition plans based on your goals, whether you're cutting, bulking, or maintaining.
• Smart Recipe Generator — No more "what should I eat?" Chompy creates delicious AI-generated recipes based on your preferences and macros.
• Cook Me Something — Snap a pic of your fridge or pantry, and Chompy will whip up a meal using what you’ve got. No grocery trip required!
• Nutrition for Your Goals — Whether you're aiming for weight loss, muscle gain, or just clean eating — Chompy adjusts and evolves with you.
• Macronutrient Guidance — Know what to eat, how much, and why. No guesswork. No stress.
AI-Driven Workouts That Adapt to You
• Personalised Workout Plans — Get AI-generated workouts based on your fitness level, goals, time, and equipment.
• Workout Tracking — Log your progress, track sets and reps, and see your gains in real time.
• 1650+ Exercises with Tutorials — From squats to shoulder presses, Chompy has videos and tips for every move.
• Goal-Focused Fitness — Whether you're a beginner or beast mode veteran, Chompy tailors your plan to help you grow stronger every week.
• Dynamic Adjustments — Chompy learns from your performance and updates your plan automatically — smarter training, better results.
Built for Real-Life Results:
• AI Progress Tracking — Chompy doesn’t just guess — it knows how you’re doing and suggests what’s next.
• Fitness Journey Support — Chompy adapts to every stage — from “what’s a dumbbell?” to “I lift trucks for fun.”
• Weight Loss or Weight Gain — No matter your goal, Chompy shows you how to get there — with science and snacks.
• Stay on Track — Daily suggestions, reminders, and friendly nudges to keep you moving in the right direction.
Extra Chompy Perks:
• 100% Free to start. No nonsense.
• Sync Across Devices — Log in from anywhere and pick up where you left off.
• Smarter Over Time — Chompy gets to know you and makes better recommendations every day.
• Fun, Friendly, and Easy to Use — No boring menus or cold fitness trackers. Chompy’s got charm and bite.
• Fully AI-Driven — No cookie-cutter plans. Every meal, workout, and suggestion is tailored just for you.
Who's Chompy For?
• Beginners looking for simple guidance
• Lifters wanting next-level progress
• Busy humans who want fast, smart health tools
• Anyone confused by calories, carbs, or cardio
• You — if you’re ready for a better way to get fit
No complicated plans. No gym guilt. Just smart suggestions, tasty meals, effective workouts, and a fun little croc cheering you on. 
Download Chompy: AI Nutrition & Workout App now — and start your fitness journey with a buddy who really gets you.
Let’s get chompin’!

Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition or treatment, and never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read in this app.

bluejetty:00178820:ios.summary:
Goat Simulator+ is the latest in goat simulation technology, bringing next-gen goat simulation to YOU. You no longer have to fantasize about being a goat, your mobile dreams have finally come true!
Gameplay-wise, Goat Simulator+ is all abo
bluejetty:00178820:ios.description:
Goat Simulator+ is the latest in goat simulation technology, bringing next-gen goat simulation to YOU. You no longer have to fantasize about being a goat, your mobile dreams have finally come true!
Gameplay-wise, Goat Simulator+ is all about causing as much destruction as you possibly can as a goat. It has been compared to an old-school skating game, except instead of being a skater, you're a goat, and instead of doing tricks, you wreck stuff. more! When it comes to goats, not even the sky is the limit, as you can probably just bug through it and crash the game. 
DISCLAIMER
Goat Simulator+ is a completely stupid game and, to be honest, you should probably spend your money on something else, such as a hula hoop, a pile of bricks, or maybe pool your money together with your friends and buy a real goat.
KEY FEATURES
* You can be a goat 
* Get points for wrecking stuff - brag to your friends that you're the alpha goat 
* MILLIONS OF BUGS! We're only eliminating the crash-bugs, everything else is hilarious and we're keeping it 
* In-game physics that bug out all the time 
* Seriously look at that goat's neck 
* You can be a goat

bluejetty:00121884:ios.name: Pro Snooker & Pool 2026
bluejetty:00121884:ios.summary: By request iWare Designs has combined the free versions of Pro Snooker 2026 and Pro Pool 2026 including all in-app purchases into one game for a single price. Try before you buy, download the free versions of Pro Snooker 2026 and Pro Pool
bluejetty:00121884:ios.description:
By request iWare Designs has combined the free versions of Pro Snooker 2026 and Pro Pool 2026 including all in-app purchases into one game for a single price. Try before you buy, download the free versions of Pro Snooker 2026 and Pro Pool 2026 from the App Store now.
Following the worldwide success of its sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Snooker & Pool 2026, probably one of the most realistic and playable snooker and pool games available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and full 3D rigid body physics this game is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers.
The simple click and play interface allows you to pick up and play the game quickly, or alternatively for the more serious players the game includes cue ball control allowing you to perform more advanced shots including back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and ball swerve. 
So whether you want a simple easy and fun snooker game or a full on simulation this game is for you. 
Download Pro Snooker & Pool 2026 now, you will not be disappointed. 
System Requirements: 
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
∙ Supports iOS 15.0 and above. 
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices. 
∙ Game Center compatible. 
Game Features: 
∙ One purchase buys complete game, no hidden extras. 
∙ No 3rd party advertising.
∙ Localized to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments. 
∙ Full 3D physics at 60 FPS.
∙ Free online multiplayer games
∙ Free local network multiplayer games
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own with no rules. 
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against another friend, family member or computer opponent. 
∙ League: Participate in a league event over 7 rounds where the highest points total wins. 
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event. 
∙ Configure up to 3 player profiles to keep track of all your statistics. 
∙ Each profile contains comprehensive statistics and progression history. 
∙ Select your handicap level with 5 levels of aiming and ball guide mark-ups. 
∙ Select your preferred post shot camera through your player’s profile. 
∙ Progress through the ranks from Rookie to Legend. Beware you can go down the ranks as well as up. 
∙ Play against 25 different computer opponents spread over 5 difficulty levels. 
∙ Fully customizable tables, choose from over 100 combinations of table finish effects and baize colors. 
∙ Play snooker on regulation 10ft and 12ft rectangular tables.
∙ Play pool on regulation 7ft, 8ft and 9ft rectangular tables. 
∙ Test your skills on the non-regulation Casket, Clover, Hexagonal, L-Shaped and Square tables.
∙ Play 6 Red Ball Snooker, 10 Red Ball Snooker and 15 Red Ball Snooker based on WPBAS rules. 
∙ Play US 8 Ball, US 9 Ball, US 10 Ball and Black Ball based on WPA rules. 
∙ Play World Eight Ball Pool based on WEPF rules.
∙ 14.1 Continuous pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Rotation Pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Bonus 8ft snooker table for pool games. 
∙ Bonus Chinese 8 Ball table.
∙ Fully featured ball control system allowing back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and swerve shots. 
∙ Choose from various camera views including 3D, Top Cushion and Overhead views. 
∙ 20+ game achievements to collect locally or via Game Center. 
∙ Take action photos and share them via Email or save them to your device. 
∙ In game tips and help.

bluejetty:00183097:ios.name: BlackJack 101 Pro Trainer
bluejetty:00183097:ios.summary: BlackJack 101 is a basic strategy trainer for the game of Blackjack. This is *not* a Blackjack game. It deals hands and lets you practice choosing the best strategy. It has an easy-to-use strategy guide that shows the correct move for every
bluejetty:00183097:ios.description:
BlackJack 101 is a basic strategy trainer for the game of Blackjack. This is *not* a Blackjack game. It deals hands and lets you practice choosing the best strategy. It has an easy-to-use strategy guide that shows the correct move for every combination of hands. 
Blackjack 101 allows you to adjust the playing rules to match conditions commonly found in casinos, including the number of decks in the shoe, the dealer's action on a soft 17, doubling rules, and surrender. It also allows you to focus your training on the trickier hands: pairs and soft hands. Plus it has both a left- and right-handed layout, to make it easy to play with one hand or two. 
Introducing a new feature: Custom Hands training mode. in this mode you can choose any combination of player hands and dealer up-cards to practice. Only want to practice soft hands against a dealer's 6? No problem. Or practice soft 14s-16s vs. any dealer card? Easy. Or get fancy and practice a hard 15 or 16, soft 13 or a pair of 4's vs. any dealer card over 5. Any combo you can imagine. 
Features: 
- Four learning modes: random hands, soft hands, pairs, and a new Custom mode: choose any combination of hands to practice.
- Skill levels: Higher levels concentrate your training on the harder-to-memorize hands 
- Strategy guide shows all the best moves and highlights the strategy for the current hand and dealer card
- Left-handed and right-handed playing layouts 
- Many different rule configurations (1-4 decks, dealer hits/stays on soft 17, double after split, early/late surrender) 
- Keeps track of your stats: hands played, choices made, and percent of correct guesses

bluejetty:00062157:ios.name: DreamBox Math
bluejetty:00062157:ios.summary:
DreamBox Learning
Award-winning PreK-8 digital math program developed by educators with proven effectiveness. Awarded Best Math Learning Solution in 2019 by the EdTech Breakthrough Awards and scoring the highest privacy rating by Common Sen
bluejetty:00062157:ios.description:
DreamBox Learning
Award-winning PreK-8 digital math program developed by educators with proven effectiveness. Awarded Best Math Learning Solution in 2019 by the EdTech Breakthrough Awards and scoring the highest privacy rating by Common Sense Media, DreamBox is meaningful screen-time that kids love!
What You Need to Know About DreamBox:
• Independent studies from Harvard and SRI found that kids who use DreamBox 60 minutes per week improved their math scores by 60% more than kids who don’t use DreamBox.
• Interactive lessons with a game-like experience keep kids engaged – serious learning that’s seriously fun!
• Adaptive technology meets each learner right where they are and adjusts based on how kids are solving problems for a truly personalized learning experience that’s age and grade agnostic.
• Rigorous curriculum and rich learning pathways develop conceptual understanding, critical thinking, mental math skills, and procedural fluency.
• Students learn independently with built-in help and in-the-moment scaffolding for “just in time” support tailored to their unique needs.
• All student lessons are available either in English or Spanish and have closed captioning.
• Parent and Educator Dashboards provide insight into each child’s growth and proficiency to help identify learning needs and celebrate learning milestones.
• Using math proficiency insights, parents and educators can assign specific concepts or skills based on areas where additional support is needed.
• Reporting aligned to all state standards.
• Available for either school or home accounts. For school accounts, a school login is required. Contact your school for set-up instructions.
By downloading the DreamBox Math app, students will have access to its full preK-8 curriculum.
“DreamBox is such a fun platform for learning math for my kids. We have been using it for three years, sometimes as a primary resource and sometimes as a supplement to another program. Even when choosing another program, we keep the DreamBox subscription as a "go to" when the kids are feeling less motivated for book work.” — Fonda, Parent
“DreamBox is awesome! My kiddo loves it and looks forward to playing on it. I love that they are learning so much, and that they think it's a game!” — Jules, Parent
“DreamBox helps students understand the background information; making them stronger mathematically, conceptually, and helping them fully understand the material. That’s what I like. They’re walking away with a deeper understanding of math.” — Amber, Teacher
“DreamBox allows our teachers to really provide in-the-moment differentiation to reach each student where they are.” — Leia, Principal

bluejetty:00079011:ios.name: PetrolHead Open World Car Game
bluejetty:00079011:ios.summary:
PetrolHead is an open world car game with online multiplayer driving, racing, drift, tuning, missions, garage building and a realistic car simulator feel.
Drive through massive city maps, collect 200+ cars, build your garage, complete miss
bluejetty:00079011:ios.description:
PetrolHead is an open world car game with online multiplayer driving, racing, drift, tuning, missions, garage building and a realistic car simulator feel.
Drive through massive city maps, collect 200+ cars, build your garage, complete missions and meet other players online. PetrolHead is more than a racing game. You can leave your car, walk around the map, show your driver to other players, take photos and enjoy a social car game experience.
ONLINE OPEN WORLD DRIVING
- Explore huge open world city maps with different roads, weather and driving conditions.
- Meet friends and other drivers in lively online rooms with up to 10 players.
- Race other drivers, build your reputation and progress as a driver.
- Complete map-based story missions and earn reputation and XP.
- Own a home, spend time with friends and enjoy the online driving lifestyle.
- Run burger and coffee shops to earn extra in-game income.
200+ CARS AND GARAGE CUSTOMIZATION
- Build a garage with 200+ iconic and realistic cars.
- Drive SUVs, sports cars, hypercars, vintage cars, limousines, cabriolets, roadsters, off-roaders, pick-ups and more.
- Customize cars with body kits, wraps, decals, spoilers, rims, tuning and engine upgrades.
- Design your own garage and show off your car collection.
RACING, DRIFT AND GAME MODES
- Drift: Slide through corners and chase the highest score.
- Ranked Race: Beat rivals on competitive tracks.
- Parking Race: Park faster and more accurately than your opponent.
- Traffic Race: Drive smart through traffic and prove your control.
- Sumo 1v1 and 2v2: Push rivals out of the arena and stay in the game.
DRIVER AND CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
- Choose from a growing selection of characters.
- Customize your outfit and create your own driver style.
- Get out of your car, walk, run, jump and dance.
- Meet friends online, be seen by other players and take photos with Photo Mode.
CAREER, MISSIONS AND BADGES
- Improve your driving skills in Career Mode.
- Complete quests, unlock achievements and expand your garage.
- Earn badges for your masteries and display them on your profile.
- Progress as a driver, racer, collector and open world explorer.
REALISTIC DRIVING FEEL
- Enjoy smooth car handling, drift control and realistic driving mechanics.
- Feel the road with asphalt driving, traffic challenges, engine power races and open world exploration.
- Experience high quality graphics with natural lighting and detailed city environments.
PetrolHead brings together open world driving, online multiplayer, racing, drift, tuning, garage building, missions, character customization and 200+ cars in one free-to-play car game.

bluejetty:00017548:ios.description:
Get the AF247 app for 24/7 access to cash anytime, anywhere. The Advance Financial app gives you an at-a-glance snapshot of your loan so you always know exactly how much available cash you have. Other features include making payments, knowing your balance and starting and finishing an application online for fast approvals and same-day funding.*
The AF247 app puts you in total control of your cash**
- Check your available credit & credit limit
- Access cash anytime, anywhere
- Make loan payments
- Know your balance, minimum payment & total payoff amount
- Start your application on your mobile device
- same-day funding*
Location Services
While the AF24/7 Mobile App is running, it uses real-time location services in order to trigger geolocation-specific notifications.
We’re here to answer your questions and help with your application. Contact us by phone at 888-462-0535 or by e-mail at m.customer@af247.com.
Advance Financial delivers fast cash when you need it
Advance Financial loans are different from same-day payday loans, title loans, and other cash advances. With our FLEX Loan open-ended line of credit, you apply just once, then withdraw as much or as little cash as you need (up to your credit limit). 
Repayment terms are different, too. Payday and title loans give you only weeks to repay your full balance, plus interest. You repay your Advance Financial FLEX Loan or Installment Loan with conveniently scheduled payments aligned with your payday. Plus, with a FLEX Loan open-ended line of credit, you only pay for the cash you need and only for the time you need it. And as you pay down your balance, you regain access to funds for future cash advances. There are never any penalties for repaying either loan early.
Founded in 1996, Advance Financial is a family-owned fintech company based in Nashville, Tennessee. The company operates over 100 stores throughout Tennessee and online loan services in more than 13 states including Alabama, California, Delaware, Idaho, Kansas, Mississippi, Missouri, North Dakota, South Carolina, Tennessee, Utah, and Wisconsin. Advance Financial provides fast lending decisions on line of credit loans, installment loans, and other financial services, 24/7/365. Tennessee store customers have access to cash loans, check cashing, free money orders, bill-pay services, ATM services, Western Union wire transfers, and NetSpend Prepaid cards.
Recent recognition includes being named a Top Work Place in 2022 by the Tennessean and named a Best Employer for New Grads and America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes in 2022. Advance Financial has an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.
*Bank participation required
** Wi-Fi or mobile data is required for access. Deposit times for online loans vary by bank. Bank participation is required. Please see our website for terms and conditions. Please borrow responsibly.

bluejetty:00119835:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00119835:ios.description:
ABC Dinos is an educational game for preschool kids and elementary school first graders to learn to read and write vowels and consonants. 
It adapts to each child's age group, allowing them to choose the letter that they want to learn whether in uppercase or lowercase. 
In addition, ABC Dinos has English voices which allows the youngest children (preschool) to hear the words without needing to know how to read.
DESCRIPTION
ABC Dinos is an educational game for children. With spectacular results, the game makes it possible to learn letters and improve reading and writing, regardless of each child's learning level. 
The screen interface is attractive and simple allowing children to play alone without needing an adult. 
All this learning is wrapped in a magical story full of emotions, action and fun surrounded by funny characters such as Finn's family, our Dino, and the ""crazy"" ogres and their dragons. Help Finn free his family by collecting the magic letters that make ogres transform into funny animals !
ENGLISH VOICES
We have incorporated English voices to repeat the literacy activity words and statements. With this we not only manage to make our activities accessible to all ages, but it also allows us to incorporate auditory recognition activities, which are so valuable at this stage in their learning (Preschool and 1st grade). 
OBJECTIVES
 - Learn to read
 - Visual and auditory memorization
 - Discrimination of vowels and consonants 
 - Discrimination of the letters of the alphabet
 - Improvement of understanding
 - Learn to draw the outline of all the letters of the alphabet (vowels and consonants). 
 - Expand vocabulary with: animals, professions, objects, clothing, nature, etc. 
LEARNING GAMES
- WRITE THE LETTER
In this educational game the kids have to draw the shape of each letter. As a prize they will receive an image that begins with that letter. They can choose the preferred mode of writing: joined up or printed handwriting. At the same kids will also have the possibility to trace each letter of the alphabet in uppercase or lowercase. 
- WORD FORM
This activity consists of the formation of level-appropriate words by dragging each letter to its corresponding place. And since we know that this quite difficult, we will help the little ones by changing the shape of each letter as if it were a puzzle piece that fits in. In this way all children, regardless of their age, can progress with word formations and then go on to expand their vocabulary and begin to learn to read. 
- WHERE ARE THE LETTERS?
This is, without doubt, one of the most fun learning games in our APP. The child has to find the matching letter of the two cards as quickly as possible. This game aims to strengthen visual recognition of vowels and consonants.
- WHICH LETTER DOES BEGIN WITH?
In this activity the kids will hear a word and see its picture. They have to guess the letter that the word begins with. The auditory recognition of each letter of the alphabet and the expansion of their vocabulary are the two main objectives of this educational game.
ADAPTS TO YOUR AGE
At the beginning of the game it will ask about the child's level so you don't need to worry if your son or daughter doesn't yet know how to read or write. It adapts to their learning level and you can choose which letters you want to work with and repeat at any point.
Company: Didactoons
Recommended age: For children aged between 3 and 7 years old (preschool and 1st - 2nd grades of Primary).

bluejetty:00139801:ios.name: Grim Tides - Old School RPG
bluejetty:00139801:ios.summary:
* CLASSIC SINGLE PLAYER RPG *
Grim Tides delivers the soul of tabletop gaming on your phone. Build your character and explore a strange and dangerous archipelago in this story-rich turn-based RPG / dungeon crawler with roguelike elements.
bluejetty:00139801:ios.description:
* CLASSIC SINGLE PLAYER RPG *
Grim Tides delivers the soul of tabletop gaming on your phone. Build your character and explore a strange and dangerous archipelago in this story-rich turn-based RPG / dungeon crawler with roguelike elements.
* IMMERSIVE FANTASY & TABLETOP EXPERIENCE *
Explore a tropical world of magic, mysteries, and ancient secrets through immersive text-based storytelling. Every choice shapes your journey in an experience inspired by TTRPG classics like Dungeons and Dragons (DnD) and Pathfinder.
* STRATEGIC TURN-BASED COMBAT *
Master tactical battles against deadly enemies, challenging bosses, and conquer your own fear of the unknown. Every encounter could be your last, every choice carries weight.
* DEEP CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION *
Choose from 7 distinct backgrounds and 50+ gameplay-changing perks. Craft your playstyle with weapons, armor, accessories, and consumables you loot and craft.
* CAPTAIN YOUR OWN SHIP *
Recruit crew, manage resources, and navigate treacherous tropical waters. Hunt bounties, complete quests, and uncover secrets scattered across the islands.
* PLAY YOUR WAY *
Four difficulty levels plus deep customization options. Optional permadeath for extra challenge. Play in quick sessions or lose yourself for hours. No internet connection required (offline).
* FAIR & RESPECTFUL *
No lootboxes. No energy timers. No predatory monetization. Just a complete RPG with some optional and unobtrusive ads, removable forever with one purchase, and purely optional goodies for those who wish to support the game further.
* GRIM SAGA *
A standalone prequel to Grim Quest and Grim Omens. Experience the mind-bending dark fantasy universe that spans 3 standalone games - pick your flair, no prior experience needed.
Set sail, but beware: when the Dark closes in, your own mind is your worst enemy.

Search thous
bluejetty:00180690:ios.description:
Realising your property dreams starts right here with Domain. Whether you’re looking to buy, sell, invest, rent or research, at Australia’s home of property, we have the tools to make real estate easy. It’s property on the go.
Search thousands of properties
With new listings every day, we make it easy for you to find the right property. Whether you’re searching for a house, apartment, off-the-plan property or house and land package - you can filter down to the exact real estate you’re looking for. Search by suburb, address, school name or on the map. Then, set your filters including price, property type, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, land size or use keywords like ‘pool’.
See properties before other buyers
Know what you’re looking for? Turn on property alerts to be notified about properties that match your search. Whether you’re looking for a rental property or a home for sale, notifications help you find the right property sooner. In NSW, VIC or QLD? Now you can get alerts about off-market properties on Domain! Just create a property alert and we'll let you know about off-market properties that tick those boxes before they're even listed. Coming soon for the rest of Australia, so stay tuned!
Draw your search
With map search, we make it easy to search for a property in your favourite area. Map view lets you use your fingertip to circle the area where you’d like to find a property. You can then switch to list view to see all available properties for rent or sale in that area neatly laid out.
Shortlist with someone
Property hunting with someone? Whether you’re buying a house with your partner, renting an apartment with your best friend or value the opinion of a trusted real estate advisor or - you can invite anyone to shortlist with you. That way, both of your favourite properties are in one place. You’ll never have to share a link again.
Plan your inspections
When you shortlist your favourite properties, we add them to your inspection planner so you know what time and where you need to be for your open inspections or auctions. You can switch to map view to understand where the properties are located in relation to each other and your current location. You can also keep track of what you thought by rating each property after you inspect it. It’s never been easier to organise your favourite properties.
See property price estimates
Understand real property values using our comprehensive Home Price Guide. Get a value range showing a home’s potential low, mid, and high market prices, complete with confidence ratings. Our detailed insights are backed by market data and trusted by the banks, allowing you to be confident in your next move. 
Find the right agent

Search thousands of properties

Whether you’re searching for a house, apartment, off-the-plan property or house and land package - you can filter down to the exact real estate you’re looking for. Search by suburb, address, school name or on the map. Then, set your filters including price, property type, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, land size or use keywords like ‘pool’.

See properties before other buyers

Whether you’re looking for a rental property or a home for sale, notifications help you find the right property sooner. In NSW, VIC or QLD? Now you can get alerts about off-market properties on Domain! Just create a property alert and we'll let you know about off-market properties that tick those boxes before they're even listed. Draw your search

Shortlist with someone

bluejetty:00073401:ios.name: AARP Now
bluejetty:00073401:ios.summary:
Introducing the new and improved AARP Now. It’s the app that makes your AARP Membership truly mobile.
AARP Now connects AARP Members to personalized news, alerts, events and savings that matter to you—whenever you want them. Download AARP
bluejetty:00073401:ios.description:
Introducing the new and improved AARP Now. It’s the app that makes your AARP Membership truly mobile.
AARP Now connects AARP Members to personalized news, alerts, events and savings that matter to you—whenever you want them. Download AARP Now and your membership is wherever you are.
MY AARP
The all-new My AARP includes top stories hand curated by our editorial team, uniquely personalized news, events, benefits, and new ways for you to customize your experience with AARP Now. Plus, videos and the latest digital editions of AARP The Magazine and AARP Bulletin. Easily access your digital membership card, Inbox and My account with one tap from My AARP.
MORE PERSONALIZED THAN EVER
The new AARP Now personalizes recommendations based on your previous activity. Get more of the content you love on My AARP, News, Benefits and Events.
ACCESS DIGITAL EDITIONS OF AMERICA’S TWO LARGEST PUBLICATIONS: AARP THE MAGAZINE AND AARP BULLETIN
AARP Publications help people 50 and older live their best and most fulfilling lives. Read current and back issues in AARP Now. You’ll find these in the new AARP Publications tile. Don’t have time to read now? Save any magazine article for quick access later. And you can even listen to articles through our new audio feature.
NEWS
The new AARP Now includes more opportunities to catch up on the latest news in just a few minutes; read the latest Top Stories on the My AARP tab, or dig deeper on the all-new News tab, bringing you even more curated news, plus news uniquely personalized just for you. Save News stories for reading later. And join the conversation by sharing with friends and adding comments!
MORE AARP
The new More AARP tab lets you tailor your app experience. If you find something you’ll want to access often, use the Customize Your Navigation feature to add it to your navigation bar.
SAVE FOR LATER
We have expanded the save feature in AARP Now beyond just benefits and events. You can now save news stories and videos, and features in AARP Publications, as well as benefits and events. Access items Saved for Later by tapping the Saved for Later icon on News, Benefits or Events, or tap Saved for Later in My Account or My AARP.
DIGITAL CARD/MEMBERSHIP
Instantly access your digital membership card and add it to Apple Wallet alongside your other affinity and payment cards. Join AARP or renew your AARP Membership in seconds. Plus, manage your account on the go.
EVENTS
Explore hundreds of local community events and online virtual events – from farmers markets, movies, documentaries, workshops, fitness classes and more, to kid-friendly activities – and quickly register for them right from the app.
MEMBER DISCOUNTS
Easily find benefits and discounts in your neighborhood, now with new Nearby view, showing nearby benefits on a map. Offers are added monthly.
GAMES
Access AARP Games, wherever you are! From Word & Trivia Games to Arcade Games to Solitaire & Mahjongg, there's something for everyone. And if you want even easier access to Games, add Games to your navigation bar with the new Customize Your Navigation feature.
NOTIFICATIONS
Receive news alerts, reminders for upcoming events or when benefits you have saved are nearby. You can easily manage your notifications in My Account > Notifications.
AARP REWARDS
Get more from AARP Now with the AARP Rewards program! Earn Rewards points for downloading the app and visiting the app each day, plus synchronize your favorite fitness tracker or the Health app to get even more points for steps, swimming, and cycling.
*AARP Membership is not required to use AARP Now, but AARP Members Edition™ exclusive content may require membership.
Terms of Service: https://www.aarp.org/about-aarp/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.aarp.org/about-aarp/privacy-policy/

Toppy offers limitless customization because it puts you in the driving seat. Here, you can make your pet picture say whatever you wish and watch it mimic your movements too. Create a message from your favorite pet and send it to everyone you know, that's what a Toppy is!
So, how does it work?
1 - Start by choosing one of our custom pet pictures, or upload a photo of your very own pet!
2 - Next use Toppy’s facial recognition technology to scan your face and align it with your picture.
3 - Once you've got everything in the right spot, it's time to record a message. Watch as your pet mimics what you say, and even copies the shapes your mouth makes while you say it!
4 - Now, it's time to give your pet an all-new look! Toppy offers a vast range of filters, outfits, and quirky costumes for you to make your pet stand out!
5 - Once you've got the look, it's time to get the sound. You can customize your vocal recording in whichever way you see fit! Go deep and booming or high like a chipmunk, as long as you choose what makes you and your friends smile!
6 - Voila! You've recorded and edited your first Toppy! Now it's time to share it with your friends and family. Send it, sit back, and watch as your recipients can't believe their eyes as your picture comes to life and relays your message! 
Think outside the box and see how much you can surprise and dazzle your friends! Record unexpected audio, use mad photos and pick the zaniest outfits - because the only limit here is your creativity. Download Toppy today and start bringing your favorite pet photos to life - you'd be barking mad not to.
If you’re struggling to use Toppy, the Friendzy team is here to help! If you have any questions or feedback, please contact us at support@friendzy.tech.

- Weekly with a 7-day free trial at $ 7.99;
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00131997:ios.description:
Today is your free personal habit tracker that helps you organize your day and build life-changing habits. Quit bad habits and stay on track with Today's unique visual and rewarding approach based on proven methods from behavioral science.
What makes Today unique?
SIMPLE & INTUITIVE
Today's clean and simple interface is designed to help you track you multiple habits and activities with a few simple gestures that feel natural right from the first launch. 
MOTIVATING PHOTO COVERS
Choose a full-screen photo cover for each of your habits to motivate yourself and stimulate you visually to stay on track. Select from our ever-growing photo gallery or choose one of your own photos. 
CUSTOMIZATION WITH CARDS
Today is the first habit tracker app that lets you build a fully customizable dashboard for each habit by combining cards that offer unique functionality: Apple Health Charts, Custom charts, Customer counters, To-do lists, Journal, Streak Calendar, Photo Galleries and more. Select those that best fit your habit and the way you want to track it.
INSIGHTFUL STATISTICS & TRENDS
You can manage what you can't measure. Get a clear overview of your check-ins and persistence across all your habits and activities from your profile in Today. Discover your weak spots to help you tweak and optimize your plan for maximum success.
WIN BADGES AND AWARDS
Developing a new habit or quitting a bad one is not just about checking a box every day. Today rewards with badges as you make progress to help you be more mindful of your journey and push you in the right direction.
SECURE AUTOMATIC BACKUPS
Your data is precious. Use Today's automatic backup feature to save all your data on your personal iCloud Drive or Dropbox folder for safekeeping and restore, if needed.
PRIVACY
Your privacy matters. Protect your all your habit data by using Today’s Touch ID or Face ID lock. For all devices that don’t support Touch ID or FaceID, we have enabled a 4-digit passcode. 
APPLE WATCH APP
Today on the Apple Watch gives a quick and clear overview of all your check-ins due for today and check-in with a simple gesture. The Apple Watch complication will keep you up to the task and let you know when every single goal is complete.
RICH NOTIFICATIONS & TODAY WIDGET
Set up as many reminders as you need for each of your habits. Using Rich Notifications, each notification comes with a beautiful graphical representation of your progress and the option to check-in without leaving the app. Today Widget allows you to view and complete your tasks quickly.
AND MORE
Visit our website to learn about all of Today's features: htts://neybox.com/today/
Download Today and change your life today!
PREMIUM FEATURES: 
- Custom photo covers and full access to all premium cover galleries
- Add unlimited cards per habit 
- Access to premium cards
- Track unlimited habits
- Backup and restore all using iCloud Drive or Dropbox 
- Control access to your habits using FaceID, TouchID or a 4-digit passcode.
Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account within 24 hours before the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the existing subscription will not be refunded. If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Terms and privacy policy: https://neybox.com/today-habit-tracker/today-privacy-policy-en

bluejetty:00126632:ios.description:
Michigan Medicine offers easy access to your medical care through the patient portal at MyUofMHealth.
If you are a current patient at Michigan Medicine, you can request a patient portal account during a clinic visit or at MyUofMHealth.org.
Some of the features and functions available to you through your MyUofMHealth patient portal include*:
•eCheck-In: Verify information to save time when you arrive for your visit
•Fast Pass: Get notification if earlier appointments become available
•Communicate with your care team 
•Request appointments for you and your children
•View appointments and receive reminders
•Fill out questionnaires prior to your visit
•Review test/lab results
•Request refills of eligible medications
•View billing statements and pay your bill*
•Conduct E-Visits: Submit a questionnaire regarding your symptoms for a variety of conditions and receive a quick reply from a Michigan Medicine provider through the MyUofMHealth portal*
•Track your health and link to other health apps – i.e. steps, weight
•Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs
*Not all features available for all user accounts

bluejetty:00041055:ios.description:
Free to play puzzles and brain-teasers in adventure games! Seek and find all hidden objects that are needed to finish a fantasy criminal investigation. 
You are a magic detective who got an invitation to the annual Venice Masquerade. This is an important event for magical creatures because they have an opportunity to move freely around the city. You go to Venice and meet your friend. At this time, an unknown person, whose face is hidden by a mask, appears at the carnival square and revives the lion statue, jeopardizing the fragile peace between the worlds of Others and humans. After revealing the identity of the masked stranger, you will have to go through many trials and witness the choice between common sense and love… 
· PREVENT AN UPCOMING CONFLICT BETWEEN HUMANS AND MERFOLKS IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles and hidden objects games after you finish the main story! More collectibles await you in this unique chapter, where you can use a clue for each task and unlock all new branches of the story!
· GATHER COLLECTIBLES AND LOOK FOR MORPHING OBJECTS!
Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles that will help you in a point & click investigation! Are you ready to go on an exciting Domini Games adventure quest and collect all the hidden pictures?
· ENJOY BONUS MATERIALS THAT INCLUDE CONCEPT ART, WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, AND MORE!
Our hidden object games for iPhone & iPad have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy!
· SOLVE MINI-GAMES AND INTERESTING RIDDLES!
Replay your favorite puzzle adventure to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
Download hidden objects, free mystery games & puzzle – “Magic City Detective: Revenge”! Play the absolutely free to play game, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
