bluejetty:00027311:ios.summary: Get ready to take your songwriting skills to the next level with Suggester 2 - the ultimate app for creating powerful and emotive chord progressions! Whether you're a seasoned musician or a budding songwriter, this app will revolutionize th
bluejetty:00027311:ios.description:
Get ready to take your songwriting skills to the next level with Suggester 2 - the ultimate app for creating powerful and emotive chord progressions! Whether you're a seasoned musician or a budding songwriter, this app will revolutionize the way you compose music, helping you to unlock new creative possibilities and reach new heights of productivity.
With its intuitive interface and cutting-edge features, Suggester 2 is the perfect tool for exploring the harmonic relationships between chords and discovering new musical ideas. Whether you're composing for piano, guitar or ukulele, this app will adapt to your needs, providing you with a wealth of powerful tools to help you create music that truly moves your listeners.
With Suggester 2, you can choose chords based on their harmonic function, using the powerful roman numeral notation to create progressions that are both dynamic and satisfying. This app will guide you every step of the way, suggesting chords that fit with your existing progressions and helping you to build your songs from the ground up.
But Suggester 2 isn't just about finding the right chords - it's also about creating tension and resolution, the heart of great music. With its ability to suggest chords that work together, this app is an essential tool for composers looking to create music that truly moves their listeners.
And if you're looking for inspiration, Suggester 2 has you covered there, too. With its library of classic chord progressions, you can draw on the rich history of music to create progressions that are both timeless and contemporary. Whether you're looking to recreate the sounds of your favorite songs or explore new musical styles, Suggester 2 has everything you need to create music that truly speaks to your soul.
And with its seamless integration with other apps and MIDI devices, Suggester 2 makes it easy to bring your music to life. Whether you're exporting your songs as audio, MIDI, or text, or using the app as an AudioUnit plugin (AUv3), you'll be able to create music that truly captures your vision.
Download Suggester 2 today and unlock the full potential of your songwriting skills! With its powerful features, intuitive interface, and endless creative possibilities, this app is sure to become your go-to tool for composing music.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00016957:ios.name: Play SRF: Streaming TV & Radio
bluejetty:00016957:ios.summary: Die Play SRF App lässt Sie direkt in die faszinierende Welt des Schweizer Radios und Fernsehens eintauchen und bietet Ihnen eine riesige Auswahl an Video- und Audio-Inhalten zum Streamen. Nutzen Sie alle Inhalte unserer Mediathek: TV, Radio
bluejetty:00016957:ios.description:
Die Play SRF App lässt Sie direkt in die faszinierende Welt des Schweizer Radios und Fernsehens eintauchen und bietet Ihnen eine riesige Auswahl an Video- und Audio-Inhalten zum Streamen. Nutzen Sie alle Inhalte unserer Mediathek: TV, Radio, Podcasts und vieles mehr – wann und wo immer Sie möchten. Streamen Sie live und auf Abruf.
SERIEN, FILME UND DOKUMENTATIONEN 
Mit der Play SRF App finden Sie genau das zum Streamen, wonach Sie suchen. Stöbern Sie in unserem breitgefächerten Angebot. Von packenden Serien und berührenden Filmen bis hin zu begeisternden Dokumentationen und Nostalgie weckenden Archivperlen ist alles mit dabei. Finden Sie schnell und einfach neue und bereits liebgewonnene Inhalte dank den praktischen Sortieroptionen nach Thema/Genre, Datum und Alphabet. Ihre Favoriten können abgespeichert werden, damit Sie diese später einfacher wiederfinden. Geniessen Sie beste Unterhaltung mit populären Inhalten wie «DOK Auf und davon», «Einstein» und «SRF bi de Lüt».
LIVE UND AUF ABRUF 
Streamen Sie alle Inhalte von SRF live, nachträglich oder teils sogar schon vor der Ausstrahlung. Ob zu Hause auf Ihrer Couch, unterwegs oder bei der Arbeit. Erleben Sie die ganze Vielfalt von SRF – wann und wo es Ihnen am besten passt. 
LIVESTREAMS 
Mit der Play SRF App können Sie alle Highlights aus dem TV live miterleben. Verfolgen Sie alle SRF TV-Programme als Livestream – SRF 1, SRF zwei und SRF info. Und das ist noch nicht alles: Fiebern Sie mit der Play SRF App bei allen Sport-Highlights aus Fussball, Tennis, Eishockey, Ski und vielen weiteren Sportarten live mit. Streamen Sie zudem exklusive Sport Livestreams, welche nicht im TV ausgestrahlt werden.
RADIOS UND PODCASTS 
Entdecken Sie das gesamte Audio-Angebot von SRF in einer App. Wählen Sie aus mehr als 100 unterschiedlichen Podcasts wie «Echo der Zeit», «Persönlich», «Input», «Focus» und unserem vielfältigen Angebot an Hörspielen und Krimis. Für alle Radio-Liebhaber:innen stehen zudem alle SRF Radiosender als Livestream inklusive Timeshift-Funktion zur Verfügung: Radio SRF 1, Radio SRF 2 Kultur, Radio SRF 3, Radio SRF 4 News, Radio SRF Musikwelle und Radio SRF Virus. 
FÜR ALLE GERÄTE 
Die Play SRF App können Sie auf einer breiten Palette an Geräten nutzen: Smart TV, Tablet, Smartphone und sogar in Ihrem Auto. 
WESENTLICHE FUNKTIONEN: 
• Breitgefächertes Streaming Angebot: Filme, Serien und Dokumentationen 
• Inhalte live und auf Abruf streamen 
• Favoriten: Speichern Sie Ihre Lieblingsinhalte 
• Alle Radiosender und TV-Sender von SRF als Livestream
• Push-Nachrichten: Benachrichtigung zu neuen Folgen Ihrer Lieblingsinhalte
• TV-Guide: TV-Programm mit praktischer Erinnerungsfunktion in Ihrem Kalender
• Themenfilter für einzelne Rubriken
• Für Tablet und Smartphone
• Auf Ihrem Smart TV streambar (Apple TV und AirPlay, Amazon Fire TV, Chromecast)
• Auch im Auto nutzbar (Apple CarPlay)
• Downloads: Laden Sie Inhalte herunter, um sie offline zu konsumieren
• Barriere- und werbefrei nutzbar
Gefällt Ihnen die Play SRF App? Dann nehmen Sie sich doch ein paar Minuten Zeit für eine Bewertung. Wir berücksichtigen Ihr Feedback bei der Weiterentwicklung. Bei Problemen mit der Play SRF App wenden Sie sich bitte an den SRF Kundendienst via https://www.srf.ch/kontakt oder Telefon (+41 848 80 80 80).

bluejetty:00176805:ios.description:
A mythic quest for your party awaits in this dark RPG in which you, and only you, can bring an end to the darkness that consumes a kingdom. 
The once-great kingdom of Vendir is now under the tyrannic King Elrik who rules with an iron fist, his judgements harsh and his punishments torturous. When discovering an ancient prophecy promising the end of Elrik's reign, two siblings must make their way from one muddy end of the Kingdom to the other- inciting Elrik’s wrath every step of the way. Challenge the truth in a Kingdom drowning in a plague of lies.
Vendir: Plague of Lies is a classic party-based RPG with a deep storyline and synergy-heavy combat. Look forward to many hours of gameplay filled with memorable characters, intense battles, deep and engaging quests, character skills, and gear progression in the vein of old-school RPGs of the late 90s and early 2000s.
A dynamic and immersive world brimming with the "old school vibes" of CRPG classics
Explore a tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Can you escape the wrath of King Elrik and save the kingdom?
Experience epic turn-based battles
A deep and nuanced battle system that's easy to learn but hard to master. Fight with swords, magic or both.
Loot & fight your way through the kingdom of Vendir
A game filled with intricate crafting mechanics and intriguing collectables with heavy story implications.
A complex skill tree with hundreds of skills to learn
Multiple classes such as Warrior, Thief, Necromancer and Plague Doctor create a game with colossal replayability.
A rich narrative that splinters based on your choices
Lore-heavy conversations in which you, as the hero, make decisions that have long-lasting implications.

bluejetty:00034904:ios.description:
Send messages to your future self!
Write a note. Pick a moment: a date, a time, or a place. HiFutureSelf delivers it exactly when you need it. Your grocery list as you walk into the store. A pep talk before the gym. A quiet "breathe" as you step out the door.
The simplest reminder app you'll ever use. And the most thoughtful.
*Celebrating 16 years on the App Store!*
WHAT YOU CAN SEND
• A note to yourself tomorrow, next month, or ten years from now.
• A voice memo recording for your future self.
• A photo, a face, a moment, a memory to land at the right time.
• A secret message to a friend. Surprise the people you love with a note that arrives exactly when they need it.
WHEN IT ARRIVES IS UP TO YOU
• Any future date and time, down to the minute.
• The moment you arrive at or leave a place.
• Hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or on the specific days you choose.
• Pause anytime with a swipe. Resume the same way.
BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
• 5 home screen widgets so your upcoming messages are always in view.
• Light and dark mode, matched to your iOS theme automatically.
• A library of motivational messages for the days the words won't come.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases. No data collection. Your messages live on your device, with optional iCloud sync. Works fully offline.
Download HiFutureSelf. Free. Start writing to the version of you who'll need it most.

bluejetty:00187947:ios.description:
For all your plans!
"Conquer your calendar" - The Daily List (App Store)
"Our Favourite Apple Watch Apps" - Editor's Choice (App Store)
"My Must-Have iOS Apps" - Federico Viticci (macstories.net)
Appointments and to-dos, meetings and deadlines, birthdays and dates - make the most of your time with Calendar 366!
Anything a calendar can do... Calendar 366 can do better - and all of its functions can be adjusted easily and intuitively.
A dentist appointment is not a friend’s wedding, and your calendar should know the difference.
How and how often do you want to be reminded about what’s important?
Create a calendar that matches your preferences and priorities.
INDIVIDUAL DISPLAY
Pick your preferences – year or month, week or day, list or agenda, from light red to dark to darkest blue...
EASY USE
Create your dates by natural text input, for example:
"Meeting tomorrow 10am Melrose Ave /work", or "Sauna! next Sunday 3pm -360", or simply "time to read tomorrow" – any way you like it.
Easily find and change events and reminders, repeat them, add attachments* and create notes without any hassle.
ENDLESS APPLICATIONS
Sync documents and attachments easily with all devices via iCloud*.
Easily send, accept or decline invitations.
Find a location on the go: simply search, save, and open in Apple, Google maps, HERE WeGo, Waze or maps.me.
Find your events via Spotlight. Organise your events & to-dos with Calendar Sets...
TOTAL OVERVIEW
See all that’s important today with the Calendar 366 Today widget.
APPLE WATCH-ABLE
Of course, Calendar 366 also works on the Apple Watch - giving you your complete calendar overview on your wrist.
Simply use voice input to create new events or reminders.
SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
Calendar 366 is fully localized in English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Dutch, Italien, Polish and Chinese.
MAIN FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Apple Watch app (iPhone)
• Apple Watch Complications: Modular (Small & Large), Utilitarian (Small, Small Flat & Large) & Circular, Extra Large, Graphic (Corner, Bezel, Circular, Rectangular)
• 10 Home Screen Widgets
• 5 Lock Screen Widgets (2 variations each)
• Join meetings with a tap
• Notifications for invitations and shared calendar changes
• Siri Watch Face support
• Siri Shortcut support
• All events and reminders at a glance
• 8 views, 9 themes
• Spotlight integration
• Calendar Se

bluejetty:00126821:ios.summary:
Kode reads QR codes and barcodes with a single tap — no accounts, no tracking, no ads. Everything happens on your device. Your scan history stays on your iPhone and never leaves.
WHAT YOU GET
- Instant scanning from the camera, with a clea
bluejetty:00126821:ios.description:
Kode reads QR codes and barcodes with a single tap — no accounts, no tracking, no ads. Everything happens on your device. Your scan history stays on your iPhone and never leaves.
WHAT YOU GET
- Instant scanning from the camera, with a clean distraction-free viewfinder
- Scan from photo: pick any image from your library and Kode pulls the code out for you — great for screenshots and saved receipts
- Batch mode: flip on "Auto-save scans" in Settings and burn through dozens of codes without stopping to confirm each one
- Searchable history with type icons: links, email, phone, Wi-Fi, contacts, SMS, locations, plain text
- From any scanned code you can copy, open the link, search on Google or Amazon, or save it for later
- Export your whole scan archive as a JSON file via share sheet (AirDrop, Files, Mail, iCloud Drive, anywhere)
- Full dark mode, 36 interface languages, haptic feedback on every detection
- Works fully offline — no subscription, no in-app purchases
SUPPORTED FORMATS
QR Code, Code 128, GS1-128, Code 39, Code 39 Mod 43, Code 93, PDF417, Aztec, EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E, ISBN 10/13, ISSN, ISMN.
GREAT FOR
- Reading any code you run into — menus, tickets, boarding passes, Wi-Fi shares
- Inventory at home, at work or in a small shop
- Pulling QR codes out of screenshots you already have
- Keeping a searchable record of business cards, events, receipts
- Shopping: compare a barcode on Google or Amazon in one tap
Kode has been on the App Store for years. This release rebuilds it in modern SwiftUI and adds the features long-time users asked for: batch scanning, scan-from-photo, export, and a clearer, faster interface — without giving up the simple, private scanner it has always been.

bluejetty:00200021:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00200021:ios.description:
M8 tracker is an eight-track music tracker, sequencer, and synthesizer from Dirtywave.
Create and arrange music using a portable tracker workflow. Sequences are built from phrases and chains, which can be arranged independently across eight tracks with sequencing and modulation at each step.
Instruments
• Wavsynth - Chip synth inspired wavetable synth 
• Macrosynth - Macro oscillators of over 40 unique synthesis engines
• FMSynth - Four-operator FM synthesis
• Hypersynth - Six-note 13 oscillator swarm synth
• Sampler - Sample playback and recording
• MIDI instruments for controlling internal or external gear
• Up to 128 instruments per song
Sequencing
• Eight independent monophonic tracks
• Instrument tables for advanced modulation
• Scales, grooves, probability, and comprehensive effect commands
• Live performance and song-rendering tools
Connectivity
• CoreMIDI input and output
• External computer keyboards and game controllers
• Ableton Link support
• AUv3 plugin version 
• Inter-App Audio (IAA) integration
• Launchpad Pro MKIII support
M8 supports portrait and landscape orientations on iPhone and iPad. Projects, instruments, samples, themes, and rendered audio are accessible through the Files app. Built-in contextual help explains every view with shortcuts.
M8 for iOS provides the complete M8 workflow in a portable, touch-enabled interface. Songs and bundles are fully compatible with M8 hardware and can be transferred between devices and shared with other M8 users. Join the Dirtywave Discord community to share music, get help, and discuss M8.

bluejetty:00073447:ios.description:
When's my bus? OneBusAway answers that question in real time, at every stop, across your whole region.
Now with Live Activities: start tracking a ride and watch it approach from your Lock Screen, without opening the app.
Free, open source, and built by a nonprofit in partnership with your transit agency.
WHAT'S NEW
- Live Activities — follow your bus, train, or ferry from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
- A redesigned stop view that opens right from the map, putting real-time arrivals one tap away.
FEATURES
- Real-time arrivals wherever your agency provides them.
- Departure alarms that nudge you before your ride pulls away.
- Trip planning with door-to-door directions across every agency in your region.
- See where your vehicle actually is on the map — buses, trains, ferries, streetcars, even funiculars.
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for the routes you check most.
- Bookmarks and recent stops, so your daily commute is always a tap away.
- Nearby stops found automatically, or search by route, address, or stop number.
- Service alerts from your agency, right where you need them.
WHERE ONEBUSAWAY WORKS
- Davis, CA
- New York, NY
- San Diego, CA
- Seattle / Tacoma / Puget Sound, WA
- Tampa, FL
- Washington, D.C.
- Adelaide, Australia
ABOUT
OneBusAway is free and open source, maintained by transit riders and researchers since 2008. There are no ads and no account to create.
The app is published by the Open Transit Software Foundation, an IRS-registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that has earned Silver Transparency status on Candid.
Questions, feedback, or support: https://onebusaway.org/
OTSF on Candid: https://www.guidestar.org/profile/84-1786969

bluejetty:00164072:ios.description:

Earthquake Turkey is an advanced platform that integrates trusted sources to help you monitor earthquakes in real time and stay prepared for emergencies. Here’s what it offers:
 • Real-Time Earthquake Alerts: Receive personalized notifications from trusted networks such as Kandilli Observatory, AFAD (Disaster and Emergency Management Authority), and EMSC (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre).
 • Report Felt Earthquakes: Easily report earthquakes you have experienced through the app and view comments from other users.
 • Breaking Earthquake News: Stay informed with the latest earthquake updates from 14 different news outlets, all in one place.
 • City-Based Earthquake Listings: Sort and analyze earthquake activities in specific cities for a detailed overview of local seismic events.
 • Emergency SMS Feature: Instantly share your status, location, and full address via SMS to pre-designated contacts in case of emergencies.
 • Map-Based Earthquake Tracking: Visualize ongoing earthquakes on a map and sort them by magnitude to assess affected regions quickly.
 • Emergency Equipment Tips: Access vital information about essential tools like whistles and alarms that can be lifesaving during an earthquake.
 • Dynamic Dark Mode Support: The app adapts to your system settings, providing a seamless experience in both light and dark modes.
Earthquake Turkey is designed to keep you and your loved ones safe by offering a comprehensive network of information and alerts. Be prepared, stay safe!

bluejetty:00200022:ios.description:
Muse is your personal AI agent that gets things done, always working on what matters to you. It manages email, books dinners, tracks budgets, and finds deals, with your approval.
PERSONAL PRODUCTIVITY
Muse takes the the busywork off your plate. It manages scheduling conflicts, books reservations, sets reminders, and follows up with people, so birthdays, plans, and deadlines don't slip. Stay on top of your calendar, email, and daily tasks without carrying it all in your head.
SHOPPING & DEALS
Muse compares prices, tracks price drops, and alerts you the moment something you want goes on sale. AI-powered shopping that can actually buy on your behalf, with your OK.
CONNECT YOUR APPS
You decide what Muse can access. Link your email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health and fitness data, and finances. Approve actions before they happen. Muse gets smarter with every connection.
GROW YOUR SMALL BUSINESS
Give Muse a goal, like finding new customers or growing sales, and it gets it done. Connect your Instagram Business Account, Facebook Pages, and Meta ad accounts in a few clicks, and Muse understands your business: what you sell, what your brand sounds like, and what customers keep asking about.
SAVE MONEY
Muse helps you understand where your money is going. It tracks expenses, audits subscriptions, flags charges you forgot about, cancels what you don't need, and helps you hit a savings goal, checking with you before it cancels or spends. Get financial insights without the spreadsheet.
HEALTH & FITNESS
Muse is your AI fitness coach. It builds a custom workout or meal plan from data you choose to share, tracks calories and nutrition, monitors sleep and wellness, and adjusts your training day by day. Whether it's running, eating better, or building a habit, Muse coaches you through it.
SHARE A TASK, START TO FINISH
Hand Muse a whole job and it sees it through: the research, the comparisons, the back-and-forth, the bookings. Sell your car for more, negotiate a bill down, or plan and book a whole trip. A better result than you'd have managed alone.
ALWAYS WORKING FOR YOU
Muse keeps things moving after you close the app. It monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention, so nothing falls through the cracks.
IN YOUR CONTROL
Approve actions before they happen. Muse keeps a full activity log, and lets you revoke any connector anytime. 
UNIQUELY YOURS
Name it, shape how it talks, and make it your own.
SMART, BUT STILL LEARNING
Muse may be inaccurate or take unexpected actions, so check in to keep it on track and intervene as needed.

bluejetty:00090786:ios.description:
Phonics Games PreK to Grade 2 Phonics is the only iPad or iPhone app that dives deep into advanced phonics concepts in a kid friendly and engaging way. It uses scientifically proven methods to build confident and capable readers.
Did you know that 69% of fourth graders in the United States read below grade level? That is more than a statistic, it is a crisis. Traditional methods often skip the deeper rules of phonics, leaving children confused. For example, the letter C in "cat" sounds like K, but in "cereal," it sounds like S. Our app teaches these tricky rules step by step, so your child gains the tools to decode any word with confidence.
Why Parents (and Kids) Love It:
1. Advanced Phonics Made Fun:
We turn challenging concepts into games and activities that keep kids engaged while they learn.
2. Step-by-Step Progress:
Each lesson builds on the last, ensuring children gain confidence without feeling overwhelmed.
3. Scientifically Proven Methods:
Our structured approach is backed by research, showing how letters connect to sounds in a clear, logical way.
4. Built-In Support and Tracking:
Guided narration lets kids learn independently, while report cards show how they are progressing.
5. Flexible Learning, Your Way:
Pick and choose lessons in any order, and easily manage screen time with our built-in tools.
Why It Matters: Reading does not happen automatically, it must be taught systematically. Phonics is proven to be the most effective method, showing kids how letters form sounds and words. This transforms frustration into confidence.
Your Child’s Future Starts Here: Phonics Games PreK to Grade 2 puts the power of reading at your child’s fingertips. Download it today and see how quickly they become a strong, eager reader.

bluejetty:00136227:ios.description:
Reading the Bible every day can be hard. It’s easy to feel stuck, lost, or unsure where to start. We get it. We’ve been there too. Our hope for these podcasts is that it will serve as a complement to the reading plans, to encourage you on your commute to work, while you’re out for a walk, or at home making dinner. 
FEATURES:
* Bible Reading:
- Choose from popular versions like the NIV, NASB, ESV, NKJV, NLT, KJV, and more.
- Offline Bibles: Read without network access (available for select versions)
- Read the entire Bible
- Keep track of your Bible reading progress
- Easy Reading: Adjust settings like fonts, spacing, and text size, and even read in Dark Mode
- Bookmark and put highlights chapter by chapter
- Night reading mode
* Import, organize and play
- Find your favorite bible podcasts with integrating iTunes searching feature.
- Add and import feeds via the iTunes and RSS or Atom links
- Enjoy listening your way with adjustable playback speed, chapter support, remembered playback position
- AirPlay Support
* Keep track, share & appreciate
- Keep track of the best of the best by marking episodes as favourites
- Share episodes and feeds through advanced social media, email options and via OPML export
* Control the system
- Take control over automated downloading: choose feeds, exclude mobile networks, select specific WiFi networks, require the phone to be charging
- Manage storage by setting the number of cached episodes, smart deletion, and selecting your preferred location
- Back up your subscriptions and bookmarks with OPML export
- Adjust playback speed to accommodate your listening habits
Let us know what podcasts you're listening to or share your feedback with us.

bluejetty:00024537:ios.description:
Kids can’t sleep? This app is for you. 
As parents, we love those sweet bedtime moments, like reading a story, or cuddling in the rocking chair. However, when it comes to actually SLEEPING, some little ones need a little help! We get it. We’re parents too. Sound is THE solution to help create a bedroom environment fit for sleep. 
USE SOUND TO MAKE BEDTIME EASY: 
White Noise • Sleep Stories • Environmental Sounds • Lullabies • Meditations 
WHY BUDGE BEDTIME:
• Prepare them for a good night’s sleep with a custom bedtime routine
• Expertly designed audio tracks to help calm, soothe, and relax kids
• Audio-Only design keeps kids focused on sound not screens
• Exclusive lullabies, sleep stories, and meditations your kid will love
• Keep the sounds playing in the background, even while you use your other apps
SOUNDTRACKS TAILORED TO YOUR CHILDREN:
• BABIES – White Noise Sounds (Fan, Heart Beat, Washing Machine)
• TODDLERS – Lullabies, Nature Sounds, and Stories
• YOUNG CHILDREN – Stories and Mediations
DREAMY DESIGN:
• Easy to use, simple design
• AirPlay compatible to play on Bluetooth devices and speakers.
• Totally ad-free
ABOUT BUDGE
We’ve made some of your kids’ FAVORITE apps. We have spent nearly 10 years designing the BEST experiences in play. We couldn’t be more thrilled to bring joy to your family in a whole new way, by making bedtime EASY. 
Check out our newest releases for daytime fun with your little one: Barbie Dreamhouse Adventures, Thomas & Friends: Go Go Thomas, Budge World, and tons more! 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly or yearly subscriptions. 
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your subscription
- Users may be offered a free trial of the subscription in accordance with banners inside the app
- One free trial per Apple ID account on new subscriptions only
- If a free trial is offered, users will need to opt-in to a subscription in order to accept the trial period and will have the right to opt-out at any time during the trial period until at least 24 hrs prior to the end of the trial period. Users will be automatically charged after the trial period if they have not opted out at least 24 hrs prior to the end of the trial period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hrs before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but please note that you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription
- Like all other Apple subscription apps, this app cannot use family sharing to share subscriptions across family members 
- If you have any questions or need help, please contact our Customer Support at support@budgestudios.ca
PRIVACY, SAFETY & TERMS OF USE
Budge Studios™ takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps are compliant with privacy laws. This application has received the "ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) Privacy Certified Kids' Privacy Seal". bluejetty:00148560:ios.description:
► PICTURE PERFECT
Let both your inner artist and child free with this relaxing ASMR coloring game! We’ve created the ultimate coloring book app so that you can relax and create some satisfying art as you color and draw your worries away. Get ready for hours of drawing heaven in this delightful game, as well as a pallet-load of fantastic features.
► YOU DON’T WANT TO MISS
◾ Practically endless images – Our artists have worked hard to create tons upon tons of relaxing and fun images for you to color. We’ve got animals, landscapes, still life, and even abstracts -the sky is the limit here and you’re sure to find the perfect picture that will help you relax. Plus, enjoy the clean line art as you draw and paint your way to satisfaction.
◾ Let your creativity soar – Sure, we suggest color schemes that you might want to use for each image in case you don’t know where to start, but if your inner artist thinks that camel would look good in green, who are we to say no? Color each drawing with as many or as few hues as you want and have fun experimenting with different styles of painting along the way. This game doesn’t reward or penalize you for trying out new techniques or color palettes so let loose!
◾ Relax, take it easy – These satisfying images and great ASMR effects will have you feeling right as rain in no time. bluejetty:00144467:ios.description:
Zakaz.ua — your trusted grocery delivery assistant.
With the Zakaz.ua app, ordering groceries and drinks has never been easier or more convenient! No more time wasted on trips to the supermarket — now you can pick everything you need in just a few clicks and have it delivered right to your door. We partner with the biggest supermarkets like Metro, Auchan, Tavriya V,Vostorg, Novus, Winetime, Ultramarket, and many more, so you always have access to fresh products and great deals!
Why choose Zakaz.ua?
— Easy-to-use interface: The app offers a wide range of products (160 000+), making it simple to find what you're looking for. Everything is clear and intuitive, and placing an order takes just a few minutes.
— Careful order assembly: A professional shopper is at your service, selecting only the best products, and the order is packed according to all product placement rules.
— Flexible delivery options: Pick a delivery time that works for you, ensuring you get your groceries exactly when you need them.
— Secure card payments: Pay for your groceries and drinks easily and safely with online card payments.
Partner supermarkets
We work with the top supermarkets to bring you the freshest products and the best deals:
— Metro — a huge selection of food and drinks for the whole family, available for delivery.
— Auchan — affordable prices and regular discounts on a wide range of products.
— Tavria V — fresh groceries and fantastic deals.
MegaMarket — easy ordering with quick delivery of food and drinks to your doorstep.
— Novus — special deals and discounts on popular items.
— EcoMarket, Vostorg, Winetime, Ultramarket, MasterZoo, Kosmos, Alcohub — a diverse selection of everything you need, from groceries to household and pet supplies.
Key features of Zakaz.ua
— Deals and discounts: Always find the latest promotions and discounts on groceries from your favorite supermarkets.
— Shopping list: Create your shopping list in advance, add items whenever you think of them, and place your order whenever it's convenient.
— Order history: Quickly access your previous orders and reorder with just one tap.
— Product catalog: Browse a wide range of products with easy navigation and filters to find the best deals.
Zakaz.ua makes grocery shopping fast, easy, and stress-free. Forget about the hassle of going to the store — with Zakaz.ua, you can order everything you need in just a click, choose a delivery time that suits you, and pay securely with your card. Join thousands of happy users and enjoy fresh groceries delivered right to your door!

bluejetty:00100745:ios.description:
The word Ardas is derived from the Persian word 'Arazdashat', meaning a request, a supplication, a prayer, a petition or an address to a superior authority. It is a Sikh prayer that is done before performing or after undertaking any significant task; after reciting the daily Banis (prayers); or completion of a service like the Paath, kirtan (hymn-singing) program or any other religious program. In Sikhism, these prayers are also said before and after eating. The prayer is a plea to God to support and help the devotee with whatever he or she is about to undertake or has done.
Key Features of the app:
1) One can listen to path using soft keys(Play, Pause or Stop).
2) Meaning of the path on every page.
3) One can change the text size (i.e. increase or decrease) within app.
4) One can select path language from Gurmukhi(Punjabi), Hindi and English.
5) One can share this app with friends and family.
6) Themes: User can change theme. 
7) User can use Go option to quickly go to any page.
The design of the app is very simple.
We hope you will like our app.
Please rate us and if you have any feedback or suggestion, you can contact us via email: care.happyinfotech@gmail.com

bluejetty:00182918:ios.description:
After we’ve seen Phil Faily test his luck on cars and motorbikes, we take a glimpse into the life of an Ancient Faily!
While hunting for some dinosaur eggs you disturb a mighty volcano and are tossed down the side of the mountain. You are forced to keep ‘tumbling’ down the mountain avoiding obstacles and hazards in order to remain ahead of the pursuing lava flow.
In this physics based ragdoll game you must manoeuvre your way through various hazardous environments such as lava, water and clifftops, resulting in a hilarious experience.
From the developers of the Worldwide No 1 Hits FAILY BRAKES and FAILY RIDER comes FAILY TUMBLER! 
FEATURES
• NAVIGATE downhill as far as you can go avoiding obstacles along the way
• AVOID lava, cliff edges, man-eating fish and whirlpools
• COLLECT your glider and soar above the hazards
• DESTROY obstacles with you shield
• COLLECT coins as you go
• UPGRADE your character’s skills and powers
• UNLOCK unique costumes and gliders
• RECORD gameplay and share to YouTube, Facebook or Instagram
• ENDLESS fast paced gameplay
• ENDLESS hilarity
• ENDLESS fun!

- We will keep you updated with latest words in this language.

Say goodbye to ordinary photo editing apps, and hello to "Retake" – the game-changer in photography apps. No longer worry about capturing the perfect shot on the first try; "Retake" transforms any snap, be it from three years ago or from your upcoming birthday bash, into a photo you’ll absolutely adore, all with a single tap.
REALISTIC AI RETAKES THAT NO ONE CAN TELL 
If you’re thinking this is just another face editing app offering AI-generated avatars delivering artificial results, think again. "Retake" stands in a league of its own, offering you the power of endless, realistic retakes, not by enhancing your pictures, but by editing & reimagining them in a way that even you won’t believe AI did the job. It’s not about artificial filters or unnecessary makeovers; it’s about capturing your true spirit, naturally and perfectly, every single time.
Now, when you wish to freeze a not-so-perfect moment into a picture-perfect memory, trust "Retake" to turn that snap into an Instagram masterpiece that feels both genuine and flattering.
NOT YOUR REGULAR FACE & PHOTO EDITING APP
Retake is an unprecedented AI engine, a one-tap wizard that crafts perfection tailored just for you, promising results so natural that they blend seamlessly with your real moments, keeping the essence intact while portraying you at your absolute best. Whether it’s a selfie or a candid shot, Retake face editing ensures every picture looks its best.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
It's as simple as a snap! Begin your journey with "Retake" by uploading 12 of your favorite pictures, from which your personalized AI Face & Photo model will be crafted. What follows is the end of laborious photo sessions with countless retakes. Just snap once, and let "Retake" refine it to perfection, offering you an array of choices, each photo better than the last. Live the moment fully, without the stress of capturing & editing your photos perfectly; because with "Retake," every click is the best click, making each face selfie look natural and beautiful.
SHARE EVERY PHOTO FEARLESSLY, SHINE ENDLESSLY!
Every pose? A social media hit. Every picture? Absolute charm. "Retake" and its AI don’t just edit your face – they uplift, transforming each moment into a dazzling representation of you. Boost your Instagram feed from good to great, ensuring each photo captures more than just a pose. Dive into a realm where every picture isn't just liked but loved and shared. Eager to shine on Instagram and TikTok with your natural face ? "Retake" is your secret for stunning selfies and natural retouches.
Be prepared to experience the future of photography, where every face snapshot is an embodiment of perfection, where every moment is just right, capturing not just your image, but your spirit, truly and naturally. 
In a world where capturing the perfect moment often feels out of reach, "Retake" redefines the power of editing by turning any snap into a memory you’ll cherish forever. This isn’t just another photo editing tool – it’s your personal AI that reimagines, refines, and elevates every shot with unmatched realism. Say goodbye to multiple takes and exhausting editing sessions, and embrace the ease of stunning, share-ready photos with a single tap. Let "Retake" handle the details, so you can focus on living in the moment and sharing it with confidence.

bluejetty:00044818:ios.name: MG Flasher
bluejetty:00044818:ios.summary: MG Flasher is a mobile tuning App designed for BMW/Supra vehicles equipped with B48, B58, S58, N63, S63, and N74 engines. Flashing is done by OBD using ENET Wi-Fi. Flashing time on ENET is only 15 - 20 seconds! Disclaimer: For off-road use
bluejetty:00044818:ios.description:
MG Flasher is a mobile tuning App designed for BMW/Supra vehicles equipped with B48, B58, S58, N63, S63, and N74 engines. Flashing is done by OBD using ENET Wi-Fi. Flashing time on ENET is only 15 - 20 seconds! Disclaimer: For off-road use only. 
*Initial flash/ECU unlock with ENET Wifi will take approximately 4 - 6 minutes.
Flashing your BMW with MG Flasher unlocks many features:
• Custom Options - pick and choose performance mods, exhaust, cooling, torque options, as well as custom code options + more. 
• Switchable Maps On-The-Fly - WORLD'S FIRST SOLUTION FOR BMW B58/B48 - through a simple combination of cruise control buttons you can quickly select between mapping, without the need to reflash the vehicle! Currently available for gen 1 and 2 B48,B58 and S58.
• Dynamic Exhaust Burble On-The-Fly - via a simple combination of cruise control buttons you can change the intensity of the burbles whenever you like! Currently available for gen 1 and 2 B48,B58 and S58.
• Flex Fuel - Automatically adjusts engine calibration to any ethanol blend, with smart blending logic for smooth power delivery and full integration with sensor or manual override control. Live ethanol display, cruise-control adjustability, and instant cluster feedback.
• Max Cooling On-The-Fly - With a simple cruise control button combination sequence, you can enable the option without reflashing the car! Currently available for gen 1 and 2 B48,B58 and S58.
• Torque Limit Adjustability - TCU 8HP Limiter Lifted for all platforms! Software calibration without the need for any transmission tuning or skewing the torque/load calculation model maps. This allows for accurate calculations, smooth shifting and no software trickery.
• Speed Limit Removal, Startup Roar, Torque by Gear Limiter available on select software
• Sport Gauges (HP and TQ) adjustable by user!
• OTS maps prepared by MG Flasher tuners
• Custom maps flashing – flash custom maps prepared by us or other tuners/users
• Logger - log real time data and plot it into graphs for troubleshooting and optimizing
• Cloud Log Viewer - Professional log viewing on logs.mgflasher.com
• Diagnostic - Read and clear BMW specific DTC's
• Reset various adaptations, restore coding
• CVN number (Checksum Verification Number) along with flashing counter stays untouched. This means our software will be virtually invisible to dealer level diagnostic tools
Supported vehicles:
BMW M140i/120i/125i/M135i F20/F21/F40
BMW M240i/220i/225i/230i/228i/M235i - F22/F23/F44
BMW M340i/318i/320i/330i/330e - F30/F31/F34/G20/G21/G28
BMW M3 - G80
BMW M440i/420i/430i - F32/F33/F36/G22
BMW M4 - G82
BMW 540i/520i/530i/530e - G30/G31/G38
BMW M550i G30
BMW M5 LCI - F90
BMW 640i/630i - G32
BMW 740i/740Li/730i/730Li/740e/740Le - G11/G12
BMW 840i, M850i - G14/G15/G16
BMW M8 - F91, F92, F93
BMW X1 20i/25i/28i -F48
BMW X2 20i/25i/28i/M35i - F39
BMW X3 M40i/20i/30i - G01
BMW X4 M40i/20i/30i - G02
BMW X3M/X4M - F97/F98
BMW X5 40i,50i - G05
BMW X6 40i - G06
BMW X5M/X6M - F95/F96

bluejetty:00119378:ios.description:
Start making money anytime and anywhere through your smartphone by providing logistics and roadside assistance services.
You can increase your income by providing logistics services or registering your own car to provide services such as tire, Battery, Fuel and Locksmith with a flexible working hours in all Saudi regions inside and outside cities, as well as international logistics to UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt and Jordan.
Easy steps to register:
Download the application from the Store
Register using your phone number
Wait for account activation
Complete the required information
Start working as Morni Provider
With Morni you can provide the following services:
- Towing services of all types: Regular, Flatbed, Covered Flatbed and Winch Tow truck.
- Tire services: Spare tire installation, tire repair in station, tire change in station, tire repair on site, tire inflation on site.
- Battery services: battery jump-start and battery replacement..
- Fuel delivery service: a fuel or diesel delivery service inside or outside cities.
- Locksmith Services: unlock vehicle doors in case of lockdown the vehicle, this is only unlocking the locked vehicle, doesn’t include any programming neither replacement key nor key repair
- Between cities Service: Transporting vehicles between Saudi cities and outside the kingdom.
- Accident Full-Solution Services: provides a comprehensive full solution service, where the vehicle is taken care of from the accident scene and complete it’s Damage Assessment until it is delivered to the client's home.

bluejetty:00044719:ios.name: Pika - AI Video
bluejetty:00044719:ios.summary: Meet Pika, the mind-blowing AI video maker that brings your wildest dreams and weirdest ideas to life. Insert yourself into a famous painting. Kiss a troll. Put a bunny in your bathtub. Squish a skyscraper. With Pika, literally anything is
bluejetty:00044719:ios.description:
Meet Pika, the mind-blowing AI video maker that brings your wildest dreams and weirdest ideas to life. Insert yourself into a famous painting. Kiss a troll. Put a bunny in your bathtub. Squish a skyscraper. With Pika, literally anything is possible. 
1. Pikaswaps
Put your cat in the grand canyon. Turn the Mississippi River to lava. With Pikaswaps, the options are endless. Use your photos or text prompts to replace any element in any of your video, with hyper-real results. 
2. Pikamemes
React to posts, threads, and comments with custom GIFs, generated from just a single selfie. Turn yourself into your favorite emoji, blow an air kiss, or vomit slime. Whatever your mood, we’ve got a meme. 
3. Pikadditions
Catch everyone’s attention with surprising objects, people, and fantastical elements dropped right in to your videos. Let your imagination run wild on selfies, iconic clips, POV videos, or anything you imagine, while preserving the original video and sound.
4. Pikaffects
Pikafy any of your photos with different Pikaffects like Cakeify, Melt, Explode, Squish, Levitate and more. We're always releasing new Pikaffects, and with the Pika app, you'll get first access to all of them.
5. Pikascenes 
Choose from different scenes like “Guard your castle,” “Fly in the sky,” and make them your own, swapping out characters, backgrounds, wardrobe and more with what you upload. Or, start from scratch and build your own video using just your photos and a text prompt of your creation. 
6. Image-to-Video
Turn any of your photos into a dynamic video. All you need is a photo and an idea.
7. Text-to-Video
Start with a simple text prompt. Your imagination + Pika’s magic = a whole new reality.
Why are you still reading this? Download the Pika app and start playing!
Terms of Service: https://pika.art/terms-of-service
Acceptable Use Policy: https://pika.art/acceptable-use-policy
Privacy Policy:https://pika.art/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00148267:ios.description:
All-in-one Insurance Hub: Car & Travel Insurance in Qatar
QIC App is your complete Insurance Hub for managing car and travel insurance in Qatar. Access everything you need — from instant policy purchase to real-time claims and lifestyle services — all in one secure app.
Core Features:
— Buy and renew car insurance (TPL and Comprehensive) instantly
— Purchase and view your travel insurance policies anytime
— Store, manage, and track all policies in your in-app wallet
— Submit claims and follow their status in real-time
— Roadside assistance and emergency help with SOS button
— View your vehicle’s service history from partner garages
— 24/7 in-app support and secure payments
— Available in Qatar, UAE, Oman, and other supported regions
New: Explore the QIC Market
Welcome to the QIC Market — your new destination for buying and listing vehicles.
Browse new and used cars from verified dealers or list your own car for others to discover — all directly through QIC App.
New: Earn Rewards with QIC Coins
Get rewarded for every action!
Earn QIC Coins when you buy insurance or use services, and redeem them for exclusive gifts and offers inside the app.
More Than Just Insurance
— Book car services like washing, maintenance, and detailing
— Get instant quotes and appointments from trusted garages
— Buy or lease a car with support from QIC’s verified network
— Discover tailored offers for auto, home, and lifestyle needs
— Manage all your needs in one secure, seamless app
Active users will find their car insurance policies automatically synced at login. New users can get insured in under 2 minutes — and start collecting QIC Coins from day one.
With QIC App, insurance is just the beginning. From car and travel coverage to rewards and vehicle listings, it’s your complete companion for everyday convenience in Qatar and beyond.
Download QIC App today — your all-in-one Insurance Hub for car, travel, rewards, and more.

- Pub quiz practice
- Road trips, holidays and rainy afternoons

Ace Trace lets you easily trace golf, disc golf, baseball, or even bird flights with stunning visual effects—no tripod or complex editing required.

bluejetty:00121636:ios.description:
Find inspiration for your next Minecraft creation. Browse skins, customize a character, make bead patterns, and explore practical resources in one companion app.
• Skins and creation: browse the skin library and community, edit skins, combine character parts, and preview your work in 3D.
• Bead patterns: turn skins into patterns, follow your progress row by row, or use AI photo styling to start a new design.
• Maps and add-ons: browse curated resources, read compatibility and import instructions, then download and share the file.

• Useful tools: explore world seeds and command recipes.
Map and add-on import requires Minecraft Bedrock Edition, installed separately. These files are not for Java Edition; compatibility with the NetEase China edition is not verified. Covers are thematic illustrations; appearance and behavior in Minecraft may differ.
NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.
Optional in-app purchases include Pro access and coins. Available plans, prices and any trial offers are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; manage or cancel subscriptions in your account settings. A lifetime purchase, when offered, does not renew.

bluejetty:00129304:ios.description:

※ App Permission Consent Guidelines
Jin Air only accesses essential items necessary for the service based on Article 22-2 of the Information and Communication Network Act, and the details are as follows:
[Essential Access Permissions]
- Device ID and registration information: Device identification and app status check
[Optional Access Permissions]
- Storage space: Read or save files
- Camera: Passport scanning, e-Ticket, profile picture
- Photo : Save boarding pass image
- Biocertification : Login Service, ID Verification
- Notifications: Push notifications
* "Optional access permissions" are required when using the corresponding function, and even if not allowed, other services can still be used.

bluejetty:00031782:ios.summary: Get E-MERGE-D in the merge story of Merge Hospital by Operate Now! In this merge and build game you play as the merge tycoon: Dr. Player. You must match and merge items and manage the medical staff of the San Mori Hospital. By completing ta
bluejetty:00031782:ios.description:
Get E-MERGE-D in the merge story of Merge Hospital by Operate Now! In this merge and build game you play as the merge tycoon: Dr. Player. You must match and merge items and manage the medical staff of the San Mori Hospital. By completing tasks you will earn money that you can use to build your hospital. Get e- merged in the merge and story of this medical drama Doctor! 
You’re the new doctor in town! You will discover the many secrets of your staff members and discover what is happening in and around the hospital. In Merge Hospital by Operate Now you will merge and build, meet and love many highly skilled surgeons, doctors and other interesting characters. You will learn more about their stories and how they got into the hospital. What are you waiting for Doctor? Merge build now!
Can you help your medical staff by merging the items? Just like in real hospitals, there is never a dull moment in Merge Hospital by Operate Now. Merge items, match them together, complete tasks and earn money to spend on new medicine and upgrading the hospital. Your medical team is depending on you, Doctor! You will not only merge and match medical items for your medical team, but they also love pies and other food and dishes. So make sure to merge and build some delicious pies to keep them happy. In this free merge game you will merge 2 items to combine them into better versions, and remember, they not only love medicine, but they also love food!
As a new chief of the outpatient department you will find yourself in the San Mori Hospital where you meet with Nurse Sandy and discover the story of how you are connected. But you will also get to meet all the other surgeons, doctors and nurses in the hospital. 
Meet your medical team: 
- Nurse Sandy Haasan: a mysterious nurse who knows a lot about you. As the Head Nurse of the department she will help you find the right merge strategy. Discover the merge story about how you are connected.
- Paramedic Gary Walker: a mechanic that became a paramedic. He knows how to merge things and especially how to tune ambulances. He is in conflict with Matt who thinks Gary stole his job after the incident that happened. They are definitely no match! 
- Doctor John Ford: a relaxed, but arrogant- yet professional doctor that will be on your side from day one. Dr. John grew up in his parents' mansion with his little sister Rosita. He fears making mistakes as past events are forever hunting him.
- Doctor Adam Fury: he may have failed as an artist, but e- merged as an highly skilled plastic surgeon. Dr. Fury merged two disciplines into one! He uses rather unorthodox procedures and only delivers masterpieces.
- Pharmacists Chris & Viktoria: get to know Chris Chow & Viktoria Vinoski and discover the events that are happening within the San Mori Hospital. Viktoria merged a new medicine, but Chris matched some evidence against her.
As Doctor merge tycoon your task is to find the right merge strategy. You’ll get to meet Dr. Pae, a highly skilled Neurosurgeon & Emilia, a bureaucratic woman protecting the hospital's reputation & George, the patient that never left.
As the new chief of the outpatient department you will: 
- MERGE and build medical items, pies and much more your medical staff needs.
- MANAGE the hospital and improve the facilities in this merging game. 
- MONITOR your medical staff and work alongside them.
- DISCOVER the merge story of a medical drama like in your favorite medical shows.
- EXPLORE the merge and story of the hospital and your medical team.
- RELAX and enjoy a casual merge build game with interesting characters, dialogues, story and well crafted animated comics. 
Love merging games? You will love Merge Hospital by Operate Now. This free merge game has 3D graphics, a compelling and interesting medical drama story and many items you can merge on the casual merge board. Merge 2 items while upgrading the hospital. 
Follow us on our socials
Facebook & Instagram: @mergehospital

THE LIST – The Luxury Social Shopping Network
Discover THE LIST, the first social commerce platform for luxury fashion blending content, entertainment, and commerce. Get immediate access to a network of leading global brands and retailers, where you can browse and shop through personalized content and get hard-to-find items sourced. Follow your favorite brands and stores, directly communicate with them via live stream, and enjoy a truly social shopping experience.
Download THE LIST App to:
 - Browse and shop women’s and men’s fashion and lifestyle from our network of the world’s leading retailers, brands, and personal shoppers, delivered straight to your door.
 - Follow your favorite stores and brands to get notified about their product and content updates and experience a personalized shopping experience. Engage with and directly shop from sellers’ social feeds.
 - Live stream with retailers, brands, or personal shoppers, from anywhere. Get your product questions instantly answered, receive recommendations or in-store presentations by a sales associate in the store and enjoy an in-person shopping experience at home.
 - Submit product requests by simply uploading a photo of an item you desire to our seller network, and get it sourced fast and for the best possible price.
 - Discover women’s and men’s clothing, designer bags, shoes, and accessories from global luxury brands such as Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Prada, and new, emerging designer labels, i.e. Jacquemus, Khaite, Amiri, Palm Angels, to one-of-a-kind vintage bags, jewelry and accessories from Chanel, Hermès, Louis Vuitton and fine luxury watches from Rolex, Audemars Piguet, and Patek Philippe.
 - Be the first to know about the latest arrivals, new brands, and exclusive collections
 - Enjoy exclusive app-only promotions and offers
 - Shop safely from authorized, professional sellers, and be assured about authenticity, product quality, condition, and fulfillment.
 - Invite your friends to THE LIST! Give them $30, and also receive $30 for each friend who signs up with your code. Your reward can be used towards 30% off on your next order.

bluejetty:00118961:ios.name: Dokobit
bluejetty:00118961:ios.summary: Signing documents from your phone or tablet has never been so easy. Dokobit app allows you to sign legally binding documents with Mobile ID or Smart-ID, effortlessly share documents, collect signatures from others and track signing progress
bluejetty:00118961:ios.description:
Signing documents from your phone or tablet has never been so easy. Dokobit app allows you to sign legally binding documents with Mobile ID or Smart-ID, effortlessly share documents, collect signatures from others and track signing progress anywhere, anytime. Dokobit is an easy-to-use tool where your documents are organised and accessible wherever you are.
Use Dokobit app to: 
SIGN DOCUMENTS ON THE GO. Sign documents right from your phone using Mobile ID or Smart-ID. With only a few clicks you will be able to read, sign and share the document whether you’re at work, on your way to a meeting or on vacation. 
COLLECT E-SIGNATURES FROM OTHERS. Easily add other signing parties to the document, they will receive an email with invitation to sign right away. Only intended persons will be able to access the document after authenticating themselves with an eID.
STORE AND MANAGE YOUR DOCUMENTS. Sort documents into categories for a more convenient and orderly experience. It will make easier to filter and find what you are looking for later on.
TRACK PROGRESS. See all the actions performed by document users through a detailed list of events. You will be able to see when the document was created, viewed, signed, etc.
BE SURE E-SIGNATURES ARE EQUAL TO THE HANDWRITTEN ONES. Dokobit supported Qualified Electronic Signatures are equal to handwritten signatures, thus, they are legally binding and accepted across the entire EU.

Musicboard the ultimate destination for anyone looking to discover or discuss music online.
On Musicboard, people from all around the world connect through their shared love of music. Write reviews, rate music, and compile lists in music's biggest online community.
Musicboard lets you:

• Discover new music from real people. Musicboard curates a database of ratings and reviews for the world's music.
• Compile music into lists, like your favorite albums, ranking an artist's discography, or showing off your hidden gems.
• Keep track of all the music you want to listen to, and stay up to date as new albums are being released.
Subscribe to Musicboard PRO:
• Unlock in-depth statistics about your musical interests.
• Spice up your profile a personal banner and a spot to share your favorite albums.
Hundreds of thousands already use Musicboard to share their thoughts and opinions in music. With a combination of ratings, reviews, and lists, their profile quickly becomes a central hub for their life in music.
Our Terms of Use is available at https://musicboard.app/terms
For feedback on our app, let us know at feedback@musicboard.app

bluejetty:00167983:ios.name: Red Hunt: Galaxy Space Shooter
bluejetty:00167983:ios.summary: The red alert hangs over the world. No more arcade games! The planet is on the brink of universal catastrophe! Only you and your plane, the Special Air Wing, the Ultimate Fighter, and the Raiden Fighter, can stop this uprising of the machin
bluejetty:00167983:ios.description:
The red alert hangs over the world. No more arcade games! The planet is on the brink of universal catastrophe! Only you and your plane, the Special Air Wing, the Ultimate Fighter, and the Raiden Fighter, can stop this uprising of the machines. Let's go to war!
A rabid AI wants to enslave the entire world. It's already taking over continents and spreading its contagion, a virus launched into all systems. Robots, drones, armored trains, tanks - all under the power of the neural network. Invite your friends together and give the enemy hell in hurricane air battles in which only one can emerge victorious!
Join our pre-registration campaign as a volunteer and wait to be called up for duty.
RED HUNT - a real cocktail of adrenaline and emotion, a mix of strategy and shooter. Royal battle in the air!
Exciting campaign.
Many levels, of varying difficulty. Complete strategic missions, discover secret corners of the map, and analyze your enemies. Each mission can be replayed to earn stars and necessary resources. Experience the heart-pounding thrill of intense battles across multiple levels and challenge!
Huge bosses.
Each boss is unique and has its own special techniques. A towering quadcopter armed with a barrage of deadly missiles or a converted WWII-era stormtrooper. Can you overcome the challenge of facing an armored train head-on, even when you're outnumbered and outgunned?
Beautiful graphics.
Cool explosions, tracer shells, night missions where spotlights illuminate the airfield. Full immersion in the world of apocalypse and warfare! Atmospheric 3D levels. War has never been so beautiful!
Upgrade your arsenal of weapons.
You can change the weapons on the plane. You can use a shotgun if you want or a real machine gun. There is also a huge rocket launcher and even a BFG! And of course a laser! What is the best way to kill a tank? Simple gunslingers won't do here - you need something more serious.
The Reactor.
You've been dreaming of melting anything and everything in games for a long time, haven't you? Your dream has come true. You can atomize weapons, resources, and even a pilot (although we don't recommend it). The unique resource uranium is fuel for the reactor. But it is also hunted by AI. How much uranium can your plane carry?
Assassin drones.
You can also take assassin drones with you on a mission! They will shoot at the enemy while you quietly unpack your gum or wipe your flight glasses at the controls of the plane. Remember, drones are robots fighting a war on your side!
Endless action.
There is no limit to the amount of action. This is not just a vertical shoot 'em up game. This is a strategy! Raids are not similar to each other: with each game new enemies and boosters appear, and you open new locations that will not make even the most avid shooter lover bored.
The game is still in development.
RED HUNT is still in development. We are testing different mechanics, adding levels, and expanding content - everything to make a mind-blowing action game! Don't judge harshly if you think you made it through the whole game on easy, but rather tell us to add it. Send all suggestions to isorbgame@gmail.com.
If you like arcade shooters, this is your choice. In the game, you will find everything you've been looking for: exciting gameplay, stunning 3D graphics, incredible battles with bosses, and there will even be an online mode to connect your friends in the toughest battles. This is not just a shooter - this is the drive of the battle in your phone! The planet is waiting for its hero!
In RED HUNT, you can play indefinitely and completely free!

Each boss is unique and has its own special techniques. A towering quadcopter armed with a barrage of deadly missiles or a converted WWII-era stormtrooper. Can you overcome the challenge of facing an armored train head-on, even when you're outnumbered and outgunned?

Beautiful graphics.
Cool explosions, tracer shells, night missions where spotlights illuminate the airfield. Full immersion in the world of apocalypse and warfare! Atmospheric 3D levels. War has never been so beautiful!

Upgrade your arsenal of weapons.
You can change the weapons on the plane. You can use a shotgun if you want or a real machine gun. There is also a huge rocket launcher and even a BFG! And of course a laser! What is the best way to kill a tank? Simple gunslingers won't do here - you need something more serious.

The Reactor.
You've been dreaming of melting anything and everything in games for a long time, haven't you? Your dream has come true. You can atomize weapons, resources, and even a pilot (although we don't recommend it). The unique resource uranium is fuel for the reactor. But it is also hunted by AI. How much uranium can your plane carry?

Assassin drones.
You can also take assassin drones with you on a mission! They will shoot at the enemy while you quietly unpack your gum or wipe your flight glasses at the controls of the plane. Remember, drones are robots fighting a war on your side!

Endless action.
There is no limit to the amount of action. This is not just a vertical shoot 'em up game. This is a strategy! Raids are not similar to each other: with each game new enemies and boosters appear, and you open new locations that will not make even the most avid shooter lover bored.

The game is still in development.
RED HUNT is still in development. We are testing different mechanics, adding levels, and expanding content - everything to make a mind-blowing action game! Don't judge harshly if you think you made it through the whole game on easy, but rather tell us to add it. Send all suggestions to isorbgame@gmail.com.

If you like arcade shooters, this is your choice. In the game, you will find everything you've been looking for: exciting gameplay, stunning 3D graphics, incredible battles with bosses, and there will even be an online mode to connect your friends in the toughest battles. This is not just a shooter - this is the drive of the battle in your phone! The planet is waiting for its hero!

In RED HUNT, you can play indefinitely and completely free!

bluejetty:00100356:ios.description:
*TRY BEFORE YOU BUY* Play the free experience, then unlock the whole game with one payment and no ads.
Join Bluey in a new adventure game with story by the show's creator. Set off on an epic quest featuring new characters, fully animated cutscenes, and hand-drawn environments inspired by the Dragon and Escape episodes in the TV series. 
Explore vibrant worlds, solve trifficult puzzles and complete fun challenges, all as you embark on Bluey’s Quest for The Gold Pen.
A NEW BLUEY STORY
Dive into an adventure game fueled by a brand-new story from the show's creator! Discover the humor and warmth Bluey brings in this fun new game for the family, with story by Joe Brumm.
EMBARK ON A HEART-WARMING ADVENTURE
Bluey is drawing at the table when Dad suddenly yoinks the Gold Pen she needs! Bluey sets off on an adventure with the whole family. Mum designs the strange and distant lands, Dad rocks up on his cool bike as self-declared King Goldie Horns, and Bingo transforms into her honk-happy alter ego — Bingooose! Away they go on an exciting quest to retrieve the Gold Pen – and have heaps of fun along the way. 
GO ON FUN-FILLED CHALLENGES
Uncover hidden treasures, solve playful puzzles, and take on delightful mini-quests as you glide, fly, and skate through each level. Interact with quirky characters and help little lost critters return to their homes. Search near and far for goosefood and beads to unlock new moments in the adventure as you keep Bluey moving onwards in her quest.
EXPLORE HAND-DRAWN WORLDS
Explore lively levels brimming with snowy mountains, golden beaches, lush forests, and iconic Australian landscapes. Each environment is packed with vibrant details and opportunities for discovery.
FUN FOR EVERYONE
Just like the animated series, Bluey’s Quest for the Gold Pen sparks laughter and encourages players of all ages to discover through play. Packed full of trifficult puzzles and wholesome moments, this is an adventure for the whole household.
About Bluey
Bluey is a loveable, inexhaustible six year-old Blue Heeler, who loves to turn everyday family life into boundless, playful adventures, developing her imagination and resilience as she goes.
About Ludo Studio
Ludo Studio is a BAFTA, multi-Emmy® and Logie award-winning Australian studio that creates and produces original scripted drama, animation and digital stories that are authored by incredible local talent, distributed globally and loved by audiences everywhere. ludostudio.com.au

bluejetty:00172644:ios.name: Leo's World: cars & adventures
bluejetty:00172644:ios.summary:
"Leo's World" is an educational game for children aged 2 to 5, featuring Leo the Truck and his friends.
In the game, kids can build their own world, gradually expanding its boundaries and possibilities. They’ll enjoy exciting adventures wit
bluejetty:00172644:ios.description:
"Leo's World" is an educational game for children aged 2 to 5, featuring Leo the Truck and his friends.
In the game, kids can build their own world, gradually expanding its boundaries and possibilities. They’ll enjoy exciting adventures with their favorite characters, a variety of tasks and discoveries, colorful animations, and a host of fun, positive experiences!
Leo's World is packed with mini-games and activities that help develop imaginative and logical thinking, fine motor skills, and visual memory.
The game also encourages creativity, self-expression, and exploration.
This bright, engaging world — with its smooth gameplay and professional voice acting — will surely delight both you and your child.
Locations and Characters
Leo the Truck’s world consists of several locations, each filled with a variety of interactive objects. To move through a location, players can choose one of the character cars: Leo, Lea, Skoop, or Lifty.
The task window helps players navigate the game, find all available mini-games and activities in the current location, and keep track of new tasks as they appear. 
Players can move between locations not only via the global map but also through special portals located at the edges of each area.
The game includes a special mode for the youngest players, where they can freely play all the mini-games directly from the main menu without entering locations.
In Leo’s House, children can find lost letters, make fruit ice cream, complete fun jigsaw puzzles, draw pictures, repair water pipes, and wash cars. They can even set off on a space journey to another planet!
In Skoop's House, players will repair a wind turbine, build a railway station, fly a hot air balloon, and rescue a kitten. They can also play football with Skoop and conduct real archaeological digs!
It’s time to clean up Lea’s Garage: sort the trash, clean the pond, assemble a crane, and find hidden objects at the scrap yard.
Now it’s time for fun! Compete against a robot in exciting mini-races, test your reaction speed in a whack-a-mole game, and compose your own melody using the cars.
Lifty lives in the city. Help him open his own shop and serve customers.
There’s plenty more to do: make delicious pizza, build a candy vending machine, trim the bushes, sort the trash, tidy up the parking lot, repair the traffic light, and launch a new tram route.
There’s even a movie theater where you can watch all the cartoons about Leo and his friends!
Characters’ House and Prizes
Sometimes Leo and his friends may get hungry or even sick — but that’s no problem! You can feed and heal your car characters in the Character House, and even try on different outfits there.
And if your car gets dirty after a rain, you can always wash it at one of the car washes located in each area.
Complete tasks, collect stars, and earn prizes — new game objects, food, medicine, and fun accessories for your favorite characters. 
Natural disasters
In Leo’s World, children may encounter natural disasters just like in the real world. These events are unpredictable and come with their own challenges. However, with the assistance of the friendly helper cars, your child can learn to quickly extinguish forest fires, repair the damage caused by tornadoes, and tackle other exciting problems.
Our team creates kind and engaging educational games for kids, based on original content produced in our own animation studios.
All of our projects are developed with the active participation of child development specialists.

Start every day with words that move you. Impact Quotes turns quiet moments into a daily habit of motivation, self-belief, and calm — with beautifully crafted quotes and affirmations, ready the moment you need them.

bluejetty:00179204:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of striking oil, forming your very own petroleum empire and earning billions of dollars? Now, you can. Welcome to Oil Tycoon, the game where you extract oil across the globe, sell it, and make your fortune!
Your road to riches starts in your backyard where you first strike oil! From here, and with your first pump, you begin your extraction mission. Oil Tycoon boasts awesome idle gameplay where you tap and build to slowly forge a petroleum empire unlike any that’s come before. After successfully extracting your first batch of oil, it’s time to sell up and upgrade, which means you’re off to the stock market. Here, you monitor prices and make sure you sell up at the optimum moment to make bank! Once you’re richer than a gold mine, it’s time to upgrade! Now, you can install new barrels, move into gas production, or explore new areas and continue mining! There are thousands of upgrades and new ventures to get stuck into, providing you can take a break from mining.
As you progress, you’ll unlock new locations as you mine and extract your way across the world. Imagine building a factory in the depths of the Siberia, installing underwater gas works, and hiring a lunar miner! The possibilities for your empire are endless, and the only limit is your entrepreneurial talents.
You’re going to make billions with your oil because now you have everything an oil miner needs to do so. Get out there, get sellin’, and become a true Oil Tycoon.

bluejetty:00180232:ios.name: Nozbe
bluejetty:00180232:ios.summary:
WHY YOU NEED NOZBE IN YOUR COMPANY?
Because you can work better, faster and with less stress. With Nozbe, you’ll be able to share projects, delegate tasks, communicate in comments, and achieve your goals together. No matter where you are a
bluejetty:00180232:ios.description:
WHY YOU NEED NOZBE IN YOUR COMPANY?
Because you can work better, faster and with less stress. With Nozbe, you’ll be able to share projects, delegate tasks, communicate in comments, and achieve your goals together. No matter where you are and what device you’re using.
Nozbe - Finally The To-Do App You and Your Team Will Love Using
Communicate effectively, manage & achieve your business goals with our project management tool. Have everything in one place: your team tasks, discussions, files & deadlines.
Nozbe is a collaboration and task & project management app for small and medium-sized companies, as well as single users. It’s a European app, so your data is protected under European Union law and is not subject to US jurisdiction.
KEY FEATURES
- Easy to implement & use - All your team members will quickly get the hang of it.
- Free - Up to 3 active projects and 3 people.
- Available on any device - Nozbe comes as a Mac app + iPhone/iPad app + Web app if needed.
- Works offline - And then seamlessly syncs on all devices when you’re back online.
- Projects → Tasks → Comments → DONE! - Simple structure of shared projects, shared tasks, and comments.
- Incoming view - Where you receive tasks from others, control your deadlines and see where you’re needed.
- Priority view - Where you keep the key and most urgent tasks to work on them.
- Activity - To track what’s going on in the projects you want or need to observe.
- Single tasks - For ideas and stuff that still needs shaping up.
- Reminders - To never miss a thing or deadline.
- Tags, project sections & colors and groups - To manage your tasks and projects and save time for actual work.
- Suitable for teams of 100, 50, 5 and 1 - You can use it with your team or as a solopreneur/freelancer.
- Multiple teams - To own or be a part of more than just one team, even a team of 1.
- Joint Projects - To be able to work with people from the outside on a specific project.
- GCal integration - So that you can see your scheduled tasks in your Google Calendar.
- Task Me - To assign single tasks to other people. 
- File attachments to comments - To have all the materials related to a given task under one roof and easily accessible.
- Linked tasks - To create chains of tasks and quickly find related tasks.
- Widget - See your Priority tasks on your home screen
WHAT YOU GET
- Collaborate with your team to get your work done – create projects and complete them together
- Communicate through tasks and ditch chaotic emails and chat – use task comments to exchange information & make sure everyone is up to date
- Stick to deadlines – assign tasks, set up due dates & reminders, and never miss a thing
- Track progress - track your team’s activity and make sure everyone is following the plan
- Access your team projects from anywhere – use Nozbe on your desktop and mobile devices & get your work done in the office or on the go
- Make sure your data is safe – all Nozbe connections are secure and encrypted
NOZBE PLANS:
• Nozbe is FREE – We offer you the full version of the app with up to 3 active projects and 3 members for free.
• NOZBE PREMIUM – For growing businesses and solopreneurs: unlimited projects and extra project sharing options.
From a team that’s been working from home since 2007
Nozbe is a 25-person team that has no central office. Since 2007, we’ve been working from our homes, yet we’ve successfully built Nozbe trusted by more than 500,000 people.
Terms of Use (EULA) and Privacy Policy: https://nozbe.com/terms

The application is designed in such a way that it is easy to use and has user friendly interface with features like book ticket, cancel ticket, maintain their profile, manage frequent travel routes , etc.The passenger will use Railway wallet to book the ticket.
There are two modes for booking Tickets : (i) Paper (ii) Paperless. In case of paper ticket user has to take a printout from kiosk/counter at concerned station. Whereas in case of Paperless ticket user's Location will be captured to determine he/she is present in valid ticketing area. In this mode no printout is required and the user can directly show his ticket from his smartphone to the TTE. Moreover an alternative to location check has also been introduced in limited stations where a user can scan a unique barcode present at station premises to book his paperless ticket.
