Introducing the Universal Remote: Smart TV Hub" - your ultimate solution to the perennial dilemma of a missing TV remote or the frustration of dealing with outdated devices. Say goodbye to these headaches as our innovative remote control app turns your phone into a powerful TV controller.
Take your TV experience to the next level with the Universal Remote: Smart TV Hub"!
Our no-frills application offers seamless control of your web-connected TV, right from your iPhone. This app gives you full control over various functions including channels, volume, menu, info, tools, and basic controls like play/pause/stop and more, mirroring the functionality of a traditional handheld remote.
Compatible with leading brands such as SAMSUNG, LG, SONY, ROKU, PANASONIC, AndroidTV, and Hesense. Support for TV models from different years of production and screen sizes. A simple connection between your iPhone and your TV over the same Wi-Fi network turns your touchscreen into a comprehensive navigation panel. It replicates all the functions of a traditional remote control.
Key features include:
- Fast and easy to get started: The app becomes your physical remote control, always at your fingertips.
- Automatic customization: Easy to set up and use for effortless control.
- Haptic feedback: Enhances the overall experience with realistic vibrations.
- Responsive touchpad: Provides an aesthetically pleasing and tactile interface.
- Keyboard input: Simplifies TV search and entry.
- Wi-Fi compatibility: Automatically detects all TVs on your network, making phone control a breeze.
"Universal remote control: Smart TV Hub" is a full-featured mobile version of a traditional TV remote control. Designed to streamline your daily life. Now you don't have to leave the comfort of your sofa to hunt for a misplaced remote or buy a new one in case it goes missing. Just sync the app with your device and you can effortlessly browse through your favorite shows, movies, and programs - all from your mobile phone. Embrace the wonders of technology and unlock a smarter, more convenient life!
***** Disclaimer
Please note that our app is an independent application and is not endorsed or affiliated with SAMSUNG, LG, SONY, ROKU, PANASONIC, AndroidTV, Hesense, or any other brand mentioned.

bluejetty:00170761:ios.name: Action News Jax Weather
bluejetty:00170761:ios.summary: Get the most accurate Jacksonville-area forecast in town with the First Alert Weather App from Action News Jax - WJAX/WFOX. The app features the forecast from your neighborhood, live radar, breaking weather alerts, live streaming video from
bluejetty:00170761:ios.description:
Get the most accurate Jacksonville-area forecast in town with the First Alert Weather App from Action News Jax - WJAX/WFOX. The app features the forecast from your neighborhood, live radar, breaking weather alerts, live streaming video from Chief Meteorologist Mike Buresh and the First Alert weather team. 
Summary of Features:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
- New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
- Additional items added seasonally
The weather app also has these critical benefits and features:
- The radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
- The app provides Location-Based alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, This app supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
- Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
- High resolution satellite cloud imagery
- Ability to add and save locations
- A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
- Additional items added seasonally
*Data and alerting available for the United States only

apple-macos:1553636330.description:
The complete, ad-free companion for Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900): 101 exam-style questions covering every domain of the current exam, each with a full explanation.
WHY THIS APP
Most AZ-900 quiz apps are thin question dumps with no explanations or a domain mix that doesn't match the real exam. This one is built and weighted to Microsoft's official AZ-900 exam guide, and every question; not just the answer key; comes with a full explanation of why the right choice is right and the others are wrong.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
- 101 exam-style questions weighted to match the official AZ-900 domain breakdown
- Every question comes with a detailed explanation
- Choose 5, 10, or 15 questions per practice session
- Track your progress, streaks, and score history right on your device
- Works fully offline — study on a plane, a commute, anywhere
- No ads, no account, no sign-up
EXAM DOMAINS COVERED
- Describe Cloud Concepts (25–30%): shared responsibility model, cloud economics (CapEx vs. OpEx), high availability and scalability, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS
- Describe Azure Architecture and Services (35–40%): compute (VMs, containers, Azure Functions), networking, storage, databases, AI/ML services
- Describe Azure Management and Governance (30–35%): cost management, Azure Policy, RBAC, Azure Portal/CLI/PowerShell, monitoring tools
BUILT FOR REAL STUDYING
Every question is written as a scenario a working cloud professional would actually face, with distractor answers that test common misconceptions rather than obvious wrong picks. Explanations spell out the reasoning so you learn the concept, not just memorize a letter.
MORE THAN ONE EXAM?
This app is part of the Djamgatech PRO family. If you're studying for more than just Azure Fundamentals, Djamgatech PRO covers 53 certifications across AWS, Azure, GCP, and AI all offline, all in one app, all ad-free.
Study smarter, walk into your AZ-900 exam ready, and pass with confidence.

apple-macos:6793196260.name: OvateChat
apple-macos:6793196260.description:
OvateChat is a private messenger built on one principle: your conversations belong to you.
Every message, photo, video, voice note, file, call and story is protected with end-to-end encryption using the Signal Protocol — the cryptography trusted by security experts worldwide. Your keys never leave your phone. Not even we can read what you send.
PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE • End-to-end encrypted messages, media, calls, groups, channels and stories • Delivered messages are wiped from our servers — we keep no copy of your ciphertext • No ads, no trackers, no analytics, no data selling — ever • No phone number: sign up with a username and an email address • Friends by username — your address book is never uploaded
EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT • One-to-one and group chats with reactions, replies, editing and delete for everyone • Audio and video calls, one-to-one and in groups • Photos, videos, documents and large files, voice notes and location sharing • Stories for the friends you choose — 6, 12 or 24 hours, then gone • Channels: follow public channels, or open your own • Stickers, sticker packs and a sticker maker; GIFs • Disappearing messages, starred messages, message search • Read receipts and typing awareness you control • Your own name for each contact — only you see it • Several accounts on one phone; link a second device
YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES • Control who can find you and who can message you • Block, report and mute with one tap • App lock with Face ID or a PIN; screenshot notices • Encrypted backup — encrypted on your phone before it is stored • Switch an account off, or delete it any time, right from the app • Dark mode, Arabic and right-to-left support
OvateChat is built and operated by Ovate Technologies. Read our privacy policy at https://ovatechat.com/privacy — the short version: privacy isn't a setting, it's the architecture.

fdroid:com.rr.numio.decibel.name: Decibel: Volume Booster
fdroid:com.rr.numio.decibel.summary: Make your phone louder. Volume booster for speakers, videos and calls. No ads.
fdroid:com.rr.numio.decibel.description:
Decibel is a simple volume booster that makes quiet videos, calls, music and speakers louder. No ads, no tracking, no internet permission.
Turn it on, slide the boost up, and it raises the sound of every app using Android's built-in loudness effect.
 One big on/off button and a Quick Settings tile
 Volume and Boost sliders on one screen
 Up to +12 dB, or +24 dB with Higher boost
 Runs in the background with a notification to stop it
 No ads, no tracking, no internet permission
Loud sound can damage speakers and hearing. Turn the boost down if you hear crackling.
